attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation. Business justification: Forced outages can trigger NERC reliability standard violations (FAC-002, MOD standards) or environmental permit violations. Operations and compliance teams must link outage events to resulting violat

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the maintenance work order associated with the outage event. Links to the asset management work order system for tracking repair activities, labor, and materials.

attributes.name: capacity_lost_mw
attributes.description: Amount of generation capacity (in Megawatts) unavailable due to the outage. For full outages, this equals the unit nameplate capacity. For deratings, this is the reduction amount. Critical for NERC GADS EAF and EFOR calculations.

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the outage root cause, failure mode, and contributing factors. Supplements the NERC GADS cause code with plant-specific context.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the outage event record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: environmental_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage resulted in or was caused by an environmental incident (emissions exceedance, spill, discharge violation). True if environmental incident occurred. False otherwise. Triggers EPA reporting workflow.

attributes.name: equipment_component_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific equipment component or system that failed or required maintenance. Examples: turbine blade, boiler tube, generator exciter, condenser, cooling tower. Aligns with plant equipment hierarchy.

attributes.name: equipment_component_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the equipment component affected by the outage, including location within the unit and technical specifications.

attributes.name: estimated_repair_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated cost in US Dollars for outage-related repairs, parts replacement, and labor. Includes direct maintenance costs but excludes revenue loss. Used for O&M budget tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_return_to_service_timestamp
attributes.description: Projected date and time when the unit is expected to return to service. Updated as outage work progresses. Used for generation scheduling and market commitment planning.

attributes.name: estimated_revenue_loss_usd
attributes.description: Estimated revenue loss in US Dollars due to the outage, calculated based on lost generation capacity, market prices, and outage duration. Used for financial impact analysis and IRP planning.

attributes.name: forced_outage_rate_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event impacts the unit Equivalent Forced Outage Rate (EFOR) calculation. True for forced outages and unplanned deratings. False for planned maintenance.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel type of the generation unit affected by the outage. Used for fuel-specific outage analysis and generation fleet planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coal|natural_gas|nuclear|hydro|wind|solar|biomass|oil — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: grid_impact_severity
attributes.description: Assessment of the outage impact on grid reliability and system operations. Critical: caused or contributed to grid emergency. Major: significant capacity loss during peak demand. Moderate: noticeable but manageable. Minor: minimal impact. None: no grid impact.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the outage event record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Updated whenever any attribute is modified.

attributes.name: market_commitment_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage caused the unit to fail to meet day-ahead or real-time market commitments. True if the outage resulted in market penalties or buy-back costs. False if no market impact.

attributes.name: nerc_gads_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC GADS (Generating Availability Data System) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event must be reported to NERC GADS. True if the outage meets NERC GADS reporting thresholds (duration, capacity, or cause criteria). False for minor events below reporting thresholds.

attributes.name: nerc_gads_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC GADS (Generating Availability Data System) Submission Date
attributes.description: Date when the outage event data was submitted to NERC GADS. Null if not yet submitted or not reportable. Used for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: outage_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the outage in hours, calculated as the difference between outage end and start timestamps. Null if outage is still active. Used for NERC GADS availability metrics and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: outage_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the generation unit returned to service and was synchronized to the grid. Null if outage is still active. Used to calculate outage duration and unit availability metrics.

attributes.name: outage_event_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the outage event, typically assigned by the plant operations or outage management system. Used for external reporting and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: outage_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional outage details, operational context, lessons learned, and cross-functional coordination notes. Used for knowledge capture and future reference.

attributes.name: outage_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level for outage resolution. Critical: immediate grid reliability impact. High: significant capacity loss. Medium: moderate impact. Low: minimal impact or planned maintenance.

attributes.name: outage_season
attributes.description: Season during which the outage occurred. Used for seasonal outage pattern analysis and maintenance planning optimization.

attributes.name: outage_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the generation unit outage began. For forced outages, this is the trip or shutdown time. For planned outages, this is the scheduled start time. Critical for NERC GADS reporting and availability calculations.

attributes.name: outage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the outage event. Active: outage is ongoing. Completed: unit returned to service. Cancelled: planned outage was cancelled. Extended: outage duration was extended beyond original estimate.

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outage event. Forced: unplanned immediate shutdown. Planned: scheduled in advance. Maintenance: scheduled preventive or corrective work. Derating: partial capacity reduction. Seasonal: planned seasonal shutdown.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal root cause analysis (RCA) has been completed for the outage event. True if RCA is complete. False if pending or not required. Used for continuous improvement tracking.

attributes.name: rto_iso_notification_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: RTO (Regional Transmission Organization) / ISO (Independent System Operator) Notification Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the RTO or ISO was notified of the outage event. Required for forced outages and deratings per market rules. Used for compliance verification.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage involved a worker safety incident (injury, near-miss, OSHA recordable event). True if safety incident occurred. False otherwise. Triggers OSHA reporting workflow.

attributes.name: unit_nameplate_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Maximum rated generation capacity of the unit in Megawatts. Denormalized from unit master data for outage analysis and capacity planning calculations.

attributes.name: weather_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage was caused or exacerbated by weather conditions (extreme temperature, lightning, wind, ice, flooding). True if weather was a contributing factor. False otherwise.

products.name: startup_event
products.description: Transactional record of each generating unit startup event, capturing startup type (hot/warm/cold), initiation timestamp, synchronization timestamp, full-load timestamp, startup fuel consumed (MMBtu), startup cost ($), startup duration (minutes), reason for startup (economic dispatch, reliability, test), and success/failure outcome. Feeds NERC GADS event reporting (cause code linkage to outage_event), O&M cost tracking, heat rate degradation analysis, and unit commitment optimization models. Supports startup cost curve calibration for day-ahead market offers.
products.reference: ABB Ability Symphony Plus DCS Event Log / NERC GADS

attributes.name: startup_cost_usd

attributes.name: startup_duration_minutes

attributes.name: startup_event_number

attributes.name: startup_fuel_consumed_mmbtu

attributes.name: startup_fuel_cost_per_mmbtu

attributes.name: startup_heat_rate_btu_per_kwh

attributes.name: startup_reason_code

attributes.description: Guaranteed or average heat content of the fuel expressed in MMBtu per unit (ton, barrel, cubic meter) for heat rate and LCOE calculations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel contract record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: maximum_take_limit
attributes.description: Maximum volume of fuel that can be purchased annually under contract terms, expressed in volume_unit_of_measure.

attributes.name: minimum_take_obligation
attributes.description: Minimum volume of fuel that must be purchased annually under take-or-pay provisions, expressed in volume_unit_of_measure.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this fuel contract record.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Approved method of payment to the supplier for fuel deliveries under this contract.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment is due to the supplier.

attributes.name: price_adjustment_formula
attributes.description: Mathematical formula or description of how contract price adjusts based on indices, escalation factors, or other variables.

attributes.name: price_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this contract.

attributes.name: price_index_reference
attributes.description: Name of the pricing index or benchmark used for index-based contracts (e.g., Henry Hub, NYMEX Natural Gas, API2 Coal Index).
attributes.references: Energy Trading and Risk Management Standard

attributes.name: price_structure_type
attributes.description: Pricing mechanism used in the contract: fixed price, index-linked (e.g., Henry Hub, NYMEX), formula-based, hybrid, or negotiated per delivery.
attributes.references: Energy Trading and Risk Management Standard

attributes.name: quality_specification
attributes.description: Technical specifications for fuel quality including heat content, sulfur content, ash content, moisture, or other relevant parameters.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory approval was granted for this fuel contract, if applicable.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fuel contract requires approval from state PUC or FERC for cost recovery in rate base.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required to exercise or decline contract renewal option.

attributes.name: renewal_option
attributes.description: Type of renewal provision in the contract specifying how the agreement may be extended beyond the initial term.

attributes.name: termination_clause
attributes.description: Conditions and notice requirements under which either party may terminate the contract prior to expiration.

attributes.name: transportation_arrangement
attributes.description: Party responsible for arranging and paying for fuel transportation from supplier to delivery point.

attributes.name: transportation_cost_responsibility
attributes.description: Party responsible for bearing the cost of fuel transportation under contract terms.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for contracted fuel volume (MMBtu for gas, tons for coal/biomass, barrels for oil, cubic meters for gas, MWh thermal for nuclear).

domains.name: customer
domains.description: SSOT for all customer identity, account, and relationship data across residential, commercial, and industrial segments. Manages customer profiles, service agreements, premises, contact information, premise-to-account linkages, credit classifications, and multi-channel engagement history within CIS platforms (SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B). Supports NEM participants, BTM customers, and DER-enrolled accounts. Central reference for all downstream billing, metering, and demand response domains.
domains.references: NAESB RMQ, Oracle CC&B, SAP IS-U CIS

products.name: account
products.description: Core master entity representing a utility customer account in SAP IS-U and Oracle CC&B. Captures the authoritative account record for residential, commercial, and industrial customers including account number, account type (residential/commercial/industrial), account status, account status history (with change timestamps, reason codes, and initiating events), credit class, move-in/move-out dates, service territory, rate category, NEM participation flag, BTM flag, DER enrollment status, CIS source system identifier, regulatory jurisdiction, parent account reference for consolidated billing and corporate hierarchy, and account group classification (consolidated billing, corporate parent, franchise, municipal aggregation, CCA). SSOT for all downstream billing, metering, and demand response domains. Supports lifecycle tracking of activation, suspension, disconnection, reconnection, write-off, and reactivation events.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Account / Oracle CC&B Account

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the utility customer account record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for all downstream joins across billing, metering, and demand response domains.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Business Partner / Account Object; Oracle CC&B Account Entity

attributes.name: account_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master customer (business partner / person) record that owns this account. Links the account to the customer identity, contact, and demographic data in the Customer domain SSOT.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Business Partner (BUT000); Oracle CC&B Person/Account Relationship

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Customer accounts are assigned to control areas for energy settlement, interchange accounting, regulatory reporting, and balancing authority cost allocation. Required for billing and compliance operat

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.counterparty. Business justification: Large C&I customer accounts are registered as trading counterparties for bilateral energy contracts, PPAs, and capacity agreements. Credit management, ISDA/CSA agreement tracking, and bilateral trade

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent account_id for consolidated billing hierarchies and corporate account structures. Null for top-level or standalone accounts. Enables traversal of multi-level corporate hierarchies for enterprise billing and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Account Hierarchy; Oracle CC&B Account Hierarchy; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: pnode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.pnode. Business justification: In RTO/ISO markets, large industrial customer accounts are settled at a specific pricing node (pnode) for LMP-based energy charges and demand response dispatch. Market settlement, billing reconciliati

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary service premise (physical location) associated with this account. A premise represents the physical address where electricity is delivered. Accounts may span multiple premises in consolidated billing scenarios.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Premise (EANL); Oracle CC&B Premise; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network Service Location

attributes.name: primary_service_asset_registry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Service Asset Registry Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: Accounts track primary service delivery asset (transformer, service vault) for billing context, capacity planning, and outage impact analysis. Critical for customer-asset operational linkage in utilit

attributes.name: rate_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rate_case. Business justification: Commission-approved rate cases directly govern the rates applied to customer accounts. Utilities must track which rate case established a customer's current rate schedule for regulatory audits, billin

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.service_point. Business justification: Billing and service activation/deactivation processes require knowing which service point an account is billed against. Utilities track account-to-service-point assignment for billing setup, outage no

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.service_territory. Business justification: Account-level service territory assignment drives tariff application, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and franchise compliance reporting. Utility billing systems require this link to apply corr

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.contract. Business justification: Large C&I customer accounts are served under bilateral supply contracts managed in the trading/ETRM system. Contract management, rate reconciliation, and regulatory reporting (FERC EQR) require linkin

attributes.name: to_profile_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.profile.profile_id — Every account must reference the customer profile (person or organization) that owns it. This is the most fundamental FK in any CIS — account.profile_id → profile.profile_id. Without this, you cannot

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: Grouping classification that determines billing consolidation and hierarchy rules. Consolidated billing groups multiple premises under one bill; corporate parent denotes the apex of a corporate hierarchy; municipal aggregation and Community Choice Aggregation (CCA) denote aggregated load programs; franchise denotes accounts under a specific franchise territory agreement.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Account Group (VKONT-VKGRP); Oracle CC&B Account Management Group; FERC OATT; State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known utility account number as assigned by the Customer Information System (CIS). This is the number printed on customer bills and used in all customer-facing communications. Sourced from SAP IS-U FKKVK or Oracle CC&B ACCOUNT table.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Account (FKKVK); Oracle CC&B Account; NAESB WEQ-001

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the utility account. Governs service eligibility, billing generation, and collections processing. Transitions include: pending_activation (new account awaiting energization), active (energized and billed), suspended (temporarily halted per tariff or non-payment), disconnected (service terminated), written_off (uncollectable balance), reactivated (restored after disconnection).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Account Status (VKONT-VKOSTATUS); Oracle CC&B Account Status; PUC Service Disconnection Rules

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the utility account by customer segment. Drives rate eligibility, billing rules, and regulatory reporting. Residential covers single-family and multi-family dwellings; commercial covers businesses; industrial covers large-load manufacturing and processing facilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|commercial|industrial|municipal|agricultural|street_lighting|transportation|government — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Account Determination (VKTYP); Oracle CC&B Account Type; FERC Form 1 Customer Classification; EIA-861

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the account was first activated and service was energized. Represents the precise business event time of account creation and service commencement. Used for SLA tracking of new service connections.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Account Creation; Oracle CC&B Account Activation; State PUC New Connect SLA

attributes.name: ami_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account has an Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) smart meter installed, enabling automated interval reads, remote connect/disconnect, and real-time usage data. Drives eligibility for TOU rates, demand response programs, and enhanced billing analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Device Management; FERC Order 888; State PUC AMI Deployment Plans; IEEE C12.19

attributes.name: autopay_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in automatic payment (AutoPay), where the bill amount is automatically debited from the customer's bank account or charged to a payment card on the due date. Reduces collections risk and improves cash flow.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FI-CA Payment Method; Oracle CC&B Auto Pay; NAESB WEQ; PCI DSS

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle (meter reading and bill generation schedule) assigned to this account. Determines the monthly read date and bill due date. Managed in SAP IS-U Billing Order or Oracle CC&B Bill Cycle. Examples: BC01 (1st of month), BC15 (15th of month).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Order (ABRSPERR); Oracle CC&B Bill Cycle; State PUC Billing Rules

attributes.name: btm_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account has Behind-the-Meter (BTM) generation or storage assets installed at the premise. BTM assets include solar PV, battery storage, and combined heat and power (CHP) systems that are not directly visible to the grid operator. Drives load disaggregation and DER management workflows.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC DER Rules; DERMS Integration; IEEE 1547

attributes.name: budget_billing_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in a budget billing (levelized payment plan) program, where monthly bills are averaged over a 12-month period to smooth seasonal fluctuations. Affects bill calculation and settlement processes in SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Budget Billing (ABSCHLAG); Oracle CC&B Budget Billing; State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: cis_account_key
attributes.description: The native primary key or account identifier as stored in the source CIS (SAP IS-U contract account number VKONT, or Oracle CC&B account ID). Enables traceability back to the operational system of record for reconciliation, audit, and issue resolution.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Account (VKONT); Oracle CC&B Account ID; SOX Data Lineage; Enterprise MDM Policy

attributes.name: cis_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational Customer Information System (CIS) from which this account record originates. Critical for data lineage, deduplication, and cross-system reconciliation in multi-CIS utility environments. Values: SAP_IS_U (SAP Industry Solution for Utilities), ORACLE_CCB (Oracle Customer Care and Billing), LEGACY_CIS (decommissioned legacy system).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U; Oracle CC&B; Enterprise Data Governance Policy; SOX Data Lineage

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the service agreement or contract associated with this account is scheduled to expire or terminate. Null for open-ended tariff service. For fixed-term commercial or industrial contracts and PPAs, this date triggers renewal or renegotiation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract (VERTRAG); Oracle CC&B Service Agreement; FERC PPA; State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the service agreement or contract associated with this account became effective. For residential accounts this typically aligns with move_in_date; for commercial and industrial accounts this may reflect a separately negotiated contract effective date, Power Purchase Agreement (PPA), or special contract term.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract (VERTRAG); Oracle CC&B Service Agreement; FERC PPA; State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account record was first created in the source CIS system. Represents the audit creation time for data lineage and SOX compliance. Distinct from activation_timestamp which represents the business event of service energization.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Account Creation Timestamp; Oracle CC&B Account Created Date; SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: credit_class
attributes.description: Credit risk classification assigned to the account based on payment history, credit bureau data, and internal scoring. Governs deposit requirements, payment plan eligibility, and collections treatment. Managed within SAP IS-U FICA or Oracle CC&B Collections module.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FI-CA Credit Management (FKKCR); Oracle CC&B Credit Review; State PUC Credit and Deposit Rules; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of security deposit held by the utility for this account, as required by credit class or PUC tariff rules. Refundable upon account closure in good standing. Tracked in SAP IS-U FI-CA or Oracle CC&B.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FI-CA Security Deposit (FKKDEP); Oracle CC&B Deposit; State PUC Deposit Rules; SOX

attributes.name: ev_charging_enrolled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Rate Enrollment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in a special Electric Vehicle (EV) charging rate or managed charging program. Drives eligibility for off-peak EV charging incentives and supports grid load forecasting for EV adoption planning.
attributes.references: State PUC EV Tariff; FERC Order 2222; DOE EV Infrastructure Programs; IEEE 2030.5

attributes.name: last_bill_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent bill generated for this account. Used to identify unbilled accounts, support billing cycle management, and calculate days since last bill for collections and customer service workflows.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Document (ERDK); Oracle CC&B Bill; State PUC Billing Rules

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment posted to this account. Used in collections scoring, credit class review, and customer service inquiries. Sourced from SAP IS-U FI-CA payment history or Oracle CC&B payment records.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FI-CA Payment (DFKKZP); Oracle CC&B Payment; State PUC Collections Rules

attributes.name: last_status_change_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent change to account_status. Enables tracking of the current status duration and supports collections and reconnection SLA monitoring. Complements the account status history table for current-state queries.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Account Status History; Oracle CC&B Account Status History; State PUC Disconnection/Reconnection Rules

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this account record in the source CIS or Silver Layer. Supports incremental data loading, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail requirements for SOX and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Change Document; Oracle CC&B Audit Log; SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: life_support_equipment
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer at this account relies on electrically-powered life support equipment (e.g., home dialysis, ventilator, oxygen concentrator). Triggers mandatory advance disconnection notice requirements and priority restoration during outages per PUC regulations.
attributes.references: State PUC Life Support Rules; NERC EOP-011; State Emergency Management Regulations

attributes.name: move_in_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer initiated service at the associated premise, triggering account activation and the start of billing. Corresponds to the service start date in CIS. Critical for proration of first bill and regulatory reporting of new connects.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In (EINZUG); Oracle CC&B Start Service; State PUC Service Rules

attributes.name: move_out_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer terminated service at the associated premise, triggering final bill generation and account closure. Null for currently active accounts. Corresponds to the service end date in CIS.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-Out (AUSZUG); Oracle CC&B Stop Service; State PUC Service Rules

attributes.name: open_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance on the account as of the last billing or payment posting. Represents the net amount owed by the customer (positive) or credit due to the customer (negative). Sourced from SAP IS-U FI-CA or Oracle CC&B AR sub-ledger. Used for collections prioritization and credit risk management.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FI-CA (DFKKOP); Oracle CC&B Financial Transaction; SOX AR Controls; State PUC Collections Rules

attributes.name: paperless_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in paperless (electronic) billing, receiving bills via email or online portal rather than postal mail. Supports sustainability reporting and customer engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Bill Delivery; SAP IS-U Bill Print Suppression; State PUC E-Bill Rules

attributes.name: preferred_contact_channel
attributes.description: Customer's preferred channel for receiving utility communications including bills, outage notifications, and program offers. Drives multi-channel engagement routing in CRM and outage notification systems (OMS). Aligns with customer consent preferences.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Contact Preference; SAP CRM Interaction Channel; TCPA; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) representing the customer's preferred language for all communications. Drives bill language selection, IVR routing, and outage notification language. Examples: en, es, zh-TW, vi, ko.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1; State PUC Language Access Rules; Title VI Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (ISO 3166-2 subdivision) identifying the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) with regulatory authority over this account. Determines applicable tariff, consumer protection rules, and reporting obligations. Critical for multi-state utility operations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; State PUC Jurisdiction; FERC; NERC

attributes.name: renewable_energy_plan
attributes.description: Code identifying the voluntary renewable energy plan or green tariff program in which this account is enrolled. Examples include 100% renewable, green power option, or Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) purchase programs. Supports Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|green_100pct|green_50pct|rec_purchase|community_solar|wind_option — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State PUC RPS Rules; EPA Green Power Partnership; REC (Renewable Energy Certificate) Standards; NERC

attributes.name: status_change_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining the most recent account status transition. Examples include non_payment, customer_request, move_out, returned_check, medical_baseline, regulatory_order. Supports collections analytics and regulatory compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_payment|customer_request|move_out|returned_check|medical_baseline|regulatory_order|fraud|deceased — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Disconnection Reason (ABGRU); Oracle CC&B Stop Reason; State PUC Disconnection Rules; NERC CIP

attributes.name: tou_rate_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled on a Time-of-Use (TOU) rate schedule, where energy prices vary by time of day and season to reflect grid conditions. Requires AMI metering. Supports demand flexibility analytics and rate design evaluation.
attributes.references: State PUC TOU Tariff; SAP IS-U Rate Type; Oracle CC&B Rate Schedule; FERC Order 2222

products.name: profile
products.description: Master entity capturing the identity and demographic attributes of a utility customer person or organization. Stores legal name, date of birth, government ID type and masked number, business entity type (sole proprietor, LLC, corporation), language preference, communication preference, income tier classification, low-income assistance program eligibility, and identity verification status. Supports both residential individuals and commercial/industrial entities. Sourced from SAP IS-U Business Partner and Oracle CC&B Person/Account.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Business Partner / Oracle CC&B Person

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer profile record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for all downstream joins across billing, metering, and demand response domains.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Business Partner; Oracle CC&B Person/Account

attributes.name: mailing_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Profile has embedded mailing address fields that should be normalized to reference the address table. The profile table has mailing_address_line1, mailing_address_line2, mailing_city, mailing_state_pr

attributes.name: autopay_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is enrolled in automatic payment (AutoPay), authorizing the utility to automatically debit the customer's bank account or payment card on the bill due date. Reduces collections risk and improves cash flow predictability.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules; State PUC AutoPay Regulations; SAP IS-U FICA Payment Method; Oracle CC&B AutoPay

attributes.name: budget_billing_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is enrolled in a budget billing (levelized payment) program, where monthly charges are averaged over 12 months to smooth seasonal bill fluctuations. Drives levelized billing calculation in SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B.
attributes.references: State PUC Budget Billing Rules; SAP IS-U Budget Billing; Oracle CC&B Budget Billing

attributes.name: business_entity_type
attributes.description: Legal structure of the commercial or industrial customer organization. Null for residential person customers. Used for credit assessment, tax treatment, and regulatory classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sole_proprietor|partnership|llc|corporation|non_profit|government|trust|cooperative — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Entity Classification; State Corporation Commission; SAP IS-U BP Legal Form

attributes.name: business_partner_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the customer in the source Customer Information System (CIS). Maps to SAP IS-U Business Partner (BP) number or Oracle CC&B Person ID. Used for cross-system reconciliation and customer-facing correspondence.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U BP Master; Oracle CC&B Person

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preferred channel for receiving utility communications including bills, outage notifications, demand response alerts, and program enrollment confirmations. Drives multi-channel engagement routing in CRM and OMS notification systems.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CAN-SPAM Act; SAP IS-U BP Communication Method; Oracle CC&B Contact Preference

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer profile record was first created in the source CIS system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Represents the customer's initial enrollment date with the utility. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format per model conventions.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U BP Creation Date; Oracle CC&B Person Created Date; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: credit_classification
attributes.description: Internal credit risk classification assigned to the customer based on payment history, credit bureau data, and utility-specific scoring. Drives deposit requirements, payment plan eligibility, and collections treatment. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA credit segment or Oracle CC&B credit rating.
attributes.references: FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act); State PUC Deposit Rules; SAP IS-U FICA Credit Segment; Oracle CC&B Credit Rating

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score obtained from a third-party credit bureau or internal scoring model. Range typically 300–850 for FICO-based scores. Used for deposit waiver decisions, payment arrangement eligibility, and collections prioritization. Null if no credit history exists.
attributes.references: FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act); FICO Score Standards; SAP IS-U FICA Credit Score

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment classification of the customer. Drives rate schedule eligibility, billing treatment, and regulatory reporting. Residential covers individual households; commercial covers small-to-medium businesses; industrial covers large-load manufacturing and processing facilities; agricultural covers farming operations; government covers public sector entities.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Schedule Definitions; SAP IS-U Customer Class

attributes.name: customer_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is a natural person (individual) or a legal organization (business entity). Determines which identity attributes are applicable and governs data handling obligations under privacy regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP IS-U BP Category (Person/Organization)

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the residential customer individual. Used for identity verification, age-based eligibility programs (e.g., senior discount rates), and credit assessment. Null for organization customers. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format per model conventions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; CCPA §1798.140; SAP IS-U BP Date of Birth

attributes.name: demand_response_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is actively enrolled in a Demand Response (DR) program, authorizing the utility or ISO/RTO to curtail or shift the customer's load during peak demand events. Drives DR dispatch eligibility in DERMS and EMS systems.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745; NERC BAL-002; State PUC DR Program Rules; Oracle CC&B Program Enrollment

attributes.name: deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is required to pay a security deposit based on credit classification, payment history, or state PUC rules. True triggers deposit collection workflow in SAP IS-U FICA or Oracle CC&B.
attributes.references: State PUC Deposit Regulations; SAP IS-U FICA Deposit Management; Oracle CC&B Deposit

attributes.name: der_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has one or more Distributed Energy Resources (DER) — such as rooftop solar, battery storage, or EV chargers — enrolled in the utility's DERMS platform. Enables participation in virtual power plant (VPP) programs and demand response dispatch.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; IEEE 1547; NERC BAL-002; DERMS Integration Standards

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has requested to be excluded from non-essential marketing and outreach communications. Does not suppress legally required notices (e.g., disconnection warnings, safety alerts). Enforced in CRM and outbound communication systems.
attributes.references: TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); CCPA §1798.120

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the customer used for electronic bill delivery, outage notifications, demand response program communications, and account alerts. Sourced from SAP IS-U BP email or Oracle CC&B Person email.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act; SAP IS-U BP Email

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the residential customer individual. Null for commercial/industrial entity customers. Sourced from SAP IS-U BP first name or Oracle CC&B Person first name field.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP IS-U BP Name Fields

attributes.name: government_id_masked
attributes.description: Masked representation of the government-issued identification number, retaining only the last four digits (e.g., ***-**-1234 for SSN). Full ID is stored only in the source CIS system under restricted access. Used for identity confirmation without exposing the full identifier.
attributes.references: CCPA §1798.140; GDPR Article 9; PCI DSS Tokenization Guidance; SAP IS-U BP ID Number

attributes.name: government_id_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identification document provided by the customer for identity verification. SSN and ITIN apply to US individuals; EIN applies to business entities; passport and drivers_license apply to individuals. Paired with masked government_id_masked field.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004; CCPA §1798.140; GDPR Article 9; SAP IS-U BP ID Type

attributes.name: identity_verification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer's identity verification process. Verified indicates successful validation against government ID or third-party identity service; unverified indicates not yet validated; pending indicates verification in progress; failed indicates verification attempt was unsuccessful; waived indicates verification requirement was formally waived (e.g., for government accounts).
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004; FERC Standards of Conduct; SAP IS-U BP Verification Status

attributes.name: identity_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer's identity was most recently successfully verified. Used for compliance audit trails and periodic re-verification scheduling. Null if identity_verification_status is unverified or pending.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004; GDPR Article 5(1)(f); SAP IS-U BP Verification Date

attributes.name: income_tier
attributes.description: Income tier classification assigned to the customer based on self-reported or verified household income relative to the federal poverty level (FPL). Used for low-income rate program eligibility, LIHEAP enrollment, and CARE/FERA program qualification. Tier 1 represents lowest income bracket.
attributes.references: LIHEAP (Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program); State PUC CARE/FERA Program Rules; FERC Low-Income Provisions

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preferred language for all communications, bills, and notices. Stored as ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g., en, es, zh, fr, vi). Drives multi-language bill rendering and outage notification language selection in CIS and OMS systems.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; State PUC Language Access Requirements; SAP IS-U BP Language

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name of the residential customer individual. Null for commercial/industrial entity customers. Sourced from SAP IS-U BP last name or Oracle CC&B Person last name field.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP IS-U BP Name Fields

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the customer profile record in the source CIS system. Used for change data capture (CDC) processing in the Silver Layer ETL pipeline and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U BP Change Date; Oracle CC&B Person Last Modified; GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the customer as registered with the utility. For residential customers this is the individual's full name; for commercial/industrial customers this is the registered business entity name. Used for billing, regulatory correspondence, and identity verification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; SAP IS-U BP Name Fields

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the customer profile in its lifecycle. Active indicates a current utility customer; inactive indicates a former customer with no active service agreements; pending indicates a new customer application in progress; suspended indicates temporary hold due to credit or compliance issues; deceased indicates confirmed death of a residential customer; merged indicates the profile was consolidated into another record.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U BP Status; Oracle CC&B Person Status; State PUC Customer Service Rules

attributes.name: low_income_assistance_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has been determined eligible for low-income energy assistance programs such as CARE (California Alternate Rates for Energy), FERA, LIHEAP, or equivalent state-specific programs. Drives discounted rate application in billing.
attributes.references: LIHEAP Federal Program; State PUC CARE/FERA Rules; DOE Weatherization Assistance Program; Oracle CC&B Program Enrollment

attributes.name: low_income_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific low-income assistance program the customer is enrolled in (e.g., CARE, FERA, LIHEAP, HEAP, REACH). Null if low_income_assistance_eligible is false. Used for rate discount application and regulatory reporting to state PUC.
attributes.references: State PUC Low-Income Program Definitions; LIHEAP; DOE Weatherization Assistance Program

attributes.name: marketing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications about energy efficiency programs, new rate plans, and utility products. Required under GDPR opt-in rules for EU-adjacent operations and CCPA for California customers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(a); CCPA §1798.120; TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: medical_baseline_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer qualifies for a medical baseline allowance due to a life-threatening illness or condition requiring life-support equipment. Triggers additional baseline energy allocation at the lowest rate tier and special disconnection protections under state PUC rules.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Rules; CPUC Rule 11; Oracle CC&B Medical Baseline Program

attributes.name: mobile_phone_number
attributes.description: Mobile telephone number for the customer, used specifically for SMS-based outage alerts, two-factor authentication, and demand response text notifications. Distinct from primary phone which may be a landline. Stored in E.164 format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; TCPA; SAP IS-U BP Mobile Number

attributes.name: nem_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer participates in a Net Energy Metering (NEM) program, meaning they have behind-the-meter (BTM) generation (typically solar PV) and receive credits for excess energy exported to the grid. Drives bidirectional metering requirements and NEM tariff application.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC NEM Tariff Rules; PURPA; SAP IS-U NEM Rate Category

attributes.name: paperless_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted into electronic (paperless) bill delivery, suppressing physical mail generation. Drives bill rendering workflow in SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B billing engine.
attributes.references: State PUC Electronic Bill Delivery Rules; SAP IS-U Bill Print Suppression; Oracle CC&B eBill

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the customer. Used for outage notifications, payment reminders, demand response alerts, and field crew coordination. Stored in E.164 international format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; TCPA; SAP IS-U BP Phone Number

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this customer profile was sourced. SAP_IS_U indicates SAP Industry Solution for Utilities; ORACLE_CCB indicates Oracle Utilities Customer Care and Billing; MANUAL indicates manually entered records; MIGRATION indicates records loaded during a system migration event. Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U; Oracle CC&B; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number for commercial/industrial customers (EIN) or individual taxpayer identification for sole proprietors. Used for 1099 reporting, tax exemption validation, and regulatory filings. Masked in analytics layer; full value retained in source CIS.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA Tax Number

attributes.name: third_party_data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has consented to sharing their energy usage and profile data with authorized third parties (e.g., solar installers, EV charging providers, energy management platforms) under Green Button Connect My Data or similar data access frameworks.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA §1798.100; Green Button Connect My Data Standard; NAESB REQ.21

products.name: premise
products.description: Master entity representing a physical service location (premise) where utility service is delivered. Captures premise address, premise type (residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural), GIS coordinates (latitude/longitude), service territory code, distribution feeder ID, transformer bank ID, meter socket count, premise classification (single-family, multi-family, high-rise, substation-fed), load profile class, climate zone, and premise construction year. SSOT for all premise-level metering, billing, and outage management references.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Premise / Oracle CC&B Premise / Esri ArcGIS Utility Network Service Location

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the physical service location (premise) within the utility's Customer Information System (CIS). Primary key for all premise-level metering, billing, and outage management references. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Premise Object; Oracle CC&B Premise Entity

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Premises must be assigned to balancing authority control areas for load forecasting, interchange scheduling, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and NERC compliance reporting. Essential for operati

attributes.name: distribution_feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution feeder circuit supplying power to the premise, as modeled in the utility's Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) and GIS. Critical for outage management, load balancing, Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR), and Volt-VAR optimization in GE PowerOn ADMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; NERC FAC-001/FAC-002 Facility Standards

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution substation supplying the feeder that serves this premise. Used for hierarchical network topology analysis, outage impact scoping, and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; NERC TPL Transmission Planning Standards

attributes.name: distribution_transformer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution transformer bank serving the premise, as recorded in the utility's asset management system (Ventyx Asset Suite) and GIS. Used for transformer loading analysis, outage impact assessment, and asset maintenance planning.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; IEEE C57 Transformer Standards

attributes.name: forecast_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.zone. Business justification: Premises must be mapped to forecast zones for distribution load planning, capacity requirement allocation, outage impact analysis, and DER penetration forecasting. Essential for translating zone-level

attributes.name: meter_reading_route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the meter reading route to which the premise is assigned for field meter reading operations. Used for route optimization, meter reader scheduling, and AMI walk-by/drive-by reading coordination in Oracle Utilities MDM.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM Meter Reading Route; SAP IS-U Meter Reading Order

attributes.name: network_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.network_segment. Business justification: Premises are physically connected to a specific network segment, essential for outage impact scoping, hosting capacity assessment for DER interconnection, and FLISR topology modeling. Distribution eng

attributes.name: pnode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.pnode. Business justification: Transmission-connected premises (served at high voltage) are mapped to a pnode for load forecasting, LMP settlement, and demand response dispatch in RTO/ISO markets. Load research and grid planning re

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.service_territory. Business justification: Premise-level service territory assignment is foundational for reliability reporting (SAIDI/SAIFI), outage management zone routing, and rate schedule eligibility. Distribution planners and regulators

attributes.name: ami_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise is eligible for Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) smart meter deployment based on infrastructure readiness, service voltage, and utility AMI rollout program criteria. Drives meter deployment prioritization in Oracle Utilities MDM.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM AMI Deployment; DOE Smart Grid Investment Grant Standards; State PUC AMI Deployment Orders

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle to which the premise is assigned, determining meter reading schedule and bill generation frequency. Sourced from SAP IS-U Billing Cycle or Oracle CC&B Bill Cycle configuration.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Cycle; Oracle CC&B Bill Cycle; State PUC Billing Frequency Rules

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Detailed structural classification of the premise beyond the high-level premise type. Used for load profile modeling, infrastructure planning, and demand response program eligibility. Examples: single-family, multi-family, high-rise, substation-fed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_family|multi_family|high_rise|substation_fed|mobile_home|commercial_strip|warehouse|manufacturing|farm — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Premise Classification; SAP IS-U Premise Category Detail

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Climate zone designation assigned to the premise based on geographic location and DOE/ASHRAE climate classification. Used for energy efficiency program targeting, demand response (DR) program design, Integrated Resource Planning (IRP), and Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance analysis.
attributes.references: DOE Building Energy Codes; ASHRAE 90.1 Climate Zone Map; State PUC Energy Efficiency Program Rules

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year the premise structure was originally constructed. Used for energy efficiency program eligibility assessment, weatherization program targeting, load profile modeling, and infrastructure age analysis. Sourced from county assessor records or customer-provided data.
attributes.references: DOE Weatherization Assistance Program; State PUC Energy Efficiency Program Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the premise record was first created in the source CIS system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Provides audit trail for data governance, regulatory compliance, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; NERC CIP-007 System Security Management; SAP IS-U Audit Log

attributes.name: critical_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise is designated as a critical facility (e.g., hospital, emergency services, water treatment plant, telecommunications hub) requiring priority restoration during outages. Drives outage management system (OMS) prioritization and mutual aid planning.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Critical Customer; NERC CIP Critical Infrastructure Protection; State PUC Critical Facility Designation Rules

attributes.name: der_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise has an active Distributed Energy Resource (DER) enrollment, including rooftop solar, battery storage, or other behind-the-meter (BTM) generation assets registered in the utility's Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). Supports Virtual Power Plant (VPP) aggregation and demand response programs.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222 DER Aggregation; State PUC DER Interconnection Rules; IEEE 1547; DERMS Integration Standards

attributes.name: ev_charging_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise has a registered electric vehicle (EV) charging installation. Used for distribution load forecasting, EV rate schedule eligibility, demand response program targeting, and grid modernization planning.
attributes.references: State PUC EV Rate Tariffs; DOE EV Infrastructure Standards; IEEE 2030.1.1 EV Charging Standards

attributes.name: floor_area_sqft
attributes.description: Total conditioned floor area of the premise structure in square feet. Used for energy intensity benchmarking (kWh per square foot), energy efficiency program eligibility, demand response capacity estimation, and load profile normalization.
attributes.references: DOE Commercial Buildings Energy Consumption Survey (CBECS); EPA ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager

attributes.name: gis_parcel_reference
attributes.description: Assessor's parcel number or GIS parcel identifier linking the premise to the county tax assessor's spatial parcel layer in Esri ArcGIS Utility Network. Enables land-use analysis, property boundary correlation, and infrastructure planning.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; County Assessor Parcel Standards

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent utility field inspection of the premise's service entrance, metering equipment, or electrical infrastructure. Used for compliance tracking, safety program management, and asset maintenance scheduling in Ventyx Asset Suite.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Electrical Safety Standards; State PUC Safety Inspection Requirements; Ventyx Asset Suite Inspection Records

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the premise record in the source CIS system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance per SOX and NERC CIP requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; NERC CIP-007; SAP IS-U Change Document; Oracle CC&B Audit Log

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the physical service location as recorded in the utility's Geographic Information System (GIS). Used for outage management spatial analysis, field crew routing, and distribution network modeling in Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standards

attributes.name: life_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a registered life-support equipment user resides at the premise. Triggers disconnection protection, priority outage notification, and special field crew protocols per state PUC regulations. Distinct from medical_baseline_flag which governs billing treatment.
attributes.references: State PUC Life Support Equipment Rules; CPUC General Order 111-G; Oracle CC&B Life Support Configuration

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the premise within the utility's service portfolio. Drives eligibility for new service connections, billing activation, and outage management inclusion. Active premises are energized and receiving service; decommissioned premises have been permanently removed from service.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Premise Status; Oracle CC&B Premise Status

attributes.name: load_profile_class
attributes.description: Utility-assigned load profile class code used to model the premise's expected energy consumption pattern for billing, forecasting, and settlement purposes. Applied to non-interval-metered customers for load research and wholesale market settlement. Sourced from Oracle Utilities MDM or SAP IS-U.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM Load Profile; NERC Load Forecasting Standards; FERC Settlement Procedures

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the physical service location as recorded in the utility's Geographic Information System (GIS). Used in conjunction with latitude for spatial analysis, outage polygon mapping, and DER interconnection planning.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standards

attributes.name: medical_baseline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise has a registered medical baseline allowance due to a life-support or medical necessity condition. Triggers special billing treatment, outage notification priority, and disconnection protection protocols per state PUC regulations.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Tariff Rules; CPUC Rule 11 (California); Oracle CC&B Medical Baseline Configuration

attributes.name: meter_socket_count
attributes.description: Number of meter sockets (meter points) installed at the premise. Multi-socket premises include multi-family dwellings, commercial complexes, and industrial facilities with multiple service points. Drives meter deployment planning in Oracle Utilities MDM and SAP IS-U Device Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Device Management; ANSI C12.1 Electric Meters Standards

attributes.name: nem_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise is eligible for Net Energy Metering (NEM) based on service territory rules, interconnection capacity, and applicable state PUC tariff provisions. Supports Distributed Energy Resource (DER) enrollment and behind-the-meter (BTM) generation tracking.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff Rules; FERC PURPA; IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard; SAP IS-U NEM Configuration

attributes.name: num_units
attributes.description: Number of individual dwelling or tenant units within the premise. Applicable to multi-family, high-rise, and mixed-use premises. Used for per-unit load analysis, master-metered billing allocation, and demand response program enrollment capacity.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Multi-Unit Premise Configuration; SAP IS-U Premise Unit Count

attributes.name: peak_demand_kw
attributes.description: Recorded or estimated peak electrical demand in kilowatts (kW) for the premise. Used for transformer sizing, distribution capacity planning, demand charge billing, and demand response (DR) program baseline establishment. Sourced from Oracle Utilities MDM interval data or SAP IS-U demand registers.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Demand Register; NERC Load Forecasting; State PUC Demand Charge Tariffs

attributes.name: premise_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the premise as assigned by the utility's CIS (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Used in field operations, customer correspondence, and cross-system integration. Corresponds to SAP IS-U Premise Number or Oracle CC&B Premise ID.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Premise Number; Oracle Utilities CC&B Premise Identifier

attributes.name: premise_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the premise by customer segment and land use. Drives rate schedule eligibility, load profile assignment, and regulatory reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|commercial|industrial|agricultural|municipal|mixed_use — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; EIA-861 Customer Class Definitions; SAP IS-U Premise Category

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which utility service was permanently terminated at the premise (e.g., demolition, decommissioning). Null for active premises. Used for premise lifecycle management and historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Connection Object; Oracle CC&B Premise Deactivation; State PUC Service Termination Rules

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which utility service was first activated at the premise. Establishes the premise's service history baseline for billing, regulatory reporting, and infrastructure age analysis.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Connection Object; Oracle CC&B Premise Service Start; State PUC Service Commencement Rules

attributes.name: service_voltage_class
attributes.description: Nominal voltage class at which electric service is delivered to the premise. Determines applicable tariff rate schedule, metering configuration, and interconnection requirements. Critical for rate design and OATT compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: secondary_120v|secondary_240v|primary_4kv|primary_12kv|primary_25kv|transmission — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC OATT; State PUC Rate Schedules; IEEE C84.1 Voltage Standards; ANSI C12.1

attributes.name: tou_rate_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise qualifies for Time of Use (TOU) or Critical Peak Pricing (CPP) rate schedules based on metering capability (AMI), service class, and applicable PUC tariff provisions. Drives rate schedule assignment and customer enrollment workflows.
attributes.references: State PUC TOU/CPP Tariff Schedules; Oracle CC&B Rate Schedule Eligibility; SAP IS-U Rate Determination

products.name: customer_service_agreement
products.description: Master entity representing the contractual service agreement between a utility and a customer account for a specific premise and rate schedule. Captures agreement start and end dates, rate schedule code, service type (electric, gas, water), TOU plan assignment, budget billing flag, auto-pay flag, paperless billing flag, deposit amount, deposit waiver reason, and agreement status. References NEM agreement type and DER interconnection ID as contractual entitlements (detailed program participation attributes are managed in enrollment). Sourced from SAP IS-U Contract and Oracle CC&B Service Agreement. SSOT for rate schedule assignment and service entitlement at the account-premise level.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Contract / Oracle CC&B Service Agreement

attributes.name: customer_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer service agreement. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_service_agreement. Business justification: The CIS service agreement and billing service agreement are the two sides of the same utility service contract — CIS owns the customer/premise relationship while billing owns the financial terms. This

attributes.name: primary_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that holds this service agreement.

attributes.name: primary_customer_premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical premise where service is delivered under this agreement.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Installation / Oracle CC&B Service Point

attributes.name: rate_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rate_case. Business justification: A customer service agreement's rate schedule and contract terms are established by a specific commission-approved rate case. Linking CSA to rate_case enables regulatory compliance verification, rate c

attributes.name: rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.rate_schedule. Business justification: The service agreement is the contractual instrument binding a customer to a specific tariff. Rate schedule assignment on the service agreement drives billing determinant selection, regulatory tariff c

attributes.name: service_delivery_asset_registry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Delivery Asset Registry Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: Service agreements reference specific service delivery assets (transformer, switchgear) for capacity allocation, load management, and contract demand enforcement. Required for distribution capacity pl

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.service_point. Business justification: A customer service agreement governs service delivery at a specific service point. Utilities use CSA-to-service-point for service activation, billing configuration, and regulatory reporting of active

attributes.name: trading_ppa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.ppa. Business justification: A customer service agreement for solar/NEM/community solar customers is governed by a trading-domain PPA defining price, term, and delivery terms. Role-prefix 'trading_' distinguishes this from the ex

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service agreement. Draft indicates agreement is being prepared; pending approval awaiting credit or regulatory review; active means service is being delivered; suspended for temporary service interruption; terminated for completed agreements; cancelled for agreements that never went active.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Status / Oracle CC&B Service Agreement Status

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service agreement. Standard represents typical utility service; NEM (Net Energy Metering) for customers with behind-the-meter generation; DER interconnection for Distributed Energy Resource participants; community solar for shared renewable programs; green tariff for voluntary renewable energy purchase; special contract for negotiated large customer agreements.
attributes.references: PURPA / State PUC Net Metering Rules

attributes.name: auto_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment is enabled for this service agreement, allowing bills to be paid automatically from customer bank account or credit card.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Billing cycle assignment determining when meter reads occur and bills are generated. Typically represents a monthly cycle number (e.g., cycle 01 reads on 1st of month, cycle 15 reads on 15th).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Schedule / Oracle CC&B Bill Cycle

attributes.name: budget_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is enrolled in budget billing program, which averages annual usage to provide consistent monthly payment amounts.

attributes.name: care_program_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Alternate Rates for Energy (CARE) Program Flag
attributes.description: Indicates enrollment in CARE or similar low-income assistance program providing discounted rates. CARE is California-specific; other states have equivalent programs (e.g., LIHEAP).

attributes.name: contract_demand_kw
attributes.description: Contracted maximum demand in kilowatts (kW) for large commercial and industrial customers with demand-based rate schedules. Customer pays for this capacity regardless of actual usage. Null for non-demand customers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service agreement record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of security deposit held for this service agreement, typically required for customers with poor credit or no credit history. Null if no deposit required.

attributes.name: deposit_waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason why security deposit was waived if deposit amount is zero. Good credit for customers meeting credit score threshold; senior citizen, low income, or military for protected classes; prior customer for returning customers with good payment history; none if deposit was not waived.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when service agreement terminates and service delivery ends. Null for open-ended agreements. Populated when customer requests disconnection or agreement reaches contracted term end.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract End Date / Oracle CC&B Stop Date

attributes.name: life_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premise has registered life support or medical equipment requiring continuous electric service. Provides special protections against disconnection and priority restoration during outages.

attributes.name: load_profile_code
attributes.description: Statistical load profile classification used for non-interval metered customers to estimate hourly usage patterns for settlement and forecasting. Based on customer class and historical usage patterns.

attributes.name: master_metered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement covers master-metered service where a single meter serves multiple dwelling units (e.g., apartment building) and the property owner sub-meters or allocates costs to tenants.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service agreement record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: nem_agreement_type
attributes.description: Specific NEM (Net Energy Metering) program version if customer has behind-the-meter generation. NEM 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 represent California program generations; VNEM for virtual net metering; NEMBAT for NEM with battery storage. Not applicable for customers without generation.
attributes.references: CPUC NEM Tariff / State Net Metering Rules

attributes.name: paperless_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer has opted for electronic bill delivery instead of paper statements.

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer currently has an active payment arrangement or installment plan for past due balances.

attributes.name: power_factor_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum power factor (ratio of real to apparent power) required for large industrial customers. Typically 0.90 or higher. Customers below threshold may incur penalties. Null for customers without power factor requirements.

attributes.name: seasonal_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a seasonal service agreement (e.g., vacation home, agricultural operation) with predictable periods of no usage and special billing rules.

attributes.name: service_class
attributes.description: Customer segment classification for regulatory reporting and rate design. Residential for households; commercial for businesses; industrial for manufacturing; agricultural for farms; municipal for government facilities; street lighting for public infrastructure.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 / State PUC Customer Class Definitions

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of utility commodity delivered under this agreement. Electric for electricity service; gas for natural gas; water for potable water; steam and chilled water for district energy systems.

attributes.name: service_voltage_level
attributes.description: Voltage level at which electric service is delivered. Secondary for residential/small commercial (120/240V); primary for larger commercial (4-35kV); subtransmission (35-138kV); transmission for industrial customers (>138kV). Null for non-electric services.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this service agreement was sourced. SAP IS-U for SAP Industry Solution for Utilities; Oracle CC&B for Oracle Customer Care and Billing; legacy CIS for older customer information systems being migrated.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this service agreement in the source operational system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting integration issues.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when service agreement becomes effective and service delivery begins. Corresponds to service turn-on date for new customers or agreement renewal date for existing customers.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Start Date / Oracle CC&B Start Date

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for service agreement termination.
