Customer request for voluntary disconnection; move out when customer relocates; non-payment for involuntary disconnection; death of account holder; foreclosure for property repossession; service transfer when service moves to new account; contract expiration for fixed-term agreements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|move_out|non_payment|death|foreclosure|service_transfer|contract_expiration — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: third_party_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer has designated a third party (family member, social worker, advocate) to receive copies of disconnection notices and other critical communications.

attributes.name: tou_plan_code
attributes.description: Specific TOU (Time of Use) pricing plan code if the rate schedule includes time-differentiated pricing. Defines peak, off-peak, and shoulder period pricing structures.

products.name: contact
products.description: Master entity capturing all contact points and notification preferences associated with a customer profile or account. Stores contact type (primary, billing, emergency, authorized third party), contact channel (phone, email, SMS, postal mail, push notification), contact value (phone number, email address), opt-in/opt-out status per channel, contact verification status, preferred contact time window, contact role (account holder, co-applicant, property manager, landlord), and notification preferences including notification type (outage, billing alert, payment reminder, DR event, regulatory), preferred notification channel, notification frequency, quiet hours, and language preference. Supports multi-channel engagement tracking, AMI outage notification, OMS customer alerting, and demand response event dispatch within CIS platforms.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Business Partner Contact / Oracle CC&B Contact

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contact_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service account associated with this contact. Supports account-level contact management for multi-account customers.

attributes.name: contact_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer profile or account to which this contact belongs. Links contact to customer master entity in CIS (SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B).

attributes.name: postal_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Contact has embedded postal address fields that should be normalized to reference the address table. The contact table has postal_address_line1, postal_address_line2, postal_city, postal_state_provinc

attributes.name: to_account_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.account.account_id — Some contacts are account-level (billing contact, emergency contact) rather than profile-level. Required for account-specific notification routing.

attributes.name: to_profile_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.profile.profile_id — Contact points belong to a customer profile. contact.profile_id → profile.profile_id. Essential for multi-channel engagement.

attributes.name: bounce_count
attributes.description: Number of failed delivery attempts (email bounces, SMS failures, undeliverable mail) for this contact. High bounce counts trigger contact verification workflows.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary communication channel or medium for this contact point. Determines delivery method for notifications and alerts.

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: Specific role or relationship of the contact to the account holder. Defines authorization level for account actions and information access.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Determines whether the contact is eligible for notifications and communications.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact role within the customer relationship. Determines contact authority and notification eligibility.

attributes.name: contact_value
attributes.description: The actual contact information value (phone number, email address, postal address, device token). Format varies by contact_channel. Classified as restricted PII.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was first created in the CIS system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact record expires or is no longer valid for communications. Null indicates an open-ended contact.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact record becomes active and eligible for use in communications.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic communication. Used for billing statements, outage alerts, DR (Demand Response) event notifications, and regulatory communications.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the customers preferred language for communications through this contact channel.

attributes.name: last_bounce_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent failed delivery attempt for this contact channel.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact channel was last successfully used for customer communication. Supports contact hygiene and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: notification_frequency
attributes.description: Preferred frequency for non-critical notifications through this contact channel. Critical alerts (outages, safety) are always sent in real-time.

attributes.name: notification_preference_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive billing alerts and payment reminders through this contact channel.

attributes.name: notification_preference_dr_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive DR event dispatch notifications through this contact channel. Supports demand response program participation.
attributes.references: CIS (Customer Information System) Business Rules, FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: notification_preference_marketing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive marketing communications, promotional offers, and energy efficiency program information through this contact channel.
attributes.references: CIS (Customer Information System) Business Rules, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: notification_preference_outage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive outage notifications through this contact channel. Supports OMS (Outage Management System) alerting.

attributes.name: notification_preference_regulatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive regulatory notices and compliance communications through this contact channel. Some regulatory notices are mandatory regardless of preference.
attributes.references: CIS (Customer Information System) Business Rules, PUC (Public Utility Commission) Requirements

attributes.name: opt_in_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer provided consent to receive communications through this contact channel.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act), CAN-SPAM Act, GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: opt_in_status
attributes.description: Customer consent status for receiving communications through this contact channel. Supports TCPA and CAN-SPAM compliance.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act), CAN-SPAM Act, GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer withdrew consent or unsubscribed from communications through this contact channel.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act), CAN-SPAM Act, GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for voice contact. Supports outage notifications, billing alerts, and customer service callbacks.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the customers preferred contact method for general communications. True if preferred, False otherwise.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time_end
attributes.description: End time of the customers preferred contact window in HH:MM format (24-hour). Used for outbound calls and scheduled notifications.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time_start
attributes.description: Start time of the customers preferred contact window in HH:MM format (24-hour). Used for outbound calls and scheduled notifications.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of this contact within the customers contact list. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for cascading notification logic.

attributes.name: quiet_hours_end
attributes.description: End time of the do-not-disturb period in HH:MM format (24-hour). Notifications resume after quiet hours end.

attributes.name: quiet_hours_start
attributes.description: Start time of the do-not-disturb period in HH:MM format (24-hour). Notifications are suppressed during quiet hours unless critical.

attributes.name: sms_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for SMS text message notifications. Supports real-time outage alerts, payment reminders, and DR event dispatch.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system or channel where this contact record was created or last updated. Supports data lineage and multi-channel integration.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the contact information was last successfully verified by the customer.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact information has been validated through confirmation process (email click, SMS reply, phone verification).

products.name: address
products.description: Master entity representing a standardized postal address used for billing, mailing, or service delivery. Captures address line 1 and 2, city, state/province, postal code, country, address type (service, mailing, billing, third-party notification), USPS validation status, USPS standardized form, geocode latitude/longitude, census tract, and address effective date. Supports address normalization and deduplication across CIS and GIS systems.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Address / Oracle CC&B Address / Esri ArcGIS Address

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.premise.premise_id — Service addresses are associated with premises. address.premise_id → premise.premise_id (for service address type). Critical for GIS integration and field operations.

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.service_territory. Business justification: Address-level service territory assignment is required for new service eligibility checks, outage management zone routing, and regulatory jurisdiction determination. Utility GIS and CIS systems formal

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address: active (in use), inactive (not currently used), pending_validation (awaiting verification), retired (no longer valid), or seasonal (used only during specific periods).

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of address usage: service (physical service delivery location), mailing (correspondence destination), billing (invoice destination), third_party_notification (authorized third-party contact), premise (metered location), or correspondence (general communication).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Business Partner Address Types

attributes.name: carrier_route_code
attributes.description: USPS carrier route code identifying the mail delivery route for this address.

attributes.name: census_block_group
attributes.description: US Census Bureau block group identifier for granular demographic and socioeconomic analysis.

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: US Census Bureau tract identifier for demographic analysis, regulatory reporting, and low-income program eligibility (e.g., LIHEAP, energy assistance programs).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the address.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: County or parish name for regulatory jurisdiction, tax district assignment, and Public Utility Commission (PUC) reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_point_barcode
attributes.description: USPS Delivery Point Barcode (DPBC) for automated mail sorting and delivery accuracy.

attributes.name: distribution_planning_area
attributes.description: Distribution system planning zone or district for load forecasting, capacity planning, and Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) analysis.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this address ceased to be effective. Null for currently active addresses.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this address became effective and available for use in customer service agreements and billing.

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of geocoding: rooftop (exact building), parcel (property boundary), street (street segment), zip_centroid (postal code center), city_centroid (city center), or unknown (not geocoded).

attributes.name: geocode_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for GIS integration and outage management. Supports spatial analysis and proximity calculations.

attributes.name: geocode_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for GIS integration and outage management. Supports spatial analysis and proximity calculations.

attributes.name: gis_feature_reference
attributes.description: Geographic Information System (GIS) feature identifier linking this address to the utility network model in Esri ArcGIS or equivalent GIS platform.

attributes.name: is_primary_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary address for the associated customer or premise. True if primary, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_seasonal_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is used seasonally (e.g., vacation homes, seasonal businesses). True if seasonal, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and street type (e.g., 123 Main Street).

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, unit, building, floor, or other location identifiers.

attributes.name: municipality_name
attributes.description: Incorporated city, town, or municipal district name for franchise agreement tracking and local regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: outage_management_zone
attributes.description: Outage Management System (OMS) zone identifier for outage tracking, crew dispatch, and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculation.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address. Supports 5-digit, ZIP+4, and international postal code formats.

attributes.name: seasonal_end_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal occupancy typically ends. Null for non-seasonal addresses.

attributes.name: seasonal_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal occupancy typically begins. Null for non-seasonal addresses.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Source system or application that created or maintains this address record (e.g., SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B, GIS, MDM).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this address in the source system of record. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code (e.g., CA for California, ON for Ontario).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles). Used for Time of Use (TOU) rate scheduling and Demand Response (DR) event timing.

attributes.name: usps_standardized_address
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Postal Service (USPS) Standardized Address
attributes.description: USPS-standardized full address string in CASS-certified format for delivery accuracy.

attributes.name: usps_validation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Postal Service (USPS) Validation Status
attributes.description: Status of USPS address validation: validated (confirmed by USPS), invalid (rejected by USPS), not_validated (not yet checked), corrected (USPS suggested correction applied), or ambiguous (multiple matches found).

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was last verified or validated through USPS, field inspection, or customer confirmation.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the address: usps_api (USPS web service), field_inspection (physical site visit), customer_confirmation (customer-provided), gis_validation (GIS system match), or third_party_service (external validation service).

products.name: account_premise_link
products.description: Association entity and SSOT for all relationships between customer accounts and premises, including active service relationships, landlord-tenant relationships, and property management roles. Stores link start date, link end date, link type (primary service, secondary service, landlord-of-record, property manager, master-metered tenant), landlord account reference, tenant account reference, move-in/move-out order references, vacancy billing flag, notification authorization flag, and link status. Enables historical tracking of which accounts have been served at a given premise, supports premise-to-account resolution for outage notifications and field operations, manages multi-family residential and commercial property management scenarios, and tracks landlord-tenant billing and notification workflows. SSOT for all account-to-premise and landlord-tenant relationship data.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Connection Object / Oracle CC&B Account-Premise Relationship

attributes.name: account_premise_link_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account-premise relationship record. Primary key for the account_premise_link entity.

attributes.name: customer_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal service agreement governing this account-premise relationship. Links to the contract or service agreement entity.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Account, Oracle CC&B Service Agreement

attributes.name: forwarding_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the forwarding address for final bill delivery and correspondence after account-premise relationship termination. Used in move-out processing.

attributes.name: primary_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this premise. Links to the account entity in the Customer Information System (CIS).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Business Partner, Oracle CC&B Account

attributes.name: primary_account_move_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service order that initiated this account-premise relationship. Links to the move-in or service connection order.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Service Order, Oracle CC&B Field Activity

attributes.name: primary_account_premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service premise associated with this account. Links to the premise entity representing the physical service location.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Installation, Oracle CC&B Service Point

attributes.name: tertiary_tenant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant account when this link represents a landlord-of-record relationship. Used to track tenant accounts associated with a landlord premise. Null for non-landlord relationships.

attributes.name: to_premise_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.premise.premise_id — The association entity must reference the premise it links. account_premise_link.premise_id → premise.premise_id.

attributes.name: billing_responsibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account has billing responsibility for the premise. In master-metered or landlord scenarios, multiple accounts may be linked to a premise but only one has billing responsibility.

attributes.name: contact_preference
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for outage notifications and service alerts for this account-premise relationship. Used by OMS and customer engagement systems.

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Security deposit amount collected for this account-premise relationship. Null if no deposit was required. Expressed in local currency.

attributes.name: deposit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a security deposit was required for this account-premise relationship based on credit classification and service territory regulations.

attributes.name: der_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account-premise relationship is enrolled in a Distributed Energy Resource (DER) program such as demand response, virtual power plant, or distributed generation program.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222, State PUC DER Programs

attributes.name: final_bill_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a final bill has been issued for this account-premise relationship upon termination. Used in move-out and service disconnection workflows.

attributes.name: link_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account-premise link record was first created in the Customer Information System (CIS). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: link_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the account-premise relationship was terminated. Represents move-out date or service disconnection date. Null for active relationships.

attributes.name: link_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account-premise link record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking in customer relationship management.

attributes.name: link_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding this account-premise relationship. Used by customer service representatives to document special circumstances, arrangements, or historical context.

attributes.name: link_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the account-premise relationship became effective. Represents move-in date or service initiation date for the account at this premise.

attributes.name: link_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account-premise relationship. Indicates whether the link is currently in effect or has been terminated.

attributes.name: link_termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for termination of the account-premise relationship. Provides business context for why the link was ended. Null for active relationships.

attributes.name: link_type
attributes.description: Classification of the relationship between the account and premise. Defines the role and responsibility of the account holder at the service location.

attributes.name: master_metered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship involves a master-metered configuration where a single meter serves multiple tenant accounts. Common in multi-family residential and commercial properties.

attributes.name: nem_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account-premise relationship involves a Net Energy Metering (NEM) participant with Behind the Meter (BTM) generation. Used to identify customers with distributed energy resources.
attributes.references: FERC Net Metering Policy, State PUC NEM Tariffs

attributes.name: notification_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder has authorized receipt of outage notifications and service alerts for this premise. Used by Outage Management System (OMS) for customer communication.

attributes.name: occupancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the occupancy status for this account-premise relationship. Indicates whether the account holder is an owner, tenant, or if the premise is vacant.

attributes.name: priority_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of this account-premise link when multiple accounts are associated with a single premise. Used to determine primary contact for outage notifications and field operations.

attributes.name: property_management_company_code
attributes.description: Reference to the property management company responsible for this premise when the link type is property manager. Used in commercial and multi-family property management scenarios.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record that originated this account-premise link. Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: Original primary key or unique identifier from the source system. Used for data reconciliation and bidirectional synchronization with operational systems.

attributes.name: vacancy_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vacancy billing is active for this account-premise relationship. When true, the landlord or property manager is billed for usage during tenant vacancy periods.

products.name: credit_profile
products.description: Master entity capturing the credit classification and financial risk attributes of a customer account as managed within the CIS. Stores credit class code (excellent, good, fair, poor, new), credit score band, deposit requirement flag, deposit amount, deposit type (cash, surety bond, letter of credit), deposit waiver reason, credit review date, number of late payments in rolling 12 months, disconnection history count, bankruptcy flag, low-income program enrollment flag, and collections stage. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA credit management and Oracle CC&B credit configuration. Used by billing and collections domains for deposit calculation, disconnection eligibility, and payment arrangement qualification.
products.reference: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Management / Oracle CC&B Credit Profile

attributes.name: credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit profile record. Primary key for the credit profile entity.

attributes.name: primary_credit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account to which this credit profile applies. Links credit assessment to the billing account in CIS (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Contract Account; Oracle CC&B Account

attributes.name: to_account_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.account.account_id — Credit classification is assessed per account. credit_profile.account_id → account.account_id.

attributes.name: average_monthly_payment_amount
attributes.description: Average monthly payment amount over the past 12 months. Used for deposit calculation and payment arrangement sizing.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Payment History Analysis

attributes.name: bankruptcy_discharge_date
attributes.description: Date the bankruptcy was discharged or dismissed. Credit profile may be eligible for upgrade after discharge and demonstration of payment performance.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Bankruptcy Code

attributes.name: bankruptcy_filing_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent bankruptcy filing. Used to determine if bankruptcy is still active and impacts credit classification duration.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Bankruptcy Code

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has an active or recent bankruptcy filing. Impacts collections strategy and may trigger automatic deposit requirement per PUC rules.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); SAP IS-U FICA Bankruptcy Indicator

attributes.name: broken_arrangement_count
attributes.description: Number of payment arrangements that were broken (customer failed to make scheduled payments). Impacts future payment arrangement eligibility and credit classification.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Installment Plan Compliance; Oracle CC&B Payment Plan History

attributes.name: collections_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the collections process for past-due balances. Drives automated dunning notices, disconnection scheduling, and external collections referral. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: current|reminder|final_notice|disconnection_pending|disconnected|write_off|legal_action — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Collections Management; Oracle CC&B Collections Process

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was first created in the CIS. Required for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Audit Trail; Oracle CC&B Audit Log

attributes.name: credit_class_code
attributes.description: Credit classification code assigned to the customer account based on payment history, credit score, and risk assessment. Determines deposit requirements and collection strategies.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Management; Oracle CC&B Credit Configuration

attributes.name: credit_freeze_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has placed a credit freeze with the credit bureaus, preventing external credit checks. Requires manual credit assessment process.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Credit Freeze Regulations

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance allowed before service disconnection or additional deposit requirement is triggered. Based on credit class and deposit on file.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Limit Configuration; State PUC Credit Rules

attributes.name: credit_profile_status
attributes.description: Current status of the credit profile record. Active profiles are used for deposit and collections decisions; under_review profiles are pending credit reassessment.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Management; Oracle CC&B Credit Configuration

attributes.name: credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent credit review or reassessment. Credit profiles are typically reviewed annually or upon significant payment events (late payments, disconnection, bankruptcy).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Review Process; Oracle CC&B Credit Review

attributes.name: credit_score_band
attributes.description: Credit score range band obtained from external credit bureau (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion). Used for initial credit classification and deposit determination.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FICO Score Ranges

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Security deposit amount required from the customer, typically calculated as 2-3 months of estimated billing. Null if no deposit is required.
attributes.references: State PUC Deposit Calculation Rules; SAP IS-U FICA Deposit

attributes.name: deposit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a security deposit is required for this account based on credit classification and PUC regulations.
attributes.references: State PUC Deposit Regulations; SAP IS-U Deposit Management

attributes.name: deposit_type
attributes.description: Type of security deposit instrument held for the account. Cash deposits are held in trust accounts; surety bonds and letters of credit are third-party guarantees.
attributes.references: State PUC Deposit Regulations; SAP IS-U Deposit Types

attributes.name: deposit_waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for waiving the security deposit requirement. Regulatory exemptions include low-income program enrollment, medical necessity, and senior citizen status per PUC rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: excellent_credit|existing_customer|low_income_program|senior_citizen|medical_necessity|regulatory_exemption|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State PUC Deposit Waiver Rules; Low-Income Program Regulations

attributes.name: disconnection_history_count
attributes.description: Total number of service disconnections for non-payment in the account history. Indicates chronic payment issues and impacts credit classification.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Disconnection History; Oracle CC&B Service Orders

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date this credit profile became effective. Credit profiles are versioned; this date marks the start of this version's validity period.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Management; Oracle CC&B Credit Configuration

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date this credit profile version expires or is superseded by a new version. Null for the current active credit profile.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Management; Oracle CC&B Credit Configuration

attributes.name: external_credit_bureau
attributes.description: Credit bureau used to obtain the credit score and credit report for this customer. Required for FCRA compliance and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Credit Bureau Integration

attributes.name: external_credit_check_date
attributes.description: Date the external credit bureau check was performed. Credit checks are typically performed at account establishment and periodically for high-risk accounts.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); SAP IS-U Credit Bureau Integration

attributes.name: highest_past_due_amount
attributes.description: Highest past-due balance amount in the account history. Indicates maximum payment risk exposure and informs deposit amount calculation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Receivables History; Oracle CC&B Aging Analysis

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this credit profile record. Tracks credit reassessments, manual overrides, and system updates.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Audit Trail; Oracle CC&B Audit Log

attributes.name: late_payment_count_12m
attributes.description: Number of late payments (payments received after due date) in the rolling 12-month period. Key metric for credit class downgrade and disconnection eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Payment History; Oracle CC&B Collections

attributes.name: low_income_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is enrolled in a low-income assistance program (LIHEAP, state-specific programs). Enrollment may waive deposit requirements and provide disconnection protections.
attributes.references: LIHEAP Regulations; State PUC Low-Income Programs

attributes.name: manual_override_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the credit management staff member who performed the manual override. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; SAP IS-U User Audit Trail

attributes.name: manual_override_date
attributes.description: Date the manual credit classification override was performed. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; SAP IS-U Audit Trail

attributes.name: manual_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credit classification was manually overridden by credit management staff. Overrides require supervisor approval and documented justification.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Management Workflow; Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: manual_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text justification for manual credit classification override. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic credit review. Typically set 12 months from the last review date or earlier if triggered by payment issues.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Review Schedule

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_count
attributes.description: Total number of payment arrangements or installment plans established for this account. Excessive arrangements may indicate chronic payment issues and impact credit classification.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Installment Plan History; Oracle CC&B Payment Plans

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is eligible for a payment arrangement or installment plan based on credit class, payment history, and PUC regulations.
attributes.references: State PUC Payment Arrangement Rules; SAP IS-U FICA Installment Plans

attributes.name: returned_payment_count_12m
attributes.description: Number of returned payments (NSF checks, ACH returns, declined credit cards) in the rolling 12-month period. Indicates payment reliability issues and may trigger deposit requirement.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Payment Processing; Oracle CC&B Payment History

products.name: segment
products.description: Reference entity defining market segmentation classifications applied to customer accounts for rate design, demand response targeting, regulatory reporting, and marketing programs. Captures segment code, segment name, segment tier (residential low-use, residential high-use, small commercial, medium commercial, large commercial, industrial, agricultural, municipal), load profile class, AMI penetration flag, DER adoption flag, EV ownership flag, segment effective date, and segment expiration date. Used by billing, demand response, and regulatory reporting domains to classify accounts for tariff application, program eligibility, and FERC/PUC reporting breakdowns.
products.reference: Oracle CC&B Customer Class / SAP IS-U Customer Group

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for segment

attributes.name: account_id

Stores complaint date, complaint type (billing dispute, service quality, outage response, disconnection, rate dispute, discrimination, safety), complaint source (customer direct, PUC referral, BBB, social media, legislative inquiry), assigned resolution owner, regulatory docket number, PUC/PSC case reference, resolution deadline, resolution date, resolution type (upheld, dismissed, settled, withdrawn), customer satisfaction outcome, and escalation tier. products.name: enrollment
products.description: Transactional entity and SSOT for all customer program participation across the utility. Captures enrollments in demand response (DR), time-of-use (TOU) rate plans, critical peak pricing (CPP) tariffs, budget billing, auto-pay, paperless billing, Net Energy Metering (NEM 1.0/2.0/3.0/NEM-ST) including interconnection application date, approval date, permission-to-operate date, installed capacity (kW-DC), inverter type, technology type (PV, wind, CHP), export compensation rate, annual true-up month, and cumulative export credits. Captures DER/VPP aggregation program enrollments including DER asset type (rooftop solar, battery storage, EV charger, smart thermostat, generator), DER registration ID, DERMS system reference, aggregator name, VPP program code, telemetry availability flag, communication protocol (IEEE 2030.5, OpenADR, Modbus), and dispatch authorization level. Captures medical baseline allowance certifications including certification type (life support, medical baseline allowance), qualifying condition, physician certification date, certification expiration, renewal reminder date, approved additional baseline kWh per day, and life-support equipment type (oxygen concentrator, dialysis, ventilator). Captures low-income assistance program enrollments (LIHEAP, CARE, FERA), green energy programs, EV charging incentive programs, and arrearage management plans. Stores program code, enrollment date, enrollment channel, enrollment status, effective start and end dates, opt-out date and reason, and all program-specific eligibility and technical attributes. Supports FERC Order 2222 compliance, PUC medical baseline tariff compliance, disconnection protection rules, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when customer eligibility was verified for the assistance program. [Moved from assistance_program: Verification date varies by enrollment instance based on when the customer submitted documentation.]

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_status

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer submitted or was enrolled in the program. Represents the principal business event date (application/enrollment action date), distinct from the effective start date when benefits begin.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the enrollment record. 'pending' = application submitted, awaiting approval; 'active' = currently participating; 'suspended' = temporarily paused (e.g., medical review); 'cancelled' = voluntarily withdrawn; 'expired' = past effective end date; 'rejected' = application denied.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment expires and requires re-certification or renewal. [Moved from assistance_program: Enrollment expiration is specific to each account-program enrollment, not to the program definition.]

attributes.name: export_compensation_rate

attributes.name: green_energy_percentage

attributes.name: household_size
attributes.description: Number of individuals in the customer household used for eligibility determination. [Moved from assistance_program: Household size is captured at enrollment time for eligibility determination and may change between recertifications, making it enrollment-specific.]

attributes.name: income_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer's income eligibility was last verified for low-income assistance programs (CARE, FERA, LIHEAP). Used for periodic re-certification compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: installed_capacity_kw_dc

attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; FERC Order 2222; IEEE 1547

attributes.name: interconnection_application_date

attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC Interconnection Rules; IEEE 1547

attributes.name: inverter_type

attributes.name: last_recertification_date

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: life_support_equipment_type

attributes.name: low_income_program

attributes.name: med_certification_type

attributes.name: medical_baseline

attributes.name: nem_participant

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the move order workflow. Pending: submitted but not yet processed. In_progress: actively being executed (meter read scheduled, field crew dispatched). Completed: service change fully effected. Cancelled: withdrawn before execution. Rejected: failed validation or business rules.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the service order: move_in (new service activation at a premise), move_out (service termination at a premise), transfer (simultaneous move-out and move-in for a change of occupant), reconnect (restoration of previously disconnected service), or disconnect (non-payment or voluntary disconnection). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: move_in|move_out|transfer|reconnect|disconnect — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: SAP IS-U EVER; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service; NAESB Retail Electric Provider standards

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: The tariff rate schedule code assigned to the new service account upon move-in or transfer. Determines the billing rate class (e.g., residential, small commercial, large industrial, TOU, CPP). Sourced from the applicable PUC-approved tariff.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Rate Management; Oracle CC&B Rates; State PUC tariff filings; FERC OATT

attributes.name: read_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the move-order meter read was obtained: actual (field technician physical read), estimated (calculated based on usage history when actual read is unavailable), AMI_remote (automated read via Advanced Metering Infrastructure), or customer_self_read (customer-reported reading).
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM VEE rules; SAP IS-U Device Management; State PUC metering standards

attributes.name: read_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the final_read_value. Typically kWh for electric meters, but may be therms, CCF, or MCF for gas service points. Ensures correct interpretation of the meter read value across commodity types.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management; Oracle Utilities MDM; ANSI C12.20; NAESB standards

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or exceptions associated with this move order. May include field crew instructions, customer-specific handling notes, or escalation details entered by customer service representatives.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: The date the customer requested the service change to take effect. This is the customer-stated desired effective date, which may differ from the actual effective date after scheduling and field execution.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U EVER; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service; State PUC service connection standards

attributes.name: scheduled_read_date
attributes.description: The date on which the meter read associated with this move order is scheduled to be performed. May differ from meter_read_date (actual read date) if the read is rescheduled or delayed. Used for field crew scheduling and MDM read request management.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Device Management; State PUC metering standards

attributes.name: service_class
attributes.description: Customer service classification at the time of the move order, determining applicable tariff, billing rules, and regulatory reporting category. Residential, small commercial, large commercial, industrial, agricultural, or lighting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Rate Management; Oracle CC&B Customer Class; State PUC tariff classifications; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this move order record was sourced. SAP_IS-U: SAP Industry Solution for Utilities. Oracle_CCB: Oracle Utilities Customer Care and Billing. Manual: entered directly into the data platform. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U; Oracle CC&B; Enterprise Data Governance standards

attributes.name: source_system_order_reference
attributes.description: The native primary key or order identifier from the originating operational system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Enables traceability back to the source system record for audit, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service; SOX audit trail requirements

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the move order was first submitted into the CIS system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Represents the principal business event timestamp for order creation. Used for SLA tracking and order aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this move order record was most recently modified in the Silver layer data store. Used for change data capture and incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007 audit logging requirements

domains.name: transmission
domains.description: High-voltage bulk power transmission network operations including substations, transmission lines, transformers, circuit breakers, ATC calculations, congestion management, OATT compliance, and interconnection with RTOs/ISOs. Manages transmission rights, FTR positions, power flow models, NERC reliability coordination, and FERC transmission reporting. Integrates with EMS and SCADA for real-time grid state.
domains.references: NERC FAC/TPL, FERC Order 890, IEC 61970 CIM

products.name: line
products.description: Master record for high-voltage bulk power transmission lines including overhead and underground circuits, with NERC-compliant facility ratings. Captures line identifier, voltage class (kV), circuit configuration, conductor type, thermal rating (MVA), length (miles/km), right-of-way corridor reference, ownership percentage, in-service date, operational status, and facility ratings (normal/emergency/load-dump ratings in MVA/A, seasonal variants for summer/winter/spring-fall, rating methodology, last review date, approving engineer). SSOT for transmission line physical characteristics, electrical parameters, and thermal limits used in power flow models, ATC calculations, real-time operations, and FERC OATT compliance.
products.reference: NERC FAC-001/FAC-002 Facility Rating

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for line

attributes.name: bes_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.bes_facility. Business justification: Transmission lines with nerc_bes_flag=true have a corresponding BES facility compliance record. Linking enables compliance teams to track BES designation status, inspection results, and compliance sta

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Transmission lines operate under a specific balancing authority/control area for AGC, ATC calculations, and NERC TOP-001 outage coordination. The rto_iso_region is a denormalized text reference; a dir

attributes.name: forecast_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.zone. Business justification: Transmission lines are physically located within forecast zones. Zonal load flow studies, ATC calculations, and congestion analysis require mapping lines to forecast zones. A transmission planning eng

attributes.name: line_transmission_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating (sending-end) substation for the transmission line. Used to define the line's position in the network topology for power flow models, ATC calculations, and NERC reliability studies. References the substation master record.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: BES-designated transmission lines (nerc_bes_flag=true) are subject to NERC FAC-001/FAC-002 facility rating obligations. Linking each line to its governing obligation supports compliance evidence colle

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: Transmission lines are capital assets requiring lifecycle tracking, depreciation, maintenance planning, and FERC regulatory reporting. Every utility tracks transmission lines in their asset registry f

attributes.name: to_substation_transmission_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the terminating (receiving-end) substation for the transmission line. Together with from_substation_id, defines the line's terminal nodes in the network model for power flow, contingency analysis, and OATT path definitions.

attributes.name: circuit_configuration
attributes.description: Physical circuit arrangement of the transmission line structure. Single-circuit lines carry one three-phase circuit; double-circuit lines carry two three-phase circuits on the same tower/structure. Affects contingency analysis (N-1, N-2), right-of-way utilization, and NERC TPL reliability planning studies.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transmission line successfully completed commissioning tests and was accepted for energization. Distinct from in_service_date (commercial operation); commissioning_date marks the technical acceptance milestone. Used in warranty tracking and asset lifecycle management in Ventyx Asset Suite.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; FERC Form 1; IEC 60909

attributes.name: conductor_size_kcmil
attributes.description: Cross-sectional area of the conductor expressed in thousand circular mils (kcmil), the North American standard unit for conductor sizing. Directly determines the conductor's current-carrying capacity and is a key input to IEEE Std 738 dynamic line rating calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 738; ASTM B232; NERC FAC-008

attributes.name: conductor_type
attributes.description: Designation of the conductor material and construction used on the transmission line (e.g., ACSR — Aluminum Conductor Steel Reinforced, ACCC — Aluminum Conductor Composite Core, AAAC — All Aluminum Alloy Conductor, HTLS — High-Temperature Low-Sag). Determines ampacity, sag characteristics, and thermal rating methodology per IEEE Std 738.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 738; ASTM B232; NERC FAC-008

attributes.name: conductors_per_phase
attributes.description: Number of sub-conductors per phase bundle (e.g., 1 = single, 2 = twin bundle, 3 = triple bundle, 4 = quad bundle). Bundled conductors are used on EHV lines to reduce corona discharge and increase ampacity. Affects thermal rating calculations and power flow model parameters.

attributes.name: emergency_rating_mva
attributes.description: Short-term emergency thermal rating of the transmission line in MVA, applicable for a defined duration (typically 15–30 minutes) following an N-1 contingency event. Used in contingency analysis, post-contingency corrective action planning, and NERC TPL reliability studies.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008; NERC TPL-001; IEEE Std 738

attributes.name: ferc_oatt_path_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERC Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT) Path Code
attributes.description: FERC OATT transmission path or flowgate code associated with this line, used in ATC/TTC calculations, transmission service requests, and congestion management. Links the physical line to the commercial transmission path definitions in the OATT tariff schedules.
attributes.references: FERC OATT; FERC Order 888; NAESB WEQ

attributes.name: gis_feature_code
attributes.description: Unique feature identifier for this transmission line in the Esri ArcGIS Utility Network geospatial system. Enables spatial joins for route mapping, right-of-way analysis, outage impact assessment, and integration with OMS/ADMS systems.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; FERC Form 715

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transmission line was energized and placed into commercial service. Used for asset age calculations, depreciation schedules in SAP S/4HANA, FERC Form 1 plant-in-service reporting, and NERC reliability model versioning.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; FERC OATT; NERC FAC-001; SOX

attributes.name: insulation_type
attributes.description: Type of electrical insulation used on the transmission line. For overhead lines, refers to insulator material (porcelain, glass, polymer). For underground/submarine cables, refers to cable insulation type (XLPE, PILC). Affects dielectric performance, maintenance intervals, and failure mode analysis.

attributes.name: length_km
attributes.description: Total route length of the transmission line in kilometers. Metric equivalent of length_miles for international reporting, IEC standard compliance, and cross-border interconnection documentation. Sourced from Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.

attributes.name: length_miles
attributes.description: Total route length of the transmission line in miles. Used in impedance calculations, line loss estimation, right-of-way cost allocation, FERC transmission rate base calculations, and O&M cost modeling. Sourced from Esri ArcGIS Utility Network spatial data.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; FERC OATT; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: line_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the transmission line within the utility's network and used in FERC OATT filings, NERC reliability models, and EMS/SCADA systems. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Sourced from GE PowerOn ADMS and Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; FERC Form 715; OATT Schedule 6

attributes.name: line_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the transmission line, typically referencing the from/to substations or geographic corridor (e.g., 'Northgate–Riverside 345kV'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Used in operational displays, FERC filings, and customer-facing interconnection documents.

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Physical construction type of the transmission line. Overhead lines use aerial conductors on towers/poles; underground lines use buried cables; submarine lines cross bodies of water. Determines applicable rating standards, maintenance practices, and outage restoration timelines.

attributes.name: load_dump_rating_mva
attributes.description: Extreme short-term (load dump) thermal rating in MVA, applicable for a very brief duration (typically 1–5 minutes) under extreme contingency conditions before protective relay action. Used in NERC TPL extreme event (P5–P7) analysis and system protection scheme design.

attributes.name: nerc_bes_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transmission line is classified as part of the NERC Bulk Electric System (BES), which subjects it to mandatory NERC reliability standards (CIP, FAC, TPL, MOD, etc.). Lines operating at ≥100 kV are generally BES-applicable. Critical for NERC compliance program scoping.
attributes.references: NERC BES Definition; NERC FAC-001; FERC Order 773

attributes.name: nerc_facility_rating_code
attributes.description: NERC-assigned or utility-assigned facility rating identifier used in NERC FAC-008 compliance documentation and transmission planning model submissions (NERC MOD-032). Links this line record to the formal facility rating study documentation.

attributes.name: normal_rating_amps
attributes.description: Continuous normal thermal rating expressed in amperes (A) per phase. Complements normal_rating_mva for use in protection relay settings, SCADA alarm thresholds in OSIsoft PI, and conductor temperature monitoring applications where current is the direct measured quantity.

attributes.name: normal_rating_mva
attributes.description: Continuous normal (steady-state) thermal rating of the transmission line in megavolt-amperes (MVA) under standard ambient conditions. This is the primary facility rating used in real-time operations, ATC calculations, and NERC FAC-008 compliance. Represents the maximum continuous loading without exceeding conductor temperature limits.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008; IEEE Std 738; FERC OATT

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transmission line. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Drives inclusion in power flow models, ATC calculations, and NERC reliability assessments. Sourced from GE PowerOn ADMS and Ventyx Asset Suite.

attributes.name: owner_entity_code
attributes.description: NERC-registered entity identifier (e.g., NERC Entity ID or DUNS number) of the primary owner/operator of the transmission line. Used in NERC reliability filings, FERC OATT compliance, and joint-ownership coordination. For lines with multiple owners, represents the operating owner.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; FERC OATT; NAESB WEQ

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the transmission line owned by this utility (0.00–100.00). Joint-ownership lines are common in the bulk power system. Drives rate base allocation in FERC OATT transmission rates, revenue requirement calculations, and co-owner settlement in OpenLink Endur.

attributes.name: pnode_code
attributes.description: RTO/ISO pricing node (PNode) identifier associated with the transmission line's terminal buses. Used in LMP (Locational Marginal Price) calculations, congestion cost allocation, FTR settlement, and energy trading position management in OpenLink Endur.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Tariff; NAESB WEQ

attributes.name: protection_scheme
attributes.description: Primary protection scheme applied to the transmission line (e.g., 'Distance-Zone 1-2-3', 'Pilot-POTT', 'Pilot-DCUB', 'Current Differential'). Critical for NERC PRC (Protection and Control) standard compliance, relay coordination studies, and system protection scheme documentation.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-001; NERC PRC-019; IEEE Std C37.113

attributes.name: rating_last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transmission line's facility ratings were most recently reviewed and validated by the approving engineer. NERC FAC-008 requires periodic review of facility ratings. Triggers re-review workflow in Ventyx Asset Suite when approaching the required review interval.

attributes.name: rating_methodology
attributes.description: Methodology used to determine the transmission line's thermal ratings. Static ratings use fixed conservative assumptions; dynamic line ratings (DLR) use real-time weather and conductor temperature data; ambient-adjusted ratings use seasonal ambient temperature corrections. Required disclosure under NERC FAC-008 and FERC Order 881 (ambient-adjusted ratings mandate).
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008; FERC Order 881; IEEE Std 738

attributes.name: reactance_ohms_per_mile
attributes.description: Positive-sequence inductive reactance of the transmission line in ohms per mile. Critical parameter for power flow models, short-circuit analysis, and distance protection relay settings. Used in NERC MOD-032 power flow base case models submitted to RTOs/ISOs.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transmission line master record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record-keeping under SOX and NERC CIP.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; FERC Record Retention

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transmission line master record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer, audit trail compliance under SOX, and detecting stale records in power flow model synchronization workflows.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; FERC Record Retention

attributes.name: resistance_ohms_per_mile
attributes.description: AC resistance of the transmission line conductor in ohms per mile at 50°C (or specified temperature). A fundamental electrical parameter used in power flow models (PSS/E, PowerWorld), line loss calculations, and impedance-based protection relay settings. Sourced from conductor manufacturer data sheets.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transmission line was or is planned to be permanently retired from service. Nullable for active lines. Used in asset lifecycle management (Ventyx Asset Suite), FERC Form 1 retirements reporting, IRP planning, and NERC model updates.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; NERC FAC-001; State PUC IRP Requirements

attributes.name: scada_tag_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Tag ID
attributes.description: SCADA system tag identifier for the transmission line's real-time telemetry point in OSIsoft PI historian. Used to retrieve real-time MW flow, MVAR flow, and current measurements for EMS state estimation, real-time ATC monitoring, and NERC reliability coordinator data exchange.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSIsoft PI; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: spring_fall_normal_rating_mva
attributes.description: Seasonal normal thermal rating for spring and fall shoulder seasons (typically March–May and September–November) in MVA. Used in seasonal ATC calculations and NERC seasonal assessments where a third seasonal rating is required.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008; FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Seasonal Rating Procedures

attributes.name: summer_normal_rating_mva
attributes.description: Seasonal normal thermal rating for summer conditions (typically June–August) in MVA, reflecting higher ambient temperatures that reduce conductor ampacity. Used in seasonal ATC calculations, summer peak planning, and NERC seasonal assessments submitted to RTOs/ISOs.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008; FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Seasonal Rating Procedures

attributes.name: susceptance_siemens_per_mile
attributes.description: Positive-sequence shunt susceptance (charging susceptance) of the transmission line in siemens per mile. Represents the line's capacitive charging current contribution, which is significant for long EHV lines. Used in power flow models, reactive power planning, and Volt-VAR optimization.

attributes.name: tower_structure_type
attributes.description: Type of supporting structure used for the overhead transmission line. Determines structural loading capacity, maintenance access requirements, storm vulnerability, and asset replacement cost estimates in Ventyx Asset Suite capital planning.
attributes.references: ASCE 74; IEEE Std 691; Ventyx Asset Suite

attributes.name: voltage_class
attributes.description: Standardized voltage class designation for the transmission line used in asset categorization, rate base segmentation, and FERC OATT rate zone assignment. Complements the precise voltage_kv field with a discrete classification bucket aligned to industry-standard voltage tiers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 69kV|115kV|138kV|161kV|230kV|345kV|500kV|765kV — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC OATT; NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std C57.12

attributes.name: voltage_kv
attributes.description: Nominal operating voltage of the transmission line in kilovolts (kV). Serves as the principal MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Determines voltage class (e.g., 115 kV, 230 kV, 345 kV, 500 kV, 765 kV), which governs thermal ratings, insulation requirements, and NERC bulk electric system (BES) applicability thresholds (≥100 kV).
attributes.references: NERC BES Definition; IEC 60038; IEEE Std 1110

attributes.name: winter_normal_rating_mva
attributes.description: Seasonal normal thermal rating for winter conditions (typically December–February) in MVA, reflecting lower ambient temperatures that increase conductor ampacity. Used in seasonal ATC calculations, winter peak planning, and NERC seasonal assessments.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008; FERC OATT; RTO/ISO Seasonal Rating Procedures

products.name: transmission_substation
products.description: Master record for high-voltage transmission substations including switching stations and transformer substations. Captures substation name, NERC node identifier, voltage levels served, bus configuration, geographic coordinates (GIS), ownership, commissioning date, SCADA integration point, and operational status. Serves as the topological node anchor for the transmission network model and interconnects with EMS/SCADA systems.
products.reference: NERC TPL / IEC 61968 Network Model

attributes.name: control_area_id

attributes.name: control_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_center. Business justification: Transmission substations are operated under the jurisdiction of a specific control center for switching authority and real-time monitoring. Direct FK enables control center workload management, NERC T

attributes.name: forecast_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.zone. Business justification: Substations are the physical nodes within forecast zones. Zonal load forecasts are aggregated from substation-level measurements. IRP and capacity planning require substation-to-zone mapping for trans
