attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: BES-designated substations (bes_designation attribute) are governed by NERC FAC/TOP/CIP reliability obligations beyond CIP alone. Linking to the primary reliability obligation enables compliance track

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: Substations are major capital assets requiring comprehensive asset management for regulatory rate base, depreciation schedules, capital project planning, and FERC reporting. Standard practice in utili

attributes.name: atc_contribution_mw
attributes.description: This substation's contribution to the Available Transfer Capability (ATC) calculation in megawatts (MW) as determined by the most recent power flow study. Used in transmission planning, congestion management, and OATT ATC posting requirements.

attributes.name: bes_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substation is designated as part of the Bulk Electric System (BES) per NERC BES definition. True = BES asset subject to full NERC reliability standards; False = non-BES asset. Critical for determining applicable NERC compliance obligations.

attributes.name: bus_configuration
attributes.description: Electrical bus arrangement of the substation switchyard. Determines switching flexibility, reliability, and maintenance capability. Used in outage planning, NERC TPL reliability studies, and ADMS network modeling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single-bus|double-bus|ring-bus|breaker-and-a-half|double-bus-double-breaker — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cip_asset_classification
attributes.description: NERC CIP-002 BES Cyber System impact classification for this substation. 'high' = high-impact BES asset; 'medium' = medium-impact; 'low' = low-impact; 'not-applicable' = not classified as a BES Cyber Asset. Drives cybersecurity control requirements under NERC CIP-003 through CIP-014.

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Climate zone classification for the substation site (e.g., ASHRAE climate zone or utility-defined zone). Used in equipment de-rating calculations, extreme weather resilience planning, and NERC EOP-011 cold weather preparedness assessments.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the substation was officially energized and placed into commercial service. Used in asset lifecycle management (Ventyx Asset Suite), depreciation calculations (SAP S/4HANA), and NERC facility registration.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001, SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting

attributes.name: control_building_type
attributes.description: Physical configuration of the substation control house or control building. 'indoor' = fully enclosed GIS or AIS indoor design; 'outdoor' = open-air AIS with separate control building; 'hybrid' = mixed indoor/outdoor; 'mobile' = temporary or mobile substation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the substation is located (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Used for cross-border interconnection reporting and NERC/FERC jurisdictional classification.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the substation was permanently retired from service. Null for active substations. Used in asset lifecycle management, regulatory retirement filings, and RAB adjustments.

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation of the substation site above mean sea level in meters. Used in environmental assessments, flood risk analysis, and equipment insulation coordination at high-altitude sites.

attributes.name: ferc_facility_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Facility Identifier
attributes.description: FERC-assigned facility identifier for this substation used in FERC Form 1 transmission plant reporting and OATT compliance filings. Required for FERC-jurisdictional transmission assets.

attributes.name: gis_feature_code
attributes.description: Unique feature identifier for this substation in the Esri ArcGIS Utility Network geospatial system. Used to link the asset record to its spatial representation for network modeling, outage analysis, and field crew dispatch.

attributes.name: installed_transformer_mva
attributes.description: Total installed transformer capacity at the substation in megavolt-amperes (MVA). Represents the aggregate nameplate rating of all power transformers at this node. Used in congestion management, ATC calculations, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: insulation_medium
attributes.description: Primary insulation technology used in the substation switchgear. 'AIS' = Air-Insulated Switchgear; 'GIS' = Gas-Insulated Switchgear (SF6); 'hybrid' = combination of AIS and GIS. Affects maintenance requirements, footprint, and environmental compliance (SF6 reporting under EPA regulations).
attributes.references: IEC 62271-203, EPA 40 CFR Part 98, IEEE Std 693

attributes.name: interconnection_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the FERC-filed interconnection agreement (e.g., LGIA or SGIA) associated with this substation's point of interconnection (POI). Used in OATT compliance and interconnection queue management.

attributes.name: last_major_refurbishment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major capital refurbishment or upgrade of the substation. Used in asset condition assessment, CAPEX planning, and remaining useful life estimation in Ventyx Asset Suite.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 geographic latitude coordinate of the substation in decimal degrees. Used in GIS (Esri ArcGIS Utility Network) for network modeling, outage analysis, and asset location. Positive values indicate north of the equator.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 geographic longitude coordinate of the substation in decimal degrees. Used in GIS (Esri ArcGIS Utility Network) for network modeling, outage analysis, and asset location. Negative values indicate west of the prime meridian.

attributes.name: nerc_node_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Node Identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known NERC-assigned unique node identifier for this substation used in reliability coordination, power flow models, and NERC compliance reporting. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Aligns with NERC FAC-001 and FAC-002 facility registration requirements.

attributes.name: nerc_reliability_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reliability Region
attributes.description: NERC reliability region designation (e.g., MRO, SERC, WECC, RFC, NPCC, TRE) for this substation. Determines applicable NERC reliability standards, TPL planning criteria, and CIP cybersecurity requirements.

attributes.name: number_of_bays
attributes.description: Total number of switchgear bays (feeder bays, transformer bays, bus-coupler bays) installed at the substation. Used in capacity planning, maintenance scheduling, and asset inventory management in Ventyx Asset Suite.

attributes.name: number_of_circuit_breakers
attributes.description: Total count of high-voltage circuit breakers installed at this substation. Used in asset inventory, maintenance scheduling, and NERC FAC-002 facility rating assessments.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002, IEC 62271, Ventyx Asset Suite

attributes.name: number_of_transformers
attributes.description: Count of power transformers installed at this substation. Used in asset inventory, maintenance planning, and transformer fleet management in Ventyx Asset Suite and SAP S/4HANA PM.

attributes.name: operating_entity_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity responsible for operating and maintaining this substation. May differ from the owning entity in cases of contracted O&M or joint-ownership arrangements.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the substation. 'in-service' = energized and operational; 'out-of-service' = temporarily de-energized; 'under-construction' = not yet commissioned; 'decommissioned' = permanently retired; 'mothballed' = preserved but inactive. Serves as LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Drives asset management workflows in Ventyx Asset Suite and SAP S/4HANA PM.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity that owns this substation. Determines regulatory jurisdiction, rate-setting authority, and OATT applicability. Used in FERC Form 1 reporting and RAB calculations.

attributes.name: owning_entity_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the utility or entity that owns this substation. May differ from the operating entity in joint-ownership or leased facility arrangements. Used in FERC Form 1 and NERC registration filings.

attributes.name: physical_security_level
attributes.description: Physical security classification of the substation per NERC CIP-006 Physical Security Program requirements. Determines perimeter security controls, access management, and visitor logging requirements.

attributes.name: pnode_code
attributes.description: The Locational Marginal Price (LMP) pricing node identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO for this substation. Used in energy trading settlement (OpenLink Endur), FTR position management, and DAM/RTM market operations.

attributes.name: primary_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Nominal primary (high-side) voltage level of the substation in kilovolts (kV). Represents the principal quantitative rating of this transmission asset. Serves as MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Used in power flow models, ATC calculations, and NERC reliability assessments.

attributes.name: protection_scheme_type
attributes.description: Primary protection scheme employed at this substation. Determines relay coordination requirements and NERC PRC (Protection and Control) standard applicability. Used in protection engineering and NERC PRC-001 compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: differential|distance|overcurrent|pilot-wire|directional-comparison|hybrid — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this substation record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record provenance tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this substation record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental ETL processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: sap_functional_location
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance functional location code for this substation. Used to link the substation to work orders, maintenance plans, equipment master records, and cost center assignments in SAP.

attributes.name: scada_integration_point
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Point
attributes.description: Identifier or endpoint reference for the SCADA integration point connecting this substation to the Energy Management System (EMS). Used in OSIsoft PI historian configuration and GE PowerOn ADMS real-time data feeds for grid state estimation.

attributes.name: seismic_zone
attributes.description: Seismic hazard zone designation for the substation site per IEEE Std 693 or applicable building code. Used in equipment qualification, civil engineering assessments, and resilience planning.

attributes.name: short_circuit_level_ka
attributes.description: Maximum prospective short-circuit current level at the substation busbars in kiloamperes (kA). Used in equipment rating verification, protection relay coordination, and circuit breaker interrupting capacity assessments.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-2 state or province code where the substation is physically located. Used for jurisdictional regulatory reporting to State Public Utility Commissions (PUCs) and FERC.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1, State PUC Reporting, ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: substation_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the substation in operational systems including EMS, SCADA, and SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance. Typically a 2–10 character mnemonic aligned with the utility's internal naming convention.

attributes.name: substation_name
attributes.description: Official human-readable name of the transmission substation as registered in the utility's asset management system (Ventyx Asset Suite) and GIS (Esri ArcGIS Utility Network). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Used in operational displays, SCADA, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: substation_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the substation. 'transmission' = bulk power transmission node; 'switching' = bus-switching station without transformation; 'transformer' = voltage step-up/step-down station; 'converter' = AC/DC or DC/AC conversion station; 'collector' = renewable energy collector substation. Serves as CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: tertiary_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Nominal tertiary winding voltage level in kilovolts (kV) for three-winding transformer substations. Null when no tertiary winding exists. Used in detailed power flow and short-circuit studies.

products.name: power_transformer
products.description: Master record for bulk power transformers installed at transmission substations. Captures transformer identifier, MVA rating, primary and secondary voltage (kV), impedance, cooling class (ONAN/ONAF), tap changer type, manufacturer, serial number, installation date, condition assessment score, and SCADA tag. Critical asset for transmission capacity and voltage regulation; feeds asset management and reliability reporting.
products.reference: IEEE C57 Transformer Standards

attributes.name: power_transformer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bulk power transformer asset. Primary key for the power transformer master record.

attributes.name: bes_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.bes_facility. Business justification: Critical power transformers (is_critical_asset=true) that qualify as BES facilities have a bes_facility compliance record. Linking enables NERC compliance tracking of transformer BES status, inspectio

attributes.name: from_bus_ems_node_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: From Bus Ems Node Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.ems_node. Business justification: Power transformers are modeled as two-winding branches in the EMS with from-bus and to-bus nodes. This FK is fundamental to power flow modeling, state estimation, and contingency analysis. Role-prefix

attributes.name: nerc_cip_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.nerc_cip_asset. Business justification: Power transformers at critical substations are BES cyber assets subject to NERC CIP-007 configuration management and CIP-010 change control requirements. Asset-level compliance tracking is mandatory f

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Critical power transformers (is_critical_asset=true) are subject to NERC TPL and FAC obligations for ratings, maintenance intervals, and spare transformer programs. Linking to the governing obligation

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: Power transformers are high-value critical assets requiring detailed lifecycle management, condition monitoring, depreciation tracking, and replacement analysis. Utilities maintain comprehensive asset

attributes.name: transmission_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transmission substation where this power transformer is installed.

attributes.name: book_value
attributes.description: Current net book value of the transformer after accumulated depreciation. Used for financial reporting, rate case filings, and asset valuation.

attributes.name: capital_cost
attributes.description: Original capital cost of the transformer in US dollars including equipment, installation, and commissioning. Used for depreciation calculations, rate base determination, and capital investment reporting.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date the transformer was energized and placed into commercial operation. May differ from installation date due to testing and acceptance procedures.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards (FAC-003 - Transmission Vegetation Management)

attributes.name: condition_score
attributes.description: Composite condition assessment score based on dissolved gas analysis, oil quality tests, winding resistance, insulation power factor, and visual inspections. Typically scaled 0-100 where higher scores indicate better condition. Used for risk-based maintenance prioritization.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.152 - Guide for Diagnostic Field Testing of Fluid-Filled Power Transformers, Regulators, and Reactors

attributes.name: cooling_class
attributes.description: Transformer cooling method classification per IEEE standards. ONAN (Oil Natural Air Natural) is self-cooled; ONAF (Oil Natural Air Forced) uses fans; OFAF (Oil Forced Air Forced) uses pumps and fans. Cooling class affects MVA rating and operational efficiency.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: current_tap_position
attributes.description: Current tap position setting of the transformer. Used for real-time voltage regulation monitoring and optimization. Typically monitored via SCADA.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.15 - Requirements, Terminology, and Test Code for Step-Voltage Regulators

attributes.name: expected_retirement_date
attributes.description: Planned date for transformer retirement or replacement based on asset lifecycle planning, condition assessment, and capital investment programs.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for the transformer asset. Transmission transformers typically classified under Account 352 (Structures and Improvements) or Account 353 (Station Equipment).

attributes.name: gis_location_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking the transformer to its geospatial representation in the utility GIS system. Used for network modeling, outage analysis, and asset visualization.

attributes.name: health_index
attributes.description: Normalized health index score combining condition assessment, age, loading history, and failure probability. Used for asset investment planning and replacement prioritization. Typically scaled 0-10 or 0-100.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.152 - Guide for Diagnostic Field Testing of Fluid-Filled Power Transformers, Regulators, and Reactors

attributes.name: impedance_percent
attributes.description: Percentage impedance of the transformer on its rated MVA base. Critical parameter for short-circuit calculations, fault current analysis, and power flow modeling in Energy Management Systems (EMS).
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the transformer was installed and commissioned at the substation. Used for calculating asset age, warranty periods, and maintenance schedules.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards (FAC-003 - Transmission Vegetation Management)

attributes.name: insulation_type
attributes.description: Type of insulating medium used in the transformer. Mineral oil is most common for transmission transformers; ester fluids offer environmental benefits; dry-type uses solid insulation without liquid.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: is_critical_asset
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the transformer is designated as a critical asset for grid reliability. Critical assets receive enhanced monitoring, maintenance priority, and security measures per NERC CIP standards.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent comprehensive inspection of the transformer. Used for tracking inspection compliance and scheduling future inspections.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards (PRC-005 - Protection System, Automatic Reclosing, and Sudden Pressure Relaying Maintenance)

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent scheduled or corrective maintenance activity performed on the transformer. Used for maintenance history tracking and interval planning.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards (PRC-005 - Protection System, Automatic Reclosing, and Sudden Pressure Relaying Maintenance)

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the transformer location in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis, crew dispatch, and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the transformer location in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis, crew dispatch, and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: manufacture_year
attributes.description: Year the transformer was manufactured. Used for age-based risk assessment, depreciation calculations, and replacement planning.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: mva_rating
attributes.description: Nameplate power capacity rating of the transformer in megavolt-amperes. Represents the maximum apparent power the transformer can handle under specified conditions. Critical for transmission capacity planning and Available Transfer Capability (ATC) calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity jurisdiction where the transformer is located. Used for reliability compliance reporting, regional coordination, and regulatory oversight. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|ERCOT|MRO|NPCC|RF|SERC|SPP|TRE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned maintenance activity based on time-based or condition-based maintenance strategy.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards (PRC-005 - Protection System, Automatic Reclosing, and Sudden Pressure Relaying Maintenance)

attributes.name: oil_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Total volume of insulating oil in the transformer in gallons. Used for oil replacement planning, environmental compliance reporting, and spill containment design. Null for dry-type transformers.
attributes.references: EPA Spill Prevention Control and Countermeasure (SPCC) Rule

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the transformer in the transmission network. In-service indicates active operation; standby indicates ready for service but not currently energized; maintenance indicates scheduled or unscheduled maintenance activities.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards (FAC-003 - Transmission Vegetation Management)

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of ownership arrangement for the transformer. Owned assets are utility property; leased assets are rented; joint ownership involves multiple utilities; customer-owned transformers serve large industrial loads.

attributes.name: pcb_contamination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the transformer contains or is contaminated with PCBs above regulatory thresholds. PCB-contaminated transformers require special handling, disposal procedures, and EPA reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) - PCB Regulations

attributes.name: phase_configuration
attributes.description: Electrical phase configuration of the transformer. Three-phase transformers are standard for bulk power transmission; single-phase units may be used in banks; phase-shifting transformers control power flow direction.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: primary_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Rated voltage of the primary winding in kilovolts. Typically the higher voltage side for step-down transformers or the lower voltage side for step-up transformers.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transformer record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transformer record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: rto_iso_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) Name
attributes.description: Name of the RTO or ISO that operates the transmission grid where this transformer is located. Examples include PJM, CAISO, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP. Used for market operations, congestion management, and transmission rights tracking.

attributes.name: scada_tag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Tag
attributes.description: Unique SCADA system tag identifier for real-time monitoring and control of the transformer. Links the asset record to telemetry data streams for operational monitoring, alarm management, and Energy Management System (EMS) integration.

attributes.name: tap_changer_type
attributes.description: Type of tap changer installed on the transformer. DETC (De-Energized Tap Changer) requires transformer to be offline for adjustment; LTC (Load Tap Changer) allows voltage adjustment under load. Critical for voltage regulation and grid stability.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.15 - Requirements, Terminology, and Test Code for Step-Voltage Regulators

attributes.name: tap_position_range
attributes.description: Available tap positions for voltage adjustment, typically expressed as a range (e.g., -10 to +10, or 1 to 33). Each tap position represents a discrete voltage adjustment step.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.15 - Requirements, Terminology, and Test Code for Step-Voltage Regulators

attributes.name: tertiary_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Rated voltage of the tertiary winding in kilovolts, if present. Tertiary windings are used for auxiliary loads, reactive power compensation, or harmonic filtering. Null if transformer has only two windings.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: transformer_tag
attributes.description: Externally-known unique asset tag or equipment identifier assigned to the transformer for field identification and maintenance tracking. Typically follows utility naming convention.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: transformer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transformer based on its functional role in the transmission network. Step-up transformers increase voltage from generation to transmission levels; step-down transformers reduce voltage for distribution or industrial loads.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: weight_pounds
attributes.description: Total weight of the transformer in pounds including oil, core, windings, and tank. Critical for transportation planning, foundation design, and seismic analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

attributes.name: winding_connection
attributes.description: Configuration of primary and secondary winding connections. Delta-wye and wye-delta are most common for transmission transformers. Affects voltage transformation ratio, phase shift, and harmonic performance.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.12.00 - General Requirements for Liquid-Immersed Distribution, Power, and Regulating Transformers

products.name: path
products.description: Defines a logical transmission path or flowgate between two electrical areas or control zones. Captures path identifier, from-area, to-area, associated transmission lines (flowgate elements), base case transfer limit (MW), emergency limit, NERC path designation, transmission loss factors (marginal/average loss percentage, seasonal/peak-off-peak differentiation, effective date range, FERC-approved loss rate), and interchange schedule records (RTO/ISO name, scheduling period, source/sink control area, e-tag identifier, scheduled/actual MW, curtailment status, settlement reference). SSOT for transmission path topology, transfer limits, loss allocation for OATT billing, and scheduled energy flows across control area boundaries supporting NERC BAL compliance and energy trading settlement.
products.reference: NERC MOD-001 ATC / FERC OATT Flowgate

attributes.name: path_id
attributes.description: Primary key for path

attributes.name: from_control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Transmission paths connect source and sink control areas for ATC/TTC calculations and interchange scheduling per NERC MOD-001. The from_control_area_code is denormalized. Direct FK enables automated A

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: FK to transmission.line.line_id — Transmission paths/flowgates are composed of one or more transmission lines. This is a many-to-many relationship critical for ATC calculations, congestion analysis, and outage impact assessment. The p

attributes.name: load_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.load. Business justification: Transmission paths are rated based on forecasted load conditions for seasonal transfer capability determination. Operations planning uses load forecasts to establish path ratings, calculate seasonal l

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Transmission paths have specific NERC MOD and FERC OATT obligations for ATC posting frequency, TTC calculation methodology, and reliability monitoring. Each path is subject to defined compliance requi

attributes.name: available_transfer_capability_mw
attributes.description: Current available transmission capacity on the path for additional power transfers, calculated as total transfer capability minus existing transmission commitments and capacity benefit margin, measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: average_loss_factor_percent
attributes.description: Average transmission energy loss rate across the path for typical power flow levels, expressed as a percentage. Used for transmission loss allocation in OATT billing.

attributes.name: base_case_transfer_limit_mw
attributes.description: Normal operating transfer capability limit for the transmission path under base case system conditions, measured in megawatts. Represents the maximum power flow allowed without violating thermal, voltage, or stability criteria.

attributes.name: capacity_benefit_margin_mw
attributes.description: Amount of transmission transfer capability reserved by load serving entities to ensure access to generation from interconnected systems to meet generation reliability requirements, measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: congestion_status
attributes.description: Current congestion state of the transmission path indicating whether power flow is approaching or exceeding transfer limits, requiring congestion management actions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transmission path record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: emergency_transfer_limit_mw
attributes.description: Maximum allowable power transfer on the transmission path under emergency operating conditions, measured in megawatts. Typically higher than base case limit and used for short durations during system contingencies.

attributes.name: ems_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transmission path is integrated with the Energy Management System for state estimation, contingency analysis, and optimal power flow calculations. True if EMS-integrated, false otherwise.

attributes.name: ferc_approved_loss_rate_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Approved Loss Rate Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transmission loss rates for this path have been approved by FERC as part of the Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT). True if FERC-approved, false otherwise.

attributes.name: flowgate_rating_mw
attributes.description: Thermal or stability rating of the flowgate (most limiting transmission element) on this path, measured in megawatts. Determines the path transfer capability.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the transmission path used in operational communications, NERC reporting, and RTO/ISO scheduling. Examples include NERC-registered path names or internal path codes.

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date when the transmission path was first placed into commercial operation and became available for power transfer.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transmission path record was most recently updated, reflecting changes to path attributes, ratings, or operational parameters.

attributes.name: last_rating_study_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent transmission path rating study or transfer capability analysis conducted to determine current operating limits.

attributes.name: length_miles
attributes.description: Physical length of the transmission path in miles, measured along the transmission line route from source to destination.

attributes.name: loss_factor_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current transmission loss factors became effective for billing and settlement purposes.

attributes.name: loss_factor_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current transmission loss factors expire and are replaced by updated values, typically aligned with tariff revision cycles.

attributes.name: loss_factor_period_type
attributes.description: Time-of-day period classification for transmission loss factors, distinguishing between peak demand hours and off-peak hours when losses differ due to loading levels.

attributes.name: loss_factor_season
attributes.description: Seasonal period for which the transmission loss factors are applicable, reflecting seasonal variations in system loading and ambient conditions.

attributes.name: marginal_loss_factor_percent
attributes.description: Incremental transmission loss rate for an additional unit of power flow on this path, expressed as a percentage. Used in economic dispatch and locational marginal pricing calculations.

attributes.name: nerc_path_designation
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Path Designation
attributes.description: Official NERC-registered path designation or identifier used for reliability coordination and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: nerc_reliability_coordinator
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reliability Coordinator
attributes.description: Name of the NERC Reliability Coordinator responsible for real-time monitoring and coordination of this transmission path to maintain bulk electric system reliability.

attributes.name: next_rating_study_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next transmission path rating study or transfer capability reassessment, typically required annually or after significant system changes.

attributes.name: oatt_service_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT) Service Type
attributes.description: Type of transmission service offered on this path under the OATT: firm (guaranteed), non-firm (interruptible), network (integrated transmission service), or point-to-point (specific source to sink).

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of ownership structure for the transmission path assets: wholly owned, jointly owned with other utilities, leased from another entity, contracted capacity, or third-party owned.

attributes.name: path_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the transmission path including geographic routing, major substations, transmission line segments, and operational characteristics.

attributes.name: path_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the transmission path, often reflecting geographic endpoints or operational significance.

attributes.name: path_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the transmission path in the transmission network lifecycle.

attributes.name: path_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transmission path based on its operational role: flowgate (constrained transmission element), interface (aggregated transfer capability boundary), corridor (multi-element transmission route), tie_line (interconnection between control areas), interconnection (connection to external grid), or internal (within control area).

attributes.name: rto_iso_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Name
attributes.description: Name of the RTO or ISO that has operational authority or scheduling responsibility for this transmission path. Examples: PJM, CAISO, MISO, ERCOT, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE.

attributes.name: scada_monitoring_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Monitoring Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transmission path is monitored in real-time through SCADA systems for power flow, voltage, and equipment status. True if SCADA-monitored, false otherwise.

attributes.name: to_control_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the destination control area or balancing authority area for power flow on this transmission path.

attributes.name: total_transfer_capability_mw
attributes.description: Maximum amount of electric power that can be transferred over the interconnected transmission network in a reliable manner while meeting all of a specific set of defined pre- and post-contingency system conditions, measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: transmission_reliability_margin_mw
attributes.description: Amount of transmission transfer capability necessary to ensure that the interconnected transmission network is secure under a reasonable range of uncertainties in system conditions, measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level of the transmission path in kilovolts. Common high-voltage transmission levels include 115kV, 138kV, 230kV, 345kV, 500kV, and 765kV.

products.name: atc_calculation
products.description: Transactional record of Available Transfer Capability (ATC) calculations performed for a transmission path over a specific time horizon. Captures calculation timestamp, path identifier, Total Transfer Capability (TTC), Transmission Reliability Margin (TRM), Capacity Benefit Margin (CBM), Existing Transmission Commitments (ETC), resulting ATC value (MW), study methodology, and posting status for OASIS. Supports FERC OATT compliance and transmission scheduling.
products.reference: NERC MOD-001 ATC Methodology / FERC OASIS

attributes.name: atc_calculation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ATC calculation record. Primary key for the ATC calculation transactional event.

attributes.name: contingency_analysis_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.contingency_analysis_run. Business justification: ATC calculations use post-contingency flows from contingency analysis runs to determine TTC/ATC limits per NERC MOD-001. The limiting_contingency is a denormalized text field. attributes.name: peak_demand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.peak_demand. Business justification: NERC and FERC require ATC calculations to be performed under peak demand conditions. Peak demand forecasts define the study case load levels for ATC studies. A transmission planning engineer would exp

attributes.name: planned_outage_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.planned_outage_window. Business justification: NERC and OATT require ATC recalculation when planned outages reduce transmission capacity. Linking atc_calculation to the planned_outage_window that triggered the study enables OASIS posting of update

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.position. Business justification: ATC calculations inform trading position limits on constrained transmission paths. Traders reference specific ATC results when sizing positions for transmission capacity hedging, required for position

attributes.name: primary_atc_path_id
attributes.description: FK to transmission.path.path_id — Every ATC calculation is performed for a specific transmission path. This is the fundamental FK that connects ATC values to the network topology. Required for OASIS posting and OATT scheduling.

attributes.name: source_control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: ATC calculations are performed between source and sink balancing authorities per NERC MOD-001. The source_ba_code is denormalized. Direct FK to control_area enables OASIS posting automation, FERC tari

attributes.name: state_estimation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.state_estimation_run. Business justification: ATC calculations require state estimator base case solutions for topology, power flow, and contingency analysis. NERC MOD standards mandate ATC calculations use validated EMS state estimation. New FK

attributes.name: triggering_outage_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.outage_event. Business justification: Major transmission outages trigger ATC recalculations per FERC OATT requirements. Linking ATC calculations to the triggering outage enables automated recalculation workflows, regulatory audit trails,

attributes.name: atc_mw
attributes.description: Available Transfer Capability: the measure of the transfer capability remaining in the physical transmission network for further commercial activity over and above already committed uses. Calculated as TTC minus TRM minus CBM minus ETC. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: base_case_generation_mw
attributes.description: Total system generation assumed in the base case power flow model used for the ATC calculation. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: base_case_load_mw
attributes.description: Total system load assumed in the base case power flow model used for the ATC calculation. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate ATC: Rated System Path (RSP), Network Response (NR), Available Flowgate Capability (AFC), or other approved method per NERC standards.

attributes.name: calculation_run_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the batch or scheduled run that produced this ATC calculation, enabling traceability to the calculation job or process instance.

attributes.name: calculation_software
attributes.description: Name and version of the software application used to perform the ATC calculation (e.g., EMS application, power flow analysis tool, ATC calculation engine).

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ATC calculation was performed. Represents the principal business event time for this transactional record.

attributes.name: calculation_type
attributes.description: Type of ATC calculation based on the time horizon: day-ahead, hour-ahead, real-time, monthly, or seasonal study.

attributes.name: cbm_mw
attributes.description: Capacity Benefit Margin: the amount of transmission transfer capability reserved for Load-Serving Entities to access generation from interconnected systems to meet generation reliability requirements. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, explanations, or context related to this ATC calculation, such as special operating conditions or unusual circumstances.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ATC calculation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: ems_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the EMS real-time or historical snapshot used as input data for the ATC calculation. Represents the system state at a specific point in time.

attributes.name: etc_mw
attributes.description: Existing Transmission Commitments: the sum of all firm transmission service reservations, grandfathered rights, and other committed uses of the transmission system. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: ferc_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ATC calculation is subject to FERC reporting requirements under OATT compliance (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: firm_atc_mw
attributes.business_glossary_term: Firm Available Transfer Capability (ATC) in Megawatts (MW)
attributes.description: ATC available for firm transmission service reservations, which have the highest priority and are not subject to curtailment except under emergency conditions. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ATC calculation record was last updated or modified. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission system limit that constrains the ATC: thermal (line/transformer rating), voltage (bus voltage limit), stability (transient or dynamic stability), or other.

attributes.name: limiting_facility
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the transmission facility (line, transformer, flowgate) that reaches its thermal, voltage, or stability limit first, constraining the ATC value.

attributes.name: nerc_reliability_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reliability Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity responsible for reliability coordination and compliance for this transmission path: WECC, ERCOT, MRO, NPCC, RF, SERC, SPP, or TRE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|ERCOT|MRO|NPCC|RF|SERC|SPP|TRE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: non_firm_atc_mw
attributes.business_glossary_term: Non-Firm Available Transfer Capability (ATC) in Megawatts (MW)
attributes.description: ATC available for non-firm transmission service reservations, which are lower priority and subject to curtailment when firm service is needed. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: oasis_posting_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open Access Same-Time Information System (OASIS) Posting Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ATC value was posted to the OASIS system for public access by transmission customers.

attributes.name: oatt_service_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT) Service Type
attributes.description: Type of transmission service under OATT for which this ATC is calculated: network integration service, point-to-point firm service, or point-to-point non-firm service.

attributes.name: operator_adjustment_mw
attributes.description: Manual adjustment applied by the transmission operator to the calculated ATC value based on operational judgment, real-time conditions, or reliability concerns. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: operator_adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or justification for any manual operator adjustment applied to the ATC value, documenting the operational or reliability rationale.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open Access Same-Time Information System (OASIS) Posting Status
attributes.description: Status of the ATC value posting to OASIS: pending (not yet posted), posted (published to OASIS), revised (updated after initial posting), or withdrawn (removed from OASIS).

attributes.name: rto_iso_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) Region
attributes.description: Name or code of the RTO or ISO region responsible for this transmission path and ATC calculation (e.g., PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE).

attributes.name: scada_data_quality
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Data Quality
attributes.description: Quality indicator for the SCADA telemetry data used in the ATC calculation: good (reliable), suspect (questionable), stale (outdated), or unavailable (missing).

attributes.name: sink_ba_code
attributes.description: Code or identifier of the sink Balancing Authority to which power is being transferred on this transmission path.

attributes.name: study_case_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the power flow or contingency analysis study case used as the basis for the ATC calculation. Links to the EMS or planning system study case.

attributes.name: study_horizon_end
attributes.description: Ending timestamp of the time horizon for which ATC is calculated. Defines the validity period of the ATC value.

attributes.name: study_horizon_start
attributes.description: Beginning timestamp of the time horizon for which ATC is calculated (e.g., start of the hour or day-ahead period).

attributes.name: trm_mw
attributes.description: Transmission Reliability Margin: the amount of transmission transfer capability reserved to ensure that the interconnected transmission network is secure under a reasonable range of uncertainties in system conditions. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: ttc_mw
attributes.description: Total Transfer Capability: the maximum amount of electric power that can be transferred over the transmission path in a reliable manner while meeting all reliability criteria. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: uncertainty_margin_mw
attributes.description: Additional margin reserved to account for uncertainties in load forecast, generation dispatch, or system conditions not captured in TRM. Measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the ATC calculation validation process: validated (passed all checks), pending_review (awaiting engineer review), failed (did not pass validation rules), or override (validation failure overridden by operator).

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ATC calculation was validated and approved for posting to OASIS.

products.name: transmission_service_request
products.description: Transactional record of a request for transmission service under OATT — point-to-point (PTP) or network integration transmission service (NITS). Captures request identifier, service type, requestor entity, source and sink points, requested capacity (MW), service start and end dates, priority, queue position, study requirements, approval status, and FERC docket reference. SSOT for OATT transmission service queue management.
products.reference: FERC OATT Pro Forma / NAESB WEQ

attributes.name: transmission_service_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transmission service request under OATT (Open Access Transmission Tariff). Primary key for the transmission service request record.

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Transmission service requests are submitted to specific control areas/RTOs per FERC Order 2003 interconnection queue management. The rto_iso_region is denormalized. Direct FK enables queue position tr

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.load. Business justification: Transmission service requests require load forecasts for system impact studies to assess whether requested capacity can be accommodated under forecasted system conditions. OASIS study process uses loa

attributes.name: market_participant_id

OATT queue management, FERC Order 2000 interconnection queue reporting, and ATC allocation all require identifying th

attributes.name: primary_transmission_ems_node_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Receipt PNode (Pricing Node) ID
attributes.description: Pricing node identifier for the point of receipt, used for LMP (Locational Marginal Price) settlement and congestion management in RTO/ISO markets.

attributes.name: requestor_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.counterparty. Business justification: Transmission service requestors are trading counterparties. Unified counterparty management enables credit exposure aggregation across transmission reservations and energy trades for the same entity,

attributes.name: transmission_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the executed transmission service agreement (TSA) resulting from this approved request. Links the request to the binding service contract.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Attachment A, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: ancillary_services_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ancillary services required to support the transmission service (e.g., scheduling, system control, reactive supply, regulation, frequency response, operating reserve, energy imbalance).
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Schedule 2-6, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the transmission service request was formally approved by the transmission provider, granting transmission rights to the requestor.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 17, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: approved_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Amount of transmission capacity approved by the transmission provider in megawatts (MW). May differ from requested capacity based on ATC (Available Transfer Capability) and system impact study results.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 19, NERC MOD-001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transmission service request record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: denial_date
attributes.description: Date when the transmission service request was formally denied by the transmission provider due to insufficient ATC, reliability concerns, or other OATT-compliant reasons.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 17, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for denial of the transmission service request, citing specific OATT provisions, ATC constraints, or reliability standards that preclude approval.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 17, NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: estimated_upgrade_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Network Upgrade Cost (USD - United States Dollar)
attributes.description: Estimated cost in US dollars for transmission system network upgrades required to accommodate the requested service, as determined by the facilities study.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 19.2, FERC Order 2003

attributes.name: facilities_study_status
attributes.description: Status of the facilities study required to identify transmission system upgrades or network modifications needed to accommodate the requested service.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 19.2, NERC FAC Standards

attributes.name: ferc_docket_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) Docket Number
attributes.description: FERC docket reference number for any related transmission service dispute, complaint, or tariff filing associated with this request.

attributes.name: ftr_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved transmission service includes allocation of Financial Transmission Rights for hedging congestion costs in RTO/ISO markets.
attributes.references: FERC Order 681, RTO/ISO FTR Allocation Rules

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transmission service request record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this transmission service request record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: nerc_reliability_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) Reliability Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity responsible for reliability coordination and compliance oversight for this transmission service (e.g., WECC, ERCOT, MRO, NPCC, RF, SERC, SPP, TRE). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|ERCOT|MRO|NPCC|RF|SERC|SPP|TRE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC Regional Entities, NERC Functional Model

attributes.name: network_upgrade_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transmission system network upgrades are required to accommodate the requested service. True if facilities study identified necessary system enhancements.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 19.2, FERC Order 2003

attributes.name: point_of_delivery_name
attributes.description: Name of the sink point or substation where power will be delivered from the transmission system for point-to-point service. May reference a PNode or substation.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 13, NERC TLR

attributes.name: point_of_receipt_name
attributes.description: Name of the source point or substation where power will be received onto the transmission system for point-to-point service. May reference a PNode or substation.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 13, NERC Transmission Loading Relief (TLR)

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: OATT priority ranking for the transmission service request. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Firm service typically has priority 1-6, non-firm service 7.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 13.2, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: queue_position
attributes.description: Sequential position of this request in the transmission service queue, determined by submission timestamp. Used for first-come-first-served processing under OATT rules.

attributes.name: redirect_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transmission customer has the right to redirect the point of receipt or point of delivery during the service period, subject to ATC availability.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 22, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the transmission service request, typically formatted as TSR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN. Used for OATT queue management and FERC reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888, OATT Pro Forma Tariff

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the transmission service request in the OATT queue. Tracks progression from submission through study, approval, or denial. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SUBMITTED|UNDER-STUDY|CONDITIONALLY-APPROVED|APPROVED|DENIED|WITHDRAWN|SUPERSEDED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OATT Queue Management Standards, NAESB WEQ-001

attributes.name: request_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transmission service request was formally submitted to the transmission provider. Determines queue position and priority under OATT first-come-first-served rules.

attributes.name: requested_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Amount of transmission capacity requested in megawatts (MW). Represents the maximum power transfer capability sought under the transmission service agreement.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 13, NERC MOD Standards

attributes.name: requestor_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact for transmission service request communications and notifications.

attributes.name: requestor_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the requesting entity for this transmission service request.

attributes.name: requestor_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact for urgent transmission service request communications.

attributes.name: resale_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transmission customer is permitted to resell or reassign the transmission service capacity to a third party under OATT resale provisions.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 23, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: rollover_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transmission customer has rollover rights to renew the transmission service at the end of the service period under OATT right-of-first-refusal provisions.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 2.2, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: Requested end date for the transmission service. Defines the termination of the service period. Null for open-ended or evergreen NITS agreements.

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Requested start date for the transmission service. Defines the beginning of the service period for capacity reservation and scheduling rights.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission service requested: PTP-FIRM (Point-to-Point Firm), PTP-NON-FIRM (Point-to-Point Non-Firm), NITS (Network Integration Transmission Service), or SECONDARY (Secondary Network Service).

attributes.name: study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all required transmission service studies (system impact and facilities studies) were completed and results delivered to the requestor.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 19, NAESB WEQ-001

attributes.name: study_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a system impact study or facilities study is required to evaluate the transmission service request. True if studies are needed to assess grid reliability impacts.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 19, NERC TPL Standards

attributes.name: system_impact_study_status
attributes.description: Status of the system impact study required to evaluate whether the requested transmission service can be provided without adversely affecting system reliability.
attributes.references: OATT Pro Forma Tariff Section 19.1, NERC MOD-032

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date when the transmission service request was voluntarily withdrawn by the requestor before approval or denial.

products.name: transmission_service_agreement
products.description: Master record for executed transmission service agreements under OATT including associated billing and invoicing. SSOT for transmission customer contractual entitlements and transmission revenue billing within the OATT commercial lifecycle, distinct from retail billing domain.

products.name: ftr_position
products.description: Master record for Financial Transmission Rights (FTR) positions held by the utility or transmission customers as congestion revenue hedges. Captures FTR identifier, auction round and period, obligation or option type, source PNode, sink PNode, MW quantity, direction (prevailing/counter-flow), auction clearing price ($/MW), monthly settlement credits/charges, RTO/ISO market identifier, portfolio grouping, and expiration date. Supports congestion cost hedging strategy, day-ahead market settlement reconciliation, and ARR-to-FTR conversion tracking.

attributes.name: hedge_strategy_code

attributes.name: holding_entity_type

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.references: FERC Order 888 - Open Access Transmission Tariff

attributes.name: mw_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of transmission capacity in megawatts covered by this FTR position. Determines the magnitude of congestion revenue credits or charges.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this FTR position, including hedging rationale, special conditions, or settlement exceptions.

attributes.name: on_peak_off_peak_designation
attributes.description: Time-of-use designation for the FTR position. On-peak FTRs cover weekday business hours; off-peak FTRs cover nights and weekends; 24-hour FTRs cover all hours.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888 - Open Access Transmission Tariff

attributes.name: portfolio_grouping
attributes.description: Business grouping or portfolio designation for this FTR position. Used to aggregate positions for risk management, hedging strategy analysis, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the FTR position. Active positions are in-force and subject to settlement; expired positions have reached their end date; settled positions have completed final financial settlement; cancelled positions were terminated before expiration.

attributes.name: reconfiguration_flag

attributes.references: FERC Order 888 - Open Access Transmission Tariff

attributes.name: sink_pnode_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the sink pricing node (withdrawal point) of the FTR path. Congestion revenue is calculated based on the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) difference between source and sink PNodes.

attributes.name: source_pnode_code

attributes.name: source_pnode_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the source pricing node for the FTR path.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888 - Open Access Transmission Tariff

attributes.name: trading_hub_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether either the source or sink PNode is a major trading hub. Hub-based FTRs typically have higher liquidity and more predictable congestion patterns.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888 - Open Access Transmission Tariff

products.name: congestion_event
products.description: Transactional record of a transmission congestion event on a specific path or flowgate where physical power flow constraints cause economic dispatch deviations. Captures event identifier, affected path or flowgate, start and end timestamps, congestion direction, shadow price ($/MWh), curtailed MW, LMP differential between source and sink nodes, RTO/ISO market interval, binding constraint identifier, and remedial action taken (redispatch, TLR, curtailment). Used for congestion cost analysis, FTR settlement reconciliation, Transmission Loading Relief (TLR) tracking, and FERC reporting.

attributes.description: Total congestion cost in USD for the event, calculated as the product of curtailed MW, event duration, and shadow price or LMP differential.

attributes.description: Difference between sink LMP and source LMP, representing the congestion component of the price spread across the transmission path.

attributes.name: post_contingency_flow_mw
attributes.description: Projected power flow in megawatts on the monitored element following the contingency event, used in security-constrained dispatch.

attributes.name: pre_contingency_flow_mw
attributes.description: Power flow in megawatts on the monitored element under normal (pre-contingency) conditions during the congestion event.

attributes.description: Shadow price or marginal congestion cost in USD per MWh associated with the binding constraint. Represents the incremental cost of relieving the congestion by one MWh.

attributes.name: source_lmp_usd_per_mwh

attributes.description: Locational Marginal Price at the source PNode during the congestion event, representing the cost of delivering one additional MWh at that location.

attributes.description: Name or code of the source system that generated the congestion event record (e.g., EMS, market management system, SCADA historian).

attributes.description: NERC Transmission Loading Relief level invoked during the congestion event (e.g., TLR 1, TLR 2, TLR 3a, TLR 3b, TLR 4, TLR 5a, TLR 5b, TLR 6), if applicable.

attributes.name: weather_condition

attributes.name: primary_voltage_kv

attributes.name: transformer_type

attributes.name: flisr_enabled_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is included in automated FLISR switching logic. FLISR-enabled segments can be automatically isolated and restored during fault conditions to minimize outage duration and customer impact.

attributes.name: gis_polyline_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the corresponding polyline feature in the GIS system (Esri ArcGIS Utility Network). Links operational data to geographic representation for mapping and spatial analysis.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network - Feature Linking

attributes.name: hosting_capacity_kw
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distributed Energy Resource (DER) Hosting Capacity in Kilowatts (kW)
attributes.description: Maximum amount of distributed generation (solar, wind, storage) that can be interconnected to this segment without causing voltage, thermal, or protection violations. Critical for DER interconnection studies and renewable integration planning.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the network segment was originally installed and energized. Used for asset age analysis and replacement planning.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection of the segment. Used for compliance with maintenance schedules and condition assessment programs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this network segment record. Tracks data currency and change history for operational and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this record. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements.

attributes.name: neutral_configuration
attributes.description: Method of neutral conductor grounding. Multi-grounded neutrals are grounded at multiple points for safety, unigrounded at one point, ungrounded systems have no neutral ground, impedance-grounded use resistors or reactors.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required inspection based on regulatory requirements and utility maintenance policies.

attributes.name: nominal_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Design voltage level of the distribution segment in kilovolts. Common distribution voltages: 4.16 kV, 12.47 kV, 13.2 kV, 13.8 kV, 23 kV, 34.5 kV.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the network segment in the distribution grid. Determines whether the segment is actively carrying load, isolated for maintenance, or permanently retired.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership classification of the segment. Most distribution segments are utility-owned, but some may be customer-owned (behind-the-meter), jointly owned with municipalities, or owned by third parties.

attributes.name: peak_load_kw
attributes.description: Historical maximum load observed on this segment in kilowatts. Used for capacity planning, load balancing, and identifying overloaded segments requiring reinforcement.

attributes.name: phase_configuration
attributes.description: Electrical phase arrangement of the segment. Three-phase segments serve large loads and industrial customers, two-phase serve medium loads, single-phase serve residential areas. Phase rotation (ABC vs ACB) affects motor operation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: three_phase_abc|three_phase_acb|two_phase_ab|two_phase_bc|two_phase_ac|single_phase_a|single_phase_b|single_phase_c — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: positive_sequence_reactance_ohms_per_km
attributes.business_glossary_term: Positive Sequence Reactance in Ohms per Kilometer
attributes.description: Positive sequence inductive reactance of the conductor per unit length. Critical for power flow modeling and voltage regulation analysis.

attributes.name: positive_sequence_resistance_ohms_per_km
attributes.business_glossary_term: Positive Sequence Resistance in Ohms per Kilometer
attributes.description: Positive sequence resistance of the conductor per unit length. Used in load flow analysis, voltage drop calculations, and short circuit studies in GE PowerOn ADMS.

attributes.name: rated_ampacity_amps
attributes.description: Maximum continuous current-carrying capacity of the conductor in amperes under normal operating conditions. Determined by conductor size, material, installation method, and ambient temperature.

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the segment record is effective. Supports temporal data management and historical analysis of network topology changes.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance - Temporal Data Standards

attributes.name: record_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the segment record expires and is superseded by a new version. Null for current active records. Enables tracking of network topology evolution over time.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance - Temporal Data Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State or provincial Public Utility Commission (PUC) that has regulatory authority over this segment. Determines applicable reliability standards, reporting requirements, and rate recovery mechanisms.

attributes.name: scada_monitored_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Monitored Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment has real-time SCADA telemetry for current, voltage, and power flow monitoring. SCADA-monitored segments provide operational visibility for grid operators.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the network segment used in operational systems and field communications. Typically derived from GIS naming conventions.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network - Asset Naming Standards

attributes.name: segment_length_km
attributes.description: Physical length of the network segment measured in kilometers. Used for impedance calculations, voltage drop analysis, and hosting capacity studies.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network - Linear Measurement

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the network segment, often including geographic or operational context (e.g., 'Main St Feeder 12A Section 3').
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS - Network Topology Naming

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segment based on its role in the distribution network hierarchy. Primary feeders carry bulk power from substations, laterals branch from primaries, sub-laterals branch from laterals, service backbones serve multiple service drops, express feeders bypass load areas, and tie lines connect feeders.

attributes.name: volt_var_optimization_zone
attributes.description: Identifier for the voltage optimization zone this segment belongs to. VVO zones are coordinated groups of segments and voltage control devices managed together to reduce losses and maintain voltage within acceptable limits.

attributes.name: zero_sequence_reactance_ohms_per_km
attributes.business_glossary_term: Zero Sequence Reactance in Ohms per Kilometer
attributes.description: Zero sequence inductive reactance per unit length. Essential for fault current calculations and protection system design.

attributes.name: zero_sequence_resistance_ohms_per_km
attributes.business_glossary_term: Zero Sequence Resistance in Ohms per Kilometer
attributes.description: Zero sequence resistance per unit length. Used in ground fault analysis and protective relay coordination studies.

products.name: load_zone
products.description: Master record for distribution load zones — logical groupings of network segments used for load balancing, volt-VAR optimization dispatch, demand forecasting, and capacity planning. Captures zone identifier, zone name, geographic boundary (GIS polygon), nominal load (MW/MVAr), peak demand (MW), associated feeders, voltage regulation targets, power factor targets, and DMS zone classification. Serves as the control zone for VVO dispatch actions and the planning unit for distribution capacity studies. SSOT for load zone definition in GE PowerOn ADMS.
products.reference: GE PowerOn ADMS Load Zone / IEC CIM LoadArea

attributes.name: load_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the distribution load zone. Primary key. This is the SSOT identifier used across GE PowerOn ADMS and Esri ArcGIS Utility Network for zone-level control and planning.

attributes.name: control_area_id
