attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date when this adjustment was posted to the general ledger. Null if not yet posted. Used for financial period reconciliation and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Posting Date; Oracle ERP GL Date; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: invoice
attributes.description: FK to billing.invoice.invoice_id — Adjustments are applied against specific invoices or billing periods. Critical for AR reconciliation and SOX controls.

attributes.name: nem_credit_amount
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the total monetary credit amount calculated as nem_exported_kwh multiplied by nem_credit_rate. This amount is applied as a credit to the customer account. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Rules; Oracle CC&B NEM Module

attributes.name: nem_credit_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Energy Metering (NEM) Credit Expiration Date
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the date when unused NEM credits expire per the applicable NEM tariff rules (typically 12 months from generation). Null for non-NEM adjustments or jurisdictions without credit expiration.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; Oracle CC&B NEM Module

attributes.name: nem_credit_rate
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the per-kWh credit rate applied to exported energy, expressed in currency per kWh. Rate is determined by the applicable NEM tariff and may vary by time-of-use period. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; Oracle CC&B NEM Rate Schedule

attributes.name: nem_cumulative_credit_balance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Energy Metering (NEM) Cumulative Credit Balance
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the cumulative balance of NEM credits on the customer account after this adjustment is applied. Used to track credit carryover across billing periods. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Rules; Oracle CC&B NEM Module

attributes.name: nem_exported_kwh
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the quantity of energy in kilowatt-hours exported by the customer's behind-the-meter generation system to the grid during the billing period. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Rules; Oracle CC&B NEM Module; PURPA Section 210

attributes.name: nem_tariff_version
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the version identifier of the NEM tariff applied to this adjustment (e.g., NEM 1.0, NEM 2.0, NEM 3.0). Different tariff versions have different credit calculation rules. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff Schedule; Oracle CC&B NEM Configuration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the adjustment. Used by customer service representatives and billing analysts for documentation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Long Text; Oracle CC&B Comments

attributes.name: posted_to_gl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment has been posted to the general ledger for financial reporting. True if posted, False if pending. Supports SOX financial controls and month-end close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting; Oracle ERP GL Interface; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the adjustment (e.g., meter read correction, customer complaint resolution, regulatory mandate, billing system error).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Reason Code; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Reason

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context and details about why the adjustment was made, often used for audit trails and customer communication.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Adjustment Text; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Comments

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adjustment record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Creation Timestamp; Oracle CC&B Created Date

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adjustment record was last modified in the source system. Used for audit trails and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Change Timestamp; Oracle CC&B Last Updated Date

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment must be included in regulatory compliance reporting to state PUC, FERC, or other governing bodies. True if reportable, False otherwise.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC Annual Reports; NERC Compliance Reporting

attributes.name: revenue_class
attributes.description: Classification of the adjustment by revenue category for regulatory reporting and financial analysis. Aligns with FERC Uniform System of Accounts and state PUC reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energy_sales|distribution_charges|transmission_charges|regulatory_surcharges|ancillary_services|nem_credits|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Revenue Classification

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment is a reversal of a previous adjustment transaction. True if this is a reversal, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Reversal Indicator; Oracle CC&B Reversal Flag

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the originating document or transaction in the source system (e.g., work order number, service request ID, regulatory filing reference). Used for audit trails and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Document Number; Oracle CC&B Reference ID

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system or process that originated this adjustment transaction. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U; Oracle CC&B; Oracle MDM

attributes.name: tariff_code
attributes.description: Rate schedule or tariff code applicable to this adjustment, particularly for rate corrections and regulatory surcharge adjustments. References the approved tariff on file with the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: State PUC Tariff Schedule; FERC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component of the adjustment amount, if applicable. Null for non-taxable adjustments. Used for sales tax, utility tax, and other applicable taxes.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Tax Calculation; Oracle CC&B Tax Engine

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction applicable to this adjustment. Used for multi-jurisdictional tax compliance and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Tax Jurisdiction; Oracle CC&B Tax Authority Code

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment represents a bad debt write-off. True if this is a write-off, False otherwise. Used for accounts receivable aging and collections reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Write-Off; Oracle CC&B Write-Off Processing; GAAP Bad Debt Accounting

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for write-off (e.g., bankruptcy, uncollectible, deceased customer, small balance). Null for non-write-off adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Write-Off Reason; Oracle CC&B Write-Off Code

products.name: deposit
products.description: Master entity tracking customer security deposits held by the utility, including deposit amount, deposit type (cash, surety bond, letter of credit), collection date, interest accrual, refund eligibility date, refund status, and regulatory basis for deposit requirement. Managed within SAP IS-U FICA and Oracle CC&B deposit management. Supports PUC-mandated deposit rules and customer financial risk management.
products.reference: Customer Deposit / Security Deposit

attributes.name: deposit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer security deposit record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for which this deposit is held. Links to the customer billing account in CIS.

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.billing_service_agreement.billing_service_agreement_id — Security deposits are collected against a specific service agreement. This FK enables deposit tracking, refund eligibility, and regulatory compliance for deposit rules.

attributes.name: accrued_interest_amount
attributes.description: Total interest earned on the deposit from collection date to current date, calculated per regulatory interest rate requirements. Many PUCs mandate interest payment on customer deposits held beyond specified periods.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Original principal amount of the deposit collected from or guaranteed by the customer, in the utility's functional currency. Does not include accrued interest.

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date the deposit was collected from the customer or the guarantee instrument became effective. Serves as the start date for interest accrual and regulatory holding period calculations.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Deposit Posting Date

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Payment method or mechanism used to collect the cash deposit from the customer. Does not apply to surety bonds or letters of credit which are third-party guarantees.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the deposit record was first created in the CIS or FICA system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the deposit amount. Supports multi-currency operations for utilities operating across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: deposit_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the deposit, used in customer communications and financial reporting. Externally visible deposit reference number.

attributes.name: deposit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the deposit. Active deposits are held and earning interest, refunded deposits have been returned to customer, forfeited deposits applied to outstanding balances, transferred deposits moved to new account, expired deposits past regulatory holding period, and pending refund deposits awaiting disbursement approval.

attributes.name: deposit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deposit instrument held by the utility. Cash deposits are held in utility accounts, surety bonds and letters of credit are third-party guarantees, bank guarantees are financial institution commitments, and escrow deposits are held by third-party trustees.

attributes.name: forfeiture_amount
attributes.description: Amount of deposit (including accrued interest) applied to customer account balance upon forfeiture. May be partial if deposit exceeds outstanding balance. Null for deposits not forfeited.

attributes.name: forfeiture_date
attributes.description: Date the deposit was forfeited and applied to outstanding customer account balance due to payment default, service disconnection, or final bill settlement. Null for deposits not forfeited.

attributes.name: forfeiture_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for forfeiting the deposit and applying it to customer account balance. Payment default and service disconnection are most common triggers per PUC tariff rules.

attributes.name: guarantee_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the surety bond, letter of credit, or bank guarantee. Utility must ensure renewal or replacement before expiration to maintain deposit coverage. Null for cash deposits and perpetual guarantees.

attributes.name: guarantee_instrument_number
attributes.description: Reference number or policy number of the surety bond, letter of credit, or bank guarantee instrument. Used for verification and claim processing. Null for cash deposits.

attributes.name: guarantee_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution or surety company providing the letter of credit, surety bond, or bank guarantee. Applicable only for non-cash deposit types. Null for cash deposits.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate interest accrual on the deposit. Simple interest calculates on principal only, compound methods add accrued interest to principal at specified intervals. Method is typically mandated by PUC tariff rules.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to the deposit balance, expressed as a percentage. Rate is typically set by state PUC regulations and may be tied to treasury rates or fixed by tariff.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the deposit record was last updated. Tracks changes to deposit status, interest accrual, or refund processing for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date the deposit record was last reviewed for refund eligibility, interest accrual accuracy, or regulatory compliance. Utilities typically perform periodic deposit reviews per PUC requirements.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next deposit review cycle. Used for workflow management and compliance tracking to ensure timely refund processing and interest payment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording special circumstances, customer disputes, regulatory exceptions, or other relevant information about the deposit. Used for audit trail and customer service reference.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason for requiring or collecting the deposit. Regulatory requirements mandate deposits for certain customer risk profiles, payment defaults trigger deposit collection, and voluntary deposits may be offered for budget management.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount refunded to customer, including original deposit principal plus accrued interest, minus any forfeitures or adjustments. Null for deposits not yet refunded.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Actual date the deposit (plus accrued interest) was refunded to the customer or applied to their account balance. Null for deposits not yet refunded.

attributes.name: refund_eligibility_date
attributes.description: Date on which the deposit becomes eligible for refund to the customer, calculated based on PUC-mandated holding periods and customer payment history criteria. Typically 12-24 months of on-time payment history.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method used to return the deposit to the customer. Account credit applies deposit to outstanding balance, check and direct deposit return funds directly to customer, wire transfer used for large amounts.

attributes.name: regulatory_holding_period_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of months the utility must hold the deposit before refund eligibility, as mandated by state PUC regulations. Typically 12 or 24 months depending on jurisdiction and customer class.
attributes.references: State PUC Deposit Holding Period Rules

attributes.name: service_agreement
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Security deposits are held against a specific service agreement. Required for deposit refund eligibility tracking.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deposit record is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements. True for publicly traded utilities with material deposit balances requiring internal control documentation.

attributes.name: to_sa
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Security deposits are collected for a specific service agreement, often at service initiation or after credit events.

products.name: dunning_notice
products.description: Transactional record of a dunning or collections notice issued to a customer with a past-due balance. Captures dunning level (first notice, final notice, disconnect warning, disconnect order), issue date, past-due amount, response deadline, delivery channel (mail, email, SMS, door hanger), and resulting action taken. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA dunning program and Oracle CC&B collections workflow. Tracks the full collections escalation lifecycle.

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Dunning notices must comply with specific regulatory obligations governing mandatory notice periods, protected customer rules, and disconnection moratorium requirements. dunning_notice has regulatory_

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_id

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service premise or property associated with the delinquent account.

attributes.name: action_taken
attributes.description: Resulting action or outcome following the dunning notice. Tracks how the collections case was resolved or escalated. attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Dunning Action, Oracle CC&B Collection Action

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this dunning notice record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Creation Date, Oracle CC&B Create Date

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the past due amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: customer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the customer or authorized contact person to whom the dunning notice was addressed.

attributes.name: days_past_due

attributes.name: delivery_address
attributes.description: Physical or electronic address to which the dunning notice was sent (mailing address, email address, or phone number).

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: Method by which the dunning notice was delivered to the customer.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Confirmation status of the delivery attempt. Indicates whether the notice successfully reached the customer.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Output Status, Oracle CC&B Delivery Confirmation

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the dunning notice was successfully delivered or sent to the customer.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Output Log, Oracle CC&B Notification Log

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: dunning_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating if dunning was blocked or suppressed for this account due to special circumstances (e.g., hardship, bankruptcy, medical emergency).

attributes.name: dunning_block_reason

attributes.name: dunning_fee

attributes.name: dunning_level

attributes.name: dunning_notice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the dunning notice, used in customer correspondence and payment references.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Document Number, Oracle CC&B Notice Number

attributes.name: dunning_status

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: late_payment_fee

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: past_due_amount

attributes.name: print_suppression_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_notice_days

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: collections
products.description: Master and transactional entity representing collections cases and their associated dunning notices for customer accounts with delinquent balances. At the case level: captures case open date, delinquent amount, collections stage, assigned collector, escalation history, disconnect status, reconnect conditions, write-off eligibility, and case resolution outcome. At the notice level: captures dunning level (first notice, final notice, disconnect warning, disconnect order), issue date, past-due amount, response deadline, delivery channel (mail, email, SMS, door hanger), and resulting action taken. Managed within SAP IS-U FICA dunning program and Oracle CC&B collections workflow. SSOT for all collections activity and dunning communications supporting SOX AR aging and bad debt controls.
products.reference: Collections Case / Delinquency Case

attributes.name: collections_id

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id

attributes.name: counterparty_id

attributes.name: bankruptcy_filing_date

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag

attributes.name: enforcement_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.enforcement_action. Linking write_off to enforcement_action enables compliance tracking of write-off restrictions a

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.service_territory. The existing denormalized service_territory_code must be replaced with a proper FK to suppor

attributes.name: aging_bucket

attributes.name: amount

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager, director, or executive who authorized the write-off transaction per SOX approval hierarchy.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical approval level required for this write-off based on dollar threshold: supervisor (under $500), manager ($500-$2,500), director ($2,500-$10,000), vp ($10,000-$50,000), cfo (over $50,000).

attributes.name: bankruptcy_case_number
attributes.description: The court-assigned bankruptcy case number if the write-off reason is bankruptcy, used for tracking potential distributions.

attributes.name: bankruptcy_chapter
attributes.description: The chapter of bankruptcy filed by the customer: chapter_7 (liquidation), chapter_11 (reorganization), chapter_13 (individual debt adjustment).

attributes.name: collection_agency_referral_date
attributes.description: The date on which the account was referred to an external collection agency for recovery efforts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this write-off record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the write-off amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of days the account balance was past due at the time of write-off, calculated from the original due date to the write-off date.

attributes.name: external_collection_agency
attributes.description: Name of the third-party collection agency to which the account was referred before write-off, if applicable.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal year and period (YYYY-MM format) in which the write-off was recognized for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: from_collections_case
attributes.description: FK to billing.collections_case.collections_case_id — Write-offs are the terminal outcome of a collections case. This FK is required for bad debt tracking, recovery management, and SOX AR aging controls.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the write-off amount representing accrued interest or late payment charges.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the last payment received from the customer before the account was written off.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date of the last payment received from the customer before the account was written off.

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this write-off record was last modified.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the write-off amount representing penalties, fees, or other charges assessed to the account.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off transaction was posted to the general ledger and accounts receivable subledger.

attributes.name: principal_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the write-off amount representing the original principal balance owed by the customer.

attributes.name: puc_reporting_category
attributes.description: The regulatory reporting category for this write-off as required by state Public Utility Commission uncollectable expense reporting.

attributes.name: rate_class
attributes.description: The customer rate classification for the account at the time of write-off: residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, or agricultural.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the primary reason for the write-off: bankruptcy (customer filed for bankruptcy protection), deceased (customer is deceased with no estate recovery), skip (customer location unknown), hardship (financial hardship waiver), uncollectable (exhausted collection efforts), fraud (fraudulent account).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Write-Off Reason Codes

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances leading to the write-off decision, including supporting documentation references.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative dollar amount recovered from this write-off through subsequent collection efforts, bankruptcy distributions, or estate settlements.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent recovery payment or distribution applied against this written-off balance.

attributes.name: recovery_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the written-off balance is eligible for future recovery efforts (true) or permanently closed (false).

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was reversed, if applicable (e.g., due to error correction or subsequent payment arrangement).

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the write-off was reversed, including reference to correcting documentation or payment arrangement.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of utility service for which the written-off balance was incurred: electric, gas, water, steam, or combined services.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the write-off is reported for income tax purposes (may differ from fiscal period for tax accounting).

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accounts receivable balance was officially written off. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the write-off transaction, used in financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: write_off_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the write-off transaction: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized but not yet posted), posted (recorded to GL), reversed (write-off reversed), recovered (partial or full recovery after write-off).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created the write-off record.

products.name: budget_plan
products.description: Master entity representing a customer enrollment in a budget billing (levelized billing) program, where monthly charges are averaged over a 12-month period to smooth seasonal bill variability. Captures enrolled amount, plan start date, true-up month, cumulative actual vs. budget variance, annual true-up amount, and plan status. Managed within Oracle CC&B and SAP IS-U. Supports customer affordability programs and revenue smoothing.
products.reference: Budget Billing Plan / Levelized Billing

attributes.name: budget_plan_id

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id

attributes.name: energy_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.energy_price. Business justification: Budget billing installment calculation: monthly_installment_amount in budget plans is computed from projected annual energy costs driven by energy price forecasts. Linking budget_plan to energy_price

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Reference to an associated payment arrangement if the budget plan is part of a broader affordability or collections program.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Payment Arrangement / Oracle CC&B Payment Arrangement

attributes.name: affordability_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customer affordability or assistance program under which this budget plan is offered (low-income, senior, medical baseline, etc.).

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated annual energy cost used as the basis for calculating monthly installments, typically based on historical usage and current rates.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the budget billing plan automatically renews at the end of the term or requires customer re-enrollment.

attributes.name: budget_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget billing plan enrollment.

attributes.name: budget_to_sa
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Budget billing plans are enrolled for a specific service agreement to smooth seasonal bill variability.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget billing plan was cancelled by the customer or utility. Null if plan is active or completed normally.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for plan cancellation (customer request, payment default, account closure, service disconnection, etc.).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget billing plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_actual_amount
attributes.description: Total actual energy charges incurred by the customer since enrollment, based on actual consumption and applicable rates.

attributes.name: cumulative_billed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount billed to the customer under the budget plan since enrollment, representing the sum of all monthly installments charged.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget plan.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget billing plan ends or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended plans.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget billing plan becomes effective and monthly installment billing begins.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Budget Plan Effective Date

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when customer eligibility for the budget billing plan or associated affordability program was last verified.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer enrolled in the budget billing plan.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer was enrolled into the budget billing plan.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Budget Plan Start Date

attributes.name: historical_usage_kwh
attributes.description: Total historical annual energy consumption in kilowatt-hours used as the basis for calculating the budget amount, typically from the prior 12-month period.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget billing plan record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_true_up_amount
attributes.description: Amount settled at the most recent true-up. Positive values represent credits issued to customer; negative values represent additional charges.

attributes.name: last_true_up_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent annual true-up reconciliation when variance was settled and plan was recalculated.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this budget billing plan record.

attributes.name: monthly_installment_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment amount charged to the customer under the budget billing plan, calculated to smooth seasonal bill variability.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next plan review or recalculation, typically mid-cycle or at true-up to adjust installments based on actual usage trends.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the budget billing plan, including special arrangements, customer requests, or operational remarks.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique identifier for the budget billing plan, used in customer communications and billing statements.

attributes.name: plan_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the budget billing plan cycle in months, typically 12 months for annual levelized billing.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget billing methodology used to calculate monthly installments (levelized over 12 months, rolling average, fixed amount, seasonal adjustment, or custom calculation).

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code

attributes.description: Frequency at which the monthly installment amount is recalculated based on updated usage patterns and rate changes.

attributes.name: service_agreement

attributes.name: true_up_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when the annual true-up reconciliation occurs, settling the variance between budget installments and actual charges.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Current difference between cumulative billed amount and cumulative actual amount. Positive variance indicates customer has been overbilled (credit due at true-up); negative variance indicates underbilled (balance due at true-up).

products.name: cycle
products.description: Reference and operational entity defining billing cycle configurations and their execution history. At the cycle level: stores cycle code, read frequency (monthly, bi-monthly), scheduled read and bill generation dates, due date offset, and assigned account count. At the run level: captures batch billing run execution records including run date, billing cycle reference, accounts processed, invoices generated, total billed amount, run status (pending, in-progress, completed, error), exception count, and operator. Drives billing run scheduling, workload distribution, and revenue cycle timing. Sourced from SAP IS-U and Oracle CC&B billing engine. SSOT for billing cycle definitions and all batch billing run execution records.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.service_territory. The existing denormalized service_territo

attributes.name: accounts_processed_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer accounts successfully processed during this billing run execution.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing cycle run requires supervisory approval before invoice release (True) or can be automatically released (False). Typically True for high-value commercial/industrial cycles.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing run was approved for invoice release. Null if approval not required or not yet approved.

attributes.name: assigned_account_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer accounts assigned to this billing cycle for workload distribution and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Account Assignment, Oracle CC&B Cycle Assignment

attributes.name: bill_due_date_offset_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bill Due Date Offset in Days
attributes.description: Number of days after bill generation date to set the payment due date (e.g., 21 days for residential, 30 days for commercial).

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the consumption period covered by this billing cycle run (inclusive).

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the consumption period covered by this billing cycle run (inclusive).

attributes.name: billing_run_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the billing batch processing was executed for this cycle. May differ from scheduled date due to operational adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this billing cycle (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.description: Business identifier for the billing cycle configuration (e.g., RES01, COM15, IND30). Used for scheduling and grouping accounts into billing batches.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Rate Category, Oracle CC&B Cycle Definition

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the billing cycle (e.g., Residential Monthly Cycle 1, Commercial Bi-Monthly East).

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing cycle configuration. Active: in use for billing operations. Inactive: temporarily disabled. Suspended: on hold pending review. Archived: retired from active use.

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing cycle frequency and purpose. Monthly for standard monthly billing, bi-monthly for every-other-month, quarterly for seasonal, on-demand for ad-hoc billing, final for account closure billing.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this billing cycle configuration was retired or superseded. Null for currently active cycles.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this billing cycle configuration became active and available for use in billing operations.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Number of accounts that encountered errors or exceptions during billing run processing (e.g., missing meter reads, rate errors, validation failures). Requires manual review.

attributes.name: exception_summary
attributes.description: Brief summary of the types of exceptions encountered during the billing run (e.g., 15 missing reads, 3 rate lookup failures, 2 validation errors).

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to deliver invoices to customers in this billing cycle. Paper: postal mail. Email: electronic delivery. Portal: customer self-service. SMS: text message notification. Suppressed: no delivery (e.g., zero-balance accounts).

attributes.name: invoice_print_date
attributes.description: The date when physical invoices were printed or electronic bills were released to customers. May differ from billing run date due to approval workflows.

attributes.name: invoices_generated_count
attributes.description: Total number of invoices (bills) generated during this billing run execution. May differ from accounts processed if some accounts had zero consumption or credits.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or comments about this billing cycle or run (e.g., holiday adjustments, system issues, rate changes).

attributes.name: rate_class
attributes.description: Customer rate classification this billing cycle primarily serves. Determines applicable tariff schedules and rate structures.
attributes.references: FERC Rate Schedule Classification, State PUC Tariff Filings

attributes.name: read_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled meter reads for this billing cycle (e.g., 30 for monthly, 60 for bi-monthly).

attributes.name: run_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes for the billing run execution. Used for capacity planning and performance optimization.

attributes.name: run_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing batch processing completed or terminated. Used for performance monitoring and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: run_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing batch processing began execution. Used for performance monitoring and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current execution status of the billing run. Pending: scheduled but not started. In-progress: actively processing. Completed: finished successfully. Completed-with-exceptions: finished but some accounts had errors. Error: run failed. Cancelled: run was aborted.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Run Status, Oracle CC&B Batch Status

attributes.name: scheduled_bill_generation_date
attributes.description: The date when invoice generation batch processing is scheduled to execute for this billing cycle.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Run Schedule, Oracle CC&B Bill Calculation

attributes.name: scheduled_read_end_date
attributes.description: The date by which all meter reading activities should be completed for this billing cycle period.

attributes.name: scheduled_read_start_date
attributes.description: The date when meter reading activities are scheduled to begin for this billing cycle period.

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all invoice amounts generated during this billing run execution, before payments and adjustments. Represents gross revenue for the cycle.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Billing Document Total, SOX Revenue Recognition Controls

attributes.name: total_kwh_billed
attributes.description: Sum of all energy consumption in kilowatt-hours billed across all accounts in this billing run. Key operational metric for load forecasting and revenue analysis.

products.name: billing_run

Sourced from SAP IS-U and Oracle CC&B billing engine execution logs. Supports billing operations monitoring and revenue cycle management.

attributes.name: batch_job_reference

products.name: grid_scada_measurement
products.description: Time-series transactional record of all real-time and near-real-time grid telemetry readings — both SCADA analog/digital measurements and PMU synchrophasor data — ingested from OSIsoft PI historian into the analytics platform. SCADA attributes include PI tag reference, UTC timestamp, raw value, engineering-unit value, quality code (Good/Substituted/Bad), scan cycle, and source RTU. PMU attributes include voltage/current phasor magnitude and angle, frequency (Hz), ROCOF (Hz/s), microsecond-precision timestamp, and PDC data quality flags. Measurement source type discriminator (SCADA/PMU) distinguishes data origin and grain. SSOT for all grid telemetry time-series data supporting post-event review, NERC TOP reliability analysis, NERC PRC-002 disturbance monitoring, wide-area situational awareness, oscillation detection, and operational analytics. Distinct from interval meter data (owned by metering domain).

attributes.name: active_power_mw
attributes.description: The real power flow in megawatts (MW) measured at this telemetry point. attributes.name: agc_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement is used as an input to the Automatic Generation Control (AGC) system for real-time generation dispatch and frequency regulation. attributes.name: alarm_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement triggered an alarm condition in the SCADA or EMS (Energy Management System). True indicates the value exceeded a configured threshold (high/low limit, rate-of-change limit, or deviation alarm). False indicates normal operation. Used to filter alarm-worthy events for operator notification and post-event analysis.
attributes.references: SCADA Alarm Management Standards, NERC TOP-001

attributes.name: alarm_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to this measurement if it triggered an alarm. Critical indicates immediate operator action required (e.g., equipment overload, voltage collapse risk). High indicates urgent attention needed. Medium indicates abnormal condition requiring review. Low indicates informational alarm. Null if alarm_flag is false.

attributes.name: breaker_status
attributes.description: The operational status of a circuit breaker for digital SCADA measurements. Open indicates the breaker is open and the circuit is de-energized. Closed indicates the breaker is closed and the circuit is energized. Intermediate indicates a transitional state during switching. Unknown indicates communication loss or indeterminate status. Critical for outage management, switching order execution, and network topology determination. Null for analog measurements.

attributes.name: contingency_analysis_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement is monitored in the EMS contingency analysis application for N-1 and N-2 reliability assessments. True indicates the measurement is checked against post-contingency limits. False indicates the measurement is not part of contingency monitoring. Used to identify critical telemetry for NERC TPL (Transmission Planning) compliance.

attributes.name: current_angle_degrees
attributes.description: The phase angle of the current phasor in degrees relative to a common time reference. Used in conjunction with voltage angle to calculate power flow direction and power factor. Null for non-current SCADA measurements.

attributes.name: current_magnitude_amperes
attributes.description: The magnitude of the current phasor in amperes for PMU measurements. Represents the RMS current flowing through the monitored line or equipment. Used for real-time loading analysis and thermal limit monitoring. Null for non-current SCADA measurements.

attributes.name: disturbance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement was captured during a grid disturbance event (e.g., fault, generation trip, load rejection, frequency excursion). True indicates the measurement is part of a disturbance data set for NERC PRC-002 (Disturbance Monitoring and Reporting Requirements) compliance and post-event analysis. False indicates normal operation.

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the engineering_value field. Common values include kV (kilovolt), MW (megawatt), MVAR (megavolt-ampere reactive), A (ampere), Hz (hertz), degrees (phase angle), percent (%). Essential for correct interpretation and aggregation of telemetry data.

attributes.name: engineering_value
attributes.description: The measurement value converted to engineering units (e.g., kV for voltage, MW for power, Hz for frequency, degrees for phase angle). attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Data Model, NERC TOP-001

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: The type of grid equipment or network element that this measurement is monitoring. Transformer includes power transformers and autotransformers. Transmission Line includes overhead lines and underground cables. Generator includes generating units. Circuit Breaker includes all switching devices. Capacitor Bank and Reactor are reactive power devices. Bus represents substation buses. Tie Line represents interconnection points between control areas. Used for equipment-specific analytics and asset performance monitoring. attributes.name: frequency_hz
attributes.description: The measured electrical frequency in Hertz at the measurement point. Nominal frequency is 60 Hz in North America or 50 Hz in other regions. Frequency deviations indicate generation-load imbalance and are critical for NERC BAL (Balancing and Frequency) reliability standards compliance and automatic generation control (AGC). Captured by both SCADA frequency transducers and PMUs.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 (Real Power Balancing Control Performance), IEEE C37.118

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp_utc
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when this measurement record was ingested from the OSIsoft PI historian into the analytics lakehouse platform. Distinct from measurement_timestamp_utc (the source event time). Used for data lineage tracking, latency analysis, and identifying data pipeline delays.

attributes.name: limit_violation_type
attributes.description: The type of limit violation that triggered an alarm, if applicable. High indicates the value exceeded the high threshold. Low indicates the value fell below the low threshold. High-High and Low-Low indicate emergency thresholds. Rate-of-Change indicates the value changed too rapidly. None indicates no violation. Used for categorizing alarm events and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008 (Facility Ratings), SCADA Alarm Standards

attributes.name: measurement_category

attributes.name: measurement_source_type

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp_utc
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the telemetry measurement was captured at the source device (RTU or PMU). attributes.name: nerc_region

attributes.description: The NERC regional entity where this measurement was captured. attributes.name: raw_value

attributes.name: source_system

Topology attributes include number of energized buses, open switching devices, topology change flag, and island membership. SSOT for state estimation execution, topology snapshots, and electrical results — used for NERC TOP compliance evidence, post-event voltage profile and network reconstruction analysis, contingency pre-screening, NERC FAC-002 transfer capability studies, and EMS model validation.

attributes.name: closed_switching_device_count

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: de_energized_bus_count
attributes.description: Total number of electrical buses (nodes) in the network topology that are de-energized (out of service) and excluded from the state estimation solution for this execution cycle.

attributes.name: ems_model_version

attributes.name: energized_bus_count
attributes.description: Total number of electrical buses (nodes) in the network topology that are energized and included in the state estimation solution for this execution cycle.

attributes.name: execution_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from state estimation run initiation to solution completion or failure. Used for EMS performance monitoring and capacity planning.

attributes.name: iteration_count
attributes.description: Number of iterative solver cycles executed before the state estimator reached convergence or divergence. High iteration counts may indicate network stress or measurement quality issues.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this state estimation run record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: mvar_mismatch_tolerance
attributes.description: The maximum allowable reactive power mismatch threshold in megavars (MVAR) used as the convergence criterion for the state estimation solver. Critical for voltage stability assessment.
attributes.references: NERC VAR-001 Voltage and Reactive Control

attributes.name: mw_mismatch_tolerance
attributes.description: The maximum allowable active power mismatch threshold in megawatts (MW) used as the convergence criterion for the state estimation solver. Lower values indicate tighter solution accuracy requirements.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: observable_island_count
attributes.description: Number of electrically isolated network islands that have sufficient measurement coverage for state estimation. Each island requires independent solution processing.

attributes.name: open_switching_device_count

attributes.name: operator_override_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) signaling whether a system operator manually overrode state estimation inputs, outputs, or solver parameters during this execution cycle. Used for audit trail and compliance evidence.

attributes.name: operator_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the system operator documenting the business justification for any manual override applied during this state estimation run. Required for NERC compliance and post-event review.

attributes.name: pi_historian_tag_prefix
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI System tag prefix or namespace used to store time-series state estimation results (voltage, angle, flow) in the PI historian for operational analytics and post-event review.

attributes.name: pmu_measurement_count
attributes.description: Total number of synchrophasor measurements from Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) available and processed as inputs to the state estimation algorithm. PMU data provides high-precision time-synchronized voltage and current phasors.

attributes.name: pseudo_measurement_count
attributes.description: Number of pseudo-measurements (synthetic measurements derived from historical load profiles, generation schedules, or forecasts) injected into the state estimation to improve observability in areas with sparse SCADA coverage.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the state estimation solution indicating whether the iterative solver successfully converged to a valid network state, diverged without solution, started from flat conditions, failed due to error, was aborted by operator, or produced partial results.

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the state estimation execution cycle was initiated by the EMS. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the network state was computed.

attributes.name: scada_measurement_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Measurement Count

attributes.name: solution_quality_indicator

attributes.name: system_frequency_hz

attributes.name: thermal_violation_count

attributes.name: topology_change_flag

attributes.name: total_interchange_mw

attributes.name: total_load_mw
attributes.description: Sum of active power load in megawatts (MW) across all load buses included in the state estimation solution. Used for system-wide power balance verification and load forecasting validation.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: total_losses_mw

attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: voltage_violation_count

attributes.description: The ratio of active power to apparent power at this element. Indicates the efficiency of power transfer and reactive power balance.

attributes.name: reactive_power_mvar
attributes.description: The estimated reactive power flow through this branch or injected/consumed at this node in megavolt-amperes reactive. Essential for voltage control and stability.

attributes.name: residual

attributes.name: solution_convergence_flag

products.name: contingency
products.description: Master catalog of defined contingency cases (N-1 and N-2 scenarios) with their analysis execution records and violation results from the EMS contingency analysis (CA) function. Master attributes include contingency name, type (line outage, generator trip, transformer loss, bus fault), elements removed, NERC standard applicability (TPL-001 through TPL-004), and severity classification. Analysis run attributes (grain: one row per CA execution) include run timestamp, parent state estimation run reference, contingencies evaluated count, violations detected, worst-case contingency, solution method (full AC/linear DC), and operator acknowledgment. Violation detail attributes (grain: one row per violation per run) include violated element, violation type (thermal overload %, voltage exceedance kV), pre/post-contingency values, applicable rating, and corrective action status. SSOT for contingency definitions, security assessment execution, and N-1/N-2 violation records used in NERC TPL/TOP compliance evidence and real-time operator situational awareness.

products.description: Individual violation record produced by a contingency analysis run for a specific contingency case. Captures the contingency reference, violated element (line, transformer, bus), violation type (thermal overload % of rating, voltage limit exceedance kV), pre-contingency and post-contingency values, applicable rating (normal/emergency/extreme), and operator corrective action status. SSOT for real-time N-1 security violations used in NERC TPL and TOP reliability reporting.
products.reference: NERC TPL-001 Violation Record

attributes.name: contingency_violation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contingency violation record. Primary key for the contingency violation entity.
attributes.references: NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements

attributes.name: contingency_analysis_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent contingency analysis execution that produced this violation. Links to the specific analysis run timestamp and configuration.

attributes.name: contingency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific contingency scenario (N-1, N-2, etc.) that was simulated and resulted in this violation. Identifies the outage condition tested.
attributes.references: NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the balancing authority responsible for the violated element. Identifies the operational control area where the violation occurred.

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id

The violated_element_reference covers both lines and transformers. A separate FK to power_transformer enables transformer-speci

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Point ID
attributes.description: SCADA telemetry point identifier for the violated element. Links the violation to real-time monitoring data in the SCADA system.

attributes.name: violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation. Business justification: Contingency violations exceeding NERC TPL or FAC thermal/voltage limits must be recorded as compliance violations for enforcement tracking. contingency_violation.nerc_category and corrective_action_st

attributes.name: acknowledged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation alarm has been acknowledged by an operator. True if acknowledged, false if still requiring attention.

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the violation alarm was acknowledged by an operator. Null if not yet acknowledged.

attributes.name: alarm_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the violation alarm in the EMS operator interface. Determines visual and audible alarm presentation to operators.

attributes.name: analysis_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the power flow or stability model used for the contingency analysis. Ensures traceability of analysis results to specific model configurations.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-032 Data for Power System Modeling and Analysis

attributes.name: contingency_case_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the contingency scenario tested (e.g., 'Loss of Line 345-123', 'Generator Unit 5 Trip'). Provides operator-friendly identification of the simulated outage.
attributes.references: NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements

attributes.name: contingency_probability
attributes.description: Estimated probability of the contingency event occurring (0.0 to 1.0). Used for risk-based contingency ranking and prioritization.
attributes.references: NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective actions taken or planned to mitigate the violation (e.g., 'Reduce generation at Unit 3 by 50 MW', 'Open breaker at Station A').

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of operator corrective actions to resolve the violation. Tracks the lifecycle of violation mitigation from detection to resolution.

attributes.name: corrective_action_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when corrective action was initiated or completed by the operator. Null if no action has been taken yet.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this violation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application that generated this violation record (e.g., 'GE EMS', 'Siemens Spectrum PowerOn', 'OSI Monarch'). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: ems_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the EMS or contingency analysis application that generated the violation record (e.g., 'GE PSLF', 'Siemens Spectrum', 'OSI Monarch').

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this violation record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: limit_value
attributes.description: The applicable operating limit threshold that was exceeded (e.g., thermal rating in MW, voltage limit in kV). Defines the boundary of acceptable operation.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits Methodology

attributes.name: nerc_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) Category
attributes.description: NERC TPL planning event category classification (P0 through P7) that this contingency represents. Defines the severity and likelihood of the contingency scenario. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: P0|P1|P2|P3|P4|P5|P6|P7 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for operator comments, analysis notes, or additional context about the violation. Used for post-event review and documentation.

attributes.name: operator_action_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether immediate operator intervention is required to mitigate the violation. True if corrective action is needed, false if informational only.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI historian tag name for the violated element measurement. Enables integration with PI historian for post-event analysis and trending.

attributes.name: post_contingency_value
attributes.description: Simulated or calculated value of the monitored parameter after the contingency event. Represents the stressed system condition that triggered the violation.

attributes.name: pre_contingency_value
attributes.description: Measured or estimated value of the monitored parameter (MW loading, voltage kV, etc.) before the contingency event. Baseline condition for comparison.

attributes.name: rating_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Time duration in minutes for which the applicable rating is valid (e.g., 15-minute emergency rating, 4-hour emergency rating). Null for continuous normal ratings.

attributes.name: rating_type
attributes.description: Classification of the equipment rating that was violated. Identifies whether the violation is against normal, emergency, or extreme operating limits.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the violation was resolved and the system returned to secure operating limits. Null if violation is still active.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score combining violation severity, probability, and impact. Used for prioritizing violations in operator displays and reports.

attributes.name: time_to_violation_seconds
attributes.description: Simulated time in seconds from the contingency event initiation to the violation occurrence. Indicates how quickly the system degrades post-contingency.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the violation values (MW for thermal, kV for voltage, etc.). Provides context for interpreting pre/post-contingency and limit values.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 260.1 Standard Letter Symbols for Units of Measurement

attributes.name: violated_element_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grid element that experienced the violation. Categorizes the equipment type for analysis and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: violation_magnitude
attributes.description: Absolute difference between the post-contingency value and the limit value. Quantifies the extent of the violation in native units (MW, kV, etc.).
attributes.references: NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits Methodology

attributes.name: violation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage by which the post-contingency value exceeds the limit. Calculated as ((post_contingency_value - limit_value) / limit_value) * 100. Used for relative severity assessment.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits Methodology

attributes.name: violation_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the violation based on magnitude and operational impact. Used for prioritization of operator corrective actions.

attributes.name: violation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the contingency violation was detected by the analysis engine. Represents the real-time or study timestamp of the violation occurrence.

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: Category of the limit violation detected. Identifies whether the violation is thermal (loading), voltage (magnitude), or stability-related.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits Methodology

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level in kilovolts of the violated element. Used for categorizing violations by voltage class (transmission vs sub-transmission).

products.name: agc_signal
products.description: Time-series transactional record of Automatic Generation Control (AGC) regulation signals and Area Control Error (ACE) computations for the balancing authority control area. AGC attributes include generating unit reference, base point (MW), regulation raise/lower signal (MW), regulation reserve deployed (MW), and response rate (MW/min). ACE attributes (same time grain) include raw ACE (MW), filtered ACE (MW), 10-minute average ACE, CPS1/CPS2 compliance indicators, frequency bias setting (MW/0.1 Hz), actual system frequency (Hz), scheduled frequency (Hz), and net interchange deviation (MW). Sourced from OSIsoft PI historian AGC and ACE tags. SSOT for all AGC regulation and ACE compliance data — used for NERC BAL-001 CPS1/CPS2 compliance evidence, NERC BAL-003 frequency response obligation, frequency regulation performance tracking, and ancillary services settlement.
products.reference: NERC BAL-001 AGC / OSIsoft PI AGC Tags

attributes.name: agc_signal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the AGC signal record. Primary key for the agc_signal product.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generating unit receiving this AGC regulation signal.

attributes.name: load_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.load_zone. Business justification: AGC regulation signals drive demand response and load control actions in distribution load zones. Linking agc_signal to load_zone enables tracking of which distribution zones respond to AGC regulation

attributes.name: primary_control_area_id
attributes.description: FK to grid.control_area.control_area_id — AGC regulation signals and ACE computations are performed for a specific balancing authority control area. This link is required for NERC BAL-001 CPS1/CPS2 compliance reporting scoped to the correct B

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Point ID
attributes.description: The SCADA system point identifier associated with this AGC signal measurement.

attributes.name: to_control_area_id
attributes.description: FK to grid.control_area.control_area_id — AGC signals and ACE records (now merged) are computed for a specific balancing authority control area. This FK is essential for multi-area operations and NERC BAL compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_frequency_hz
attributes.description: The actual measured system frequency in hertz (Hz) at the time of this AGC signal. Nominal frequency is 60.000 Hz in North America.

attributes.name: agc_mode
attributes.description: The operational mode of the Automatic Generation Control system at the time of this signal. Automatic mode means AGC is actively controlling generation; manual mode means operators are controlling generation manually.

attributes.name: ancillary_service_type
attributes.description: The type of ancillary service being provided by this AGC signal. Regulation services provide continuous balancing, while reserve services provide contingency response.

attributes.name: base_point_mw
attributes.description: The base generation setpoint in megawatts (MW) for the generating unit before AGC regulation adjustment.

attributes.name: cps1_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this AGC signal interval meets NERC CPS1 compliance criteria. CPS1 measures the balancing authority's ability to follow its own generation schedule on a one-minute basis.

attributes.name: cps2_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this AGC signal interval meets NERC CPS2 compliance criteria. CPS2 measures the balancing authority's ability to limit unscheduled power flows on a 10-minute average basis.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this AGC signal record was sourced (e.g., OSIsoft PI, EMS, SCADA).

attributes.name: ems_system_name
attributes.description: The name of the Energy Management System that generated this AGC signal.

attributes.name: filtered_ace_mw
attributes.description: The filtered Area Control Error in megawatts (MW) after applying smoothing algorithms to remove noise and transient spikes.

attributes.name: frequency_bias_setting_mw_per_0_1_hz
attributes.description: The frequency bias setting in megawatts per 0.1 hertz (MW/0.1 Hz) used in the ACE calculation. Represents the balancing authority's expected MW response to a 0.1 Hz frequency deviation.

attributes.name: interconnection_name
attributes.description: The name of the North American electric interconnection to which this control area belongs. The four major interconnections are Eastern, Western, Texas (ERCOT), and Quebec.

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: The NERC regional entity code responsible for reliability oversight of this control area (e.g., WECC, SERC, MRO, NPCC, RF, TRE).

attributes.name: net_interchange_actual_mw
attributes.description: The actual net interchange power flow in megawatts (MW) across all tie lines for the control area at this timestamp.

attributes.name: net_interchange_deviation_mw
attributes.description: The deviation between actual and scheduled net interchange in megawatts (MW). Calculated as (Actual Net Interchange - Scheduled Net Interchange).

attributes.name: net_interchange_scheduled_mw
attributes.description: The scheduled net interchange power flow in megawatts (MW) across all tie lines for the control area at this timestamp.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, annotations, or operational notes related to this AGC signal event.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI historian tag name from which this AGC signal data was sourced. Used for traceability back to the SCADA system.

attributes.name: raw_ace_mw
attributes.description: The unfiltered Area Control Error in megawatts (MW) computed at the same time grain as the AGC signal. Raw ACE = (Actual Net Interchange - Scheduled Net Interchange) - (Frequency Bias Setting) × (Actual Frequency - Scheduled Frequency).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this AGC signal record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this AGC signal record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: regulation_direction
attributes.description: The direction of the regulation signal. Raise indicates the unit should increase generation, lower indicates decrease, neutral indicates no change.

attributes.name: regulation_reserve_deployed_mw
attributes.description: The amount of regulation reserve capacity deployed in megawatts (MW) in response to the AGC signal.

attributes.name: regulation_signal_mw
attributes.description: The AGC regulation signal in megawatts (MW) sent to the generating unit. Positive values indicate raise signal, negative values indicate lower signal.

attributes.name: response_rate_mw_per_min
attributes.description: The rate at which the generating unit responds to the AGC signal, measured in megawatts per minute (MW/min).

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) Code
attributes.description: The code identifying the RTO or ISO responsible for coordinating this control area's operations (e.g., PJM, MISO, CAISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP).

attributes.name: scheduled_frequency_hz
attributes.description: The scheduled target system frequency in hertz (Hz). Typically 60.000 Hz for North American interconnections.

attributes.name: settlement_interval
attributes.description: The settlement interval number within the operating day, used for ancillary services market settlement. Typically 5-minute or 15-minute intervals.

attributes.name: signal_quality_code
attributes.description: Quality indicator for the AGC signal data. Good indicates reliable data, uncertain indicates questionable data, bad indicates invalid data, substituted indicates estimated or replaced data.

attributes.name: signal_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when this AGC signal and ACE computation were recorded. Primary event timestamp for this transactional record.

attributes.name: ten_minute_average_ace_mw
attributes.description: The rolling 10-minute average of Area Control Error in megawatts (MW), used for NERC CPS2 compliance calculations.

attributes.name: unit_response_status
attributes.description: The status of the generating unit's response to the AGC signal. Indicates whether the unit is following the signal as expected.

SSOT for interchange scheduling used in NERC BAL-002 compliance and energy trading settlement.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

products.name: load_forecast
products.description: Operational load forecast records produced by the EMS load forecasting function for the control area. Captures forecast run timestamp, forecast horizon type (hour-ahead, day-ahead, week-ahead), target hour, forecasted system load (MW), weather-adjusted load (MW), temperature input (°F), humidity input (%), forecast model version, and actual load (MW) populated post-interval for accuracy tracking. attributes.name: confidence_level_percentage

attributes.description: The forecast error expressed as a percentage of actual load, calculated as ((actual_load_mw - forecasted_load_mw) / actual_load_mw) * 100, used for model accuracy assessment.

attributes.name: forecasted_load_mw
attributes.description: The predicted system load in megawatts (MW) for the target interval as calculated by the EMS load forecasting model.

attributes.name: humidity_input_percentage
