attributes.description: Timestamp when the frequency excursion event concluded and system frequency returned to acceptable operating range or stabilized.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: event_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the frequency event based on magnitude of frequency deviation, duration, and system impact. Used for prioritization and post-event analysis.

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the frequency excursion event was first detected by the Energy Management System (EMS). Represents the moment system frequency deviated beyond normal operating thresholds.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the frequency event based on the direction of frequency deviation: under-frequency (frequency drop), over-frequency (frequency rise), or frequency oscillation (sustained fluctuation).
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: frequency_deviation_hz
attributes.description: Maximum deviation of system frequency from nominal frequency (typically 60 Hz in North America or 50 Hz elsewhere) during the event, measured in Hertz.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: frequency_response_mw_per_hz
attributes.description: Measured frequency response of the balancing authority in Megawatts per Hertz (MW/Hz), calculated as the change in generation output divided by the change in frequency. Key metric for NERC BAL-003 compliance.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: generation_response_mw
attributes.description: Total generation response in Megawatts (MW) provided by generating units through governor action, Automatic Generation Control (AGC), or manual dispatch to arrest frequency deviation.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: interconnection_name
attributes.description: Name of the North American interconnection where the frequency event occurred: Eastern Interconnection, Western Interconnection, Texas (ERCOT) Interconnection, or Quebec Interconnection.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this frequency event record was last modified or updated with additional information.

attributes.name: load_shed_mw
attributes.description: Total amount of load shed in Megawatts (MW) through UFLS or manual operator actions to restore frequency balance during the event.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-006 Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding

attributes.name: max_rocof_hz_per_second
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Rate of Change of Frequency (ROCOF) (Hz/s)
attributes.description: Maximum rate of change of frequency observed during the event in Hertz per second (Hz/s). Peak ROCOF value used for worst-case analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Standard for Interconnection and Interoperability of Distributed Energy Resources

attributes.name: nadir_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Lowest system frequency in Hertz (Hz) reached during the under-frequency event. Critical metric for assessing severity of frequency decline and system stability.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity with jurisdiction over the balancing authority where the event occurred (e.g., WECC, SERC, MRO, NPCC, RF, TRE).

attributes.name: operator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by system operators documenting observations, actions taken, and contextual information about the frequency event.

attributes.name: peak_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Highest system frequency in Hertz (Hz) reached during an over-frequency event. Used for over-frequency disturbance analysis.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI historian tag name for the frequency measurement time series data associated with this event. Used for detailed post-event analysis and trending.

attributes.name: pre_event_frequency_hz
attributes.description: System frequency in Hertz (Hz) immediately before the disturbance event occurred, representing baseline operating frequency.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: recovery_frequency_hz
attributes.description: System frequency in Hertz (Hz) at the point of stabilization or restoration after the disturbance, indicating the settling point after corrective actions.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: reportable_event_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the frequency event meets NERC EOP-004 criteria for mandatory reporting to regulatory authorities and the Electricity Reliability Organization (ERO).

attributes.name: restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when system frequency was fully restored to normal operating range and all corrective actions were completed.

attributes.name: rocof_hz_per_second
attributes.description: Rate of Change of Frequency measured in Hertz per second (Hz/s). Indicates how rapidly system frequency is changing and is critical for assessing system inertia and disturbance severity.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Standard for Interconnection and Interoperability of Distributed Energy Resources

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a formal root cause analysis has been completed for this frequency event.

attributes.name: triggering_cause
attributes.description: Root cause or initiating event that triggered the frequency excursion. Common causes include generation unit trip, sudden load loss, transmission fault, system islanding, or tie-line trip.

attributes.name: ufls_activated_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Under-Frequency Load Shedding (UFLS) schemes were activated during the event to arrest frequency decline and prevent system collapse.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-006 Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding

attributes.name: ufls_stage_activated
attributes.description: Identifier of the UFLS stage or stages that were activated during the event (e.g., Stage 1, Stage 2). Multiple stages may be activated in severe events.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-006 Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding

products.name: grid_reliability_event
products.description: Transactional record of reportable reliability events as defined by NERC reliability standards (EOP, TOP, BAL), including frequency excursion events. General event attributes include event date/time, event type (disturbance, emergency, unusual occurrence, frequency excursion), NERC standard applicability, affected facilities, initiating cause, MW impact, duration, corrective actions taken, NERC OE-417 report reference, and regulatory submission status. Frequency excursion attributes (event_type=frequency_excursion) include nadir frequency (Hz), recovery frequency (Hz), ROCOF (Hz/s), excursion duration (seconds), triggering cause (generation trip, load loss, islanding), UFLS activation flag, MW of load shed, and restoration timestamp. SSOT for all NERC reliability event reporting including NERC BAL-003 frequency response obligation — distinct from outage records (owned by outage domain) which focus on customer impact.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this operating limit record was last modified. Tracks changes to ratings, limits, or metadata for change management and audit purposes.

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: Category of operating limit being defined: normal MVA rating, emergency MVA rating, voltage upper limit, voltage lower limit, stability limit in MW, or thermal limit in MW. Determines the constraint type enforced by EMS contingency analysis.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008 Facility Ratings, NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits

attributes.name: max_conductor_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable conductor temperature in degrees Celsius before thermal damage, excessive sag, or loss of tensile strength occurs. Typically 75-100°C for ACSR conductors. Defines the thermal constraint for rating calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 738 Standard for Calculating Current-Temperature Relationship of Bare Overhead Conductors

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity responsible for reliability oversight of this transmission element: WECC (Western), ERCOT (Texas), MRO (Midwest), NPCC (Northeast), RF (ReliabilityFirst), SERC (Southeast), SPP (Southwest), or TRE (Texas RE). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|ERCOT|MRO|NPCC|RF|SERC|SPP|TRE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: normal_rating_mva
attributes.description: Normal continuous operating limit in MVA for the transmission element under normal system conditions. This is the baseline capacity used for day-to-day operations and pre-contingency analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, special operating instructions, temporary limit adjustments, or engineering rationale for this operating limit. Used by operators and engineers for situational awareness.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the transmission element and its associated operating limits. In-service limits are actively enforced by EMS; out-of-service limits are inactive due to equipment outages.

attributes.name: operator_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the transmission operator responsible for real-time operation and monitoring of this element and its limits. May differ from owner in joint-use or RTO-operated facilities.
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms, NERC TOP Standards

attributes.name: operator_display_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this operating limit is displayed on EMS operator screens and alarm systems. True means operators receive real-time visibility and alarms for limit violations.

attributes.name: owner_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the transmission asset owner responsible for the physical equipment and its ratings. Used for cost allocation, maintenance responsibility, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI historian tag name for archiving this operating limit time-series data. Enables historical trending, post-event analysis, and integration with asset performance analytics.

attributes.name: rating_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine the operating limit: static (fixed rating), seasonal (varies by season), ambient-adjusted (AAR based on weather), or dynamic (DLR with real-time conductor monitoring). Indicates the sophistication and real-time responsiveness of the rating.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008 Facility Ratings, IEEE 738 Standard for Calculating Current-Temperature Relationship of Bare Overhead Conductors

attributes.name: rating_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this operating limit or dynamic rating was calculated or became effective. For dynamic ratings, this represents the real-time calculation timestamp. Critical for time-series analysis and operational decision-making.

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the RTO or ISO market region in which this transmission element operates. Relevant for market-based congestion management and transmission capacity allocation.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888, NERC Glossary of Terms

attributes.name: season
attributes.description: Season for which this operating limit is applicable. Seasonal ratings account for ambient temperature variations that affect conductor thermal capacity. Year-round indicates a single rating applies across all seasons.

attributes.name: solar_irradiance_w_per_m2
attributes.business_glossary_term: Solar Irradiance Watts Per Square Meter (W/m²)
attributes.description: Solar irradiance in watts per square meter incident on the conductor. Affects conductor heating and is a key input for dynamic line rating calculations, particularly during high solar exposure periods.
attributes.references: IEEE 738 Standard for Calculating Current-Temperature Relationship of Bare Overhead Conductors

attributes.name: stability_limit_mw
attributes.description: Maximum power transfer in MW constrained by system stability considerations (transient stability, voltage stability, or oscillatory stability). Derived from stability studies and enforced to prevent system instability following disturbances.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits, NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements

attributes.name: study_date
attributes.description: Date when the engineering study establishing this operating limit was completed. Used for tracking study vintage and determining when re-studies are required per NERC standards.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-008 Facility Ratings, NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits

attributes.name: to_bus_name
attributes.description: Name of the terminating bus or substation for transmission line or transformer elements. Defines the topology and network connectivity for EMS modeling.
attributes.references: NERC MOD Standards, EMS Network Model

attributes.name: validity_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this operating limit expires or is superseded by a new rating. For dynamic ratings, defines the end of the rating validity window. Null indicates an open-ended validity period.

attributes.name: validity_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this operating limit becomes valid and enforceable in EMS operations. For dynamic ratings, defines the beginning of the rating validity window.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level in kV of the transmission element (e.g., 69 kV, 138 kV, 230 kV, 345 kV, 500 kV). Used for classification, reporting, and determining applicable standards.

attributes.name: voltage_lower_limit_kv
attributes.description: Minimum allowable voltage in kV for the transmission element or bus. Falling below this limit may cause voltage collapse, equipment malfunction, or customer service quality issues. Used by EMS voltage control and contingency analysis.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits, ANSI C84.1 Voltage Ratings

attributes.name: voltage_upper_limit_kv
attributes.description: Maximum allowable voltage in kV for the transmission element or bus. Exceeding this limit may cause equipment damage or insulation breakdown. Used by EMS voltage control and contingency analysis.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits, ANSI C84.1 Voltage Ratings

attributes.name: wind_speed_mph
attributes.description: Wind speed in miles per hour at the transmission element location. Critical input for dynamic line rating calculations as wind cooling significantly increases conductor thermal capacity.
attributes.references: IEEE 738 Standard for Calculating Current-Temperature Relationship of Bare Overhead Conductors

domains.name: trading
domains.description: Wholesale energy trading, power purchase agreements, bilateral contracts, day-ahead and real-time market participation, LMP pricing, scheduling coordinators, ancillary services procurement, and ETRM position management via OpenLink Endur. Manages market settlements, congestion revenue rights, FTR holdings, counterparty credit exposure, REC tracking, and ISO/RTO interface for energy transactions. Supports FERC market reporting and NAESB scheduling.
domains.references: FERC Order 888, NAESB WEQ, FERC EQR, OpenLink Endur

products.name: trade
products.description: Core master record for every wholesale energy trade executed by the utility, capturing bilateral, exchange-traded, and OTC transactions for power, gas, and RECs. Sourced from OpenLink Endur position management. Stores trade type (buy/sell), commodity, quantity in MWh/MMBtu, price, currency, trade date, execution timestamp, trader ID, book, counterparty, and trade status lifecycle (confirmed, amended, cancelled). Includes confirmation workflow tracking: confirmation method (ISDA, broker, electronic), confirmation status, discrepancy details, and counterparty acknowledgment. SSOT for all trade identity and confirmation state within the trading domain.

attributes.name: trade_broker_counterparty_id

attributes.name: collateral_posted
attributes.description: Amount of collateral posted by the counterparty to secure this trade under the master agreement credit provisions.

attributes.name: commodity
attributes.description: The energy commodity being traded: electric power, natural gas, Renewable Energy Certificate (REC), capacity, ancillary services, or Financial Transmission Right (FTR).

attributes.name: confirmation_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used to confirm the trade with the counterparty: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) agreement, broker confirmation, electronic platform, manual process, or exchange clearing.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Status of the trade confirmation workflow: unconfirmed (awaiting counterparty acknowledgment), confirmed (both parties agree), disputed (discrepancy identified), or resolved (dispute settled).

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the trade was confirmed by the counterparty. Null if trade remains unconfirmed.

attributes.name: counterparty_acknowledgment_received

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_exposure_amount
attributes.description: The current credit exposure to the counterparty resulting from this trade, calculated based on mark-to-market valuation and collateral posted. Used for credit risk management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the trade price and settlement amounts.

attributes.name: deal_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the trade as recorded in the Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and counterparty communication.

attributes.name: delivery_end_date
attributes.description: The final date on which physical delivery or financial settlement of the commodity is completed.

attributes.name: delivery_point
attributes.description: Physical or financial location where the commodity is delivered. For power: Pricing Node (PNode) or hub. For gas: pipeline interconnect or city gate.

attributes.name: delivery_start_date
attributes.description: The first date on which physical delivery or financial settlement of the commodity begins.

attributes.name: discrepancy_details
attributes.description: Free-text description of any discrepancies identified during the confirmation process, such as quantity mismatches, price differences, or delivery point errors. Null if no discrepancies exist.

attributes.name: execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the trade was executed in the trading system. Critical for Day-Ahead Market (DAM) and Real-Time Market (RTM) sequencing and audit trails.

attributes.name: ferc_reporting_category

attributes.name: internal_notes

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the trade record was last updated. Tracks amendments, status changes, and data corrections.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls / Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Classification of the market in which the trade was executed: Day-Ahead Market (DAM), Real-Time Market (RTM), term contract, or spot market.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who last modified the trade record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: Unit price of the commodity. For power: dollars per MWh. For gas: dollars per MMBtu. Represents the agreed-upon price at trade execution.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Volume of the commodity traded. For power: Megawatt-hours (MWh). For gas: Million British Thermal Units (MMBtu). For RECs: certificate count.

attributes.name: rec_tracking_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) Tracking System Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Identifier from the regional REC tracking system (e.g., WREGIS, M-RETS, PJM-GATS) for REC trades. Null for non-REC trades.

attributes.name: rec_vintage_year

attributes.references: State RPS Regulations / REC Tracking Systems

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag

attributes.references: FERC Form 552 / State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: Indicates how the trade will be settled: physical delivery of the commodity, financial settlement based on market price, or cash payment.

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the trade calculated as quantity multiplied by price. Represents the gross settlement amount before adjustments.

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the trade was executed and agreed upon by both parties.

attributes.name: trade_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the trade: pending confirmation, confirmed by counterparty, amended after execution, cancelled before settlement, settled and closed, or voided due to error.

attributes.name: trade_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility is buying or selling the commodity in this transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_category
attributes.description: Classification of the trade execution method: bilateral contract, exchange-traded, over-the-counter (OTC), Independent System Operator (ISO) or Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) market, or Power Purchase Agreement (PPA).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the trade quantity is expressed: Megawatt-hour (MWh), Million British Thermal Units (MMBtu), Megawatt (MW), certificates, or rights.

Captures leg type (fixed, floating, physical delivery, financial settlement), notional quantity, price formula, start and end delivery dates, delivery point (PNode/hub), and settlement currency. Supports complex structured products such as swaps, options, and tolling agreements managed in OpenLink Endur.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty entity on the opposite side of this leg. Critical for credit exposure monitoring and settlement.

attributes.name: primary_trade_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent wholesale energy trade transaction that this leg belongs to. A single trade may contain multiple legs representing different delivery periods, pricing structures, or settlement mechanisms.

attributes.name: scheduling_coordinator_id

attributes.name: ancillary_services_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg includes procurement of ancillary services such as regulation, spinning reserves, or voltage support required for grid reliability.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this trade leg was approved for execution by authorized personnel.

attributes.name: approved_by_user

attributes.name: booking_entity

attributes.name: collateral_requirement_amount

attributes.name: congestion_revenue_rights_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of Congestion Revenue Rights or Financial Transmission Rights associated with this leg, used to hedge transmission congestion costs.

attributes.description: The username or identifier of the trader or system user who created this trade leg record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this trade leg record was first created in the Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) system.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_amount

attributes.name: delivery_end_date

attributes.name: delivery_point_hub
attributes.description: The trading hub or aggregated pricing zone for delivery. Hubs represent weighted averages of multiple PNodes and are commonly used in bilateral contracts.

attributes.name: delivery_point_pnode
attributes.description: The specific pricing node or delivery location where physical energy is delivered or financially settled. PNodes are defined by the ISO/RTO and determine locational pricing.

attributes.name: delivery_start_date
attributes.description: The first date on which physical delivery or financial settlement obligations begin for this leg. Critical for scheduling and settlement calculations.

attributes.name: fixed_price
attributes.description: The predetermined price per unit for fixed-price legs. Null for floating-price legs where price is determined by market index or formula.

attributes.name: heat_rate
attributes.description: For tolling agreements or gas-fired generation legs, the heat rate (MMBtu per MWh) used to convert fuel costs to energy pricing. Represents generation efficiency.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this trade leg record was last updated or modified in the ETRM system.

attributes.name: leg_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg represents a buy, sell, receive, or pay position from the utility's perspective. Critical for position management and risk exposure calculation.

attributes.name: leg_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this leg within the parent trade. Used to maintain the chronological or logical order of legs in complex structured products.

attributes.name: leg_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trade leg indicating whether it is active, pending approval, executed, settled, cancelled, or expired.

attributes.name: leg_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trade leg indicating whether it represents a fixed-price obligation, floating-price exposure, physical energy delivery, financial cash settlement, option right, or swap exchange.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Identifies the market in which this leg was transacted: day-ahead market (DAM), real-time market (RTM), bilateral contract, forward market, or futures exchange.

attributes.name: notional_quantity
attributes.description: The contracted volume or capacity for this leg, typically expressed in megawatt-hours (MWh) for energy transactions or megawatts (MW) for capacity products.

attributes.name: option_exercise_style
attributes.description: Defines when the option can be exercised: American (any time before expiry), European (only at expiry), or Bermudan (specific dates). Null for non-option legs.

attributes.name: option_type
attributes.description: For option legs, specifies whether this is a call option (right to buy), put option (right to sell), swaption (option on a swap), or collar (combination). Null for non-option legs.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: The upfront payment made for option legs. Represents the cost of acquiring the option right. Null for non-option legs.

attributes.name: price_formula
attributes.description: Mathematical formula or index reference used to calculate floating prices. May reference LMP (Locational Marginal Price) nodes, market indices, or custom calculation logic for structured products.

attributes.name: price_index_reference
attributes.description: External market price index or benchmark used for floating-price legs. Examples include ISO day-ahead LMP, real-time LMP, or published hub indices.

attributes.name: price_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for pricing, indicating the currency and quantity basis. Typically USD per MWh for energy or USD per MW for capacity products.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The type of wholesale product being traded in this leg: energy (MWh), capacity (MW), ancillary services, transmission rights, RECs, or financial instruments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energy|capacity|ancillary_services|transmission|REC|CRR|FTR — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the notional quantity. Common values include MWh (megawatt-hour) for energy, MW (megawatt) for capacity, and MMBtu for gas-fired generation fuel.

attributes.name: rec_vintage_year
attributes.description: The year in which the renewable energy was generated, determining the vintage of associated RECs. Some RPS programs require specific vintage years.

attributes.name: renewable_energy_certificate_quantity

attributes.name: settlement_currency

attributes.name: settlement_date

attributes.name: settlement_method

attributes.name: strike_price

attributes.name: time_of_use_profile

attributes.name: transmission_rights_included

products.name: position
products.description: Real-time and end-of-day energy trading position record aggregated by book, commodity, delivery period, and delivery point. Tracks net long/short position in MWh or MMBtu, mark-to-market (MtM) value, unrealized P&L, and value-at-risk (VaR) exposure. Captures position valuation snapshots at configurable intervals for trend analysis and intraday risk monitoring. Includes LMP reference data: Locational Marginal Price records by PNode and market interval with energy component, congestion component, and loss component ($/MWh), market type (DAM/RTM/FMM), and ISO source — used for position valuation, settlement price verification, congestion analysis, and hedging strategy support. attributes.name: market_interval_start
attributes.description: The start timestamp of the market interval (typically hourly or sub-hourly) for which this bid applies. Defines the delivery period.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ Standards, ISO/RTO Market Rules

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: The market timeframe for this bid. Day-Ahead Market (DAM) clears one day prior to delivery; Real-Time Market (RTM) clears closer to the operating hour.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this market bid record was last modified. Tracks updates to bid status, awards, schedules, or settlement data.

attributes.name: naesb_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this bid and associated scheduling comply with NAESB WEQ standards for wholesale energy transactions and e-Tag requirements.

attributes.name: procured_mw
attributes.description: The quantity of ancillary service capacity procured through this bid, measured in megawatts. Represents the reserved capacity for grid support.

attributes.name: procurement_price_per_mw_hr
attributes.description: The price paid for procured ancillary services, expressed in dollars per megawatt-hour. Reflects the capacity reservation cost.

attributes.name: rec_tracking_number
attributes.description: The tracking number for Renewable Energy Certificates associated with this bid, if the energy is from renewable sources. Used for RPS compliance and environmental attribute tracking.
attributes.references: State RPS Regulations, REC Tracking Systems

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current status of the physical energy schedule (e-Tag). Tracks progression from submission through ISO confirmation, curtailment events, and expiration.

attributes.name: scheduled_mw_by_interval
attributes.description: JSON or delimited representation of scheduled MW quantities for each sub-interval within the market interval. Captures granular scheduling data for real-time dispatch.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ Standards, ISO/RTO Market Rules

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The total financial settlement amount for this bid after market clearing and final settlement calculations. Includes energy payments, ancillary service payments, and any adjustments.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which financial settlement for this bid was completed by the ISO/RTO or counterparty.

attributes.name: sink_pnode
attributes.description: The sink PNode for the scheduled energy transaction. Identifies the load or withdrawal point for the physical energy flow.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Market Rules, NAESB WEQ Standards

attributes.name: source_pnode
attributes.description: The source PNode for the scheduled energy transaction. Identifies the generation or injection point for the physical energy flow.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Market Rules, NAESB WEQ Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this bid record originated, typically OpenLink Endur ETRM or ISO/RTO market interface systems.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact timestamp when the bid was submitted to the ISO/RTO market. Critical for compliance with market submission deadlines and audit trails.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ Standards, ISO/RTO Market Rules

attributes.description: Date and time when the ISO/RTO issued this market award confirmation. Represents the official award notification time.

attributes.name: award_version
attributes.description: Version number of this award record. Increments with each revision or correction issued by the ISO/RTO. Used for change tracking.

attributes.name: awarded_quantity_mw
attributes.description: Quantity of energy or ancillary service capacity awarded to the resource for the market interval, measured in megawatts (MW). Represents the cleared MW obligation.

attributes.name: awarded_quantity_mwh

attributes.name: minimum_run_time_minutes

attributes.name: must_run_flag

attributes.name: no_load_cost
attributes.description: No-load cost in currency units for operating the resource at minimum output. Used for commitment and settlement calculations.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Specific energy or ancillary service product awarded. ENERGY = energy commodity, REGULATION_UP/DOWN = frequency regulation, SPINNING_RESERVE = synchronized reserve, NON_SPINNING_RESERVE = supplemental reserve, REACTIVE_POWER = voltage support, BLACK_START = restoration service. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ENERGY|REGULATION_UP|REGULATION_DOWN|SPINNING_RESERVE|NON_SPINNING_RESERVE|REACTIVE_POWER|BLACK_START — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ramp_rate_mw_per_minute
attributes.description: Maximum rate at which the resource can change output, measured in MW per minute. Used for dispatch feasibility and scheduling.

attributes.name: self_schedule_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award resulted from a self-schedule (price-taker) bid rather than an economic (price-setter) bid. True = self-schedule, False = economic bid.

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Total financial settlement amount for this award, calculated as awarded_quantity_mwh multiplied by clearing_price_per_mwh. Represents the revenue or cost obligation.

attributes.name: settlement_run_type
attributes.description: Type of settlement calculation run that produced this award record. INITIAL = first settlement, FINAL = final settlement after meter data, RESETTLEMENT = correction run, TRUE_UP = annual reconciliation.

attributes.name: shadow_price
attributes.description: Shadow price of the binding constraint that limited the award quantity. Represents the marginal value of relaxing the constraint.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this award record originated. Typically the ETRM system (e.g., OpenLink Endur) or ISO/RTO interface.

attributes.name: startup_cost
attributes.description: Startup cost in currency units associated with this award if the resource was committed from an offline state. Used for make-whole payments.

attributes.name: trading_date
attributes.description: The operating day for which the energy or ancillary service was awarded. Represents the physical delivery date.

Used for trade valuation, settlement calculations, congestion analysis, and hedging strategy. Sourced from ISO market data feeds.

attributes.name: lmp_loss_component

attributes.description: Unit of measure for the LMP price. Standard is dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh).

attributes.name: pricing_zone_code

attributes.name: publication_timestamp

attributes.name: record_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LMP record became effective in the data warehouse. Used for temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: record_end_timestamp

attributes.name: reference_bus_name

attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which the LMP data was extracted. Typically the ISO/RTO market data feed or ETRM system identifier.

attributes.name: trading_hub_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing node is a designated trading hub. Trading hubs are commonly used reference points for bilateral contracts and financial hedging.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv

attributes.name: nerc_company_code

attributes.name: rtm_participation_flag

attributes.name: sc_code

attributes.name: sc_name

attributes.name: sc_type

attributes.name: scheduling_contact_email

attributes.name: scheduling_contact_name

attributes.name: scheduling_contact_phone

attributes.name: settlement_contact_phone

attributes.name: tax_identification_number

attributes.name: total_registered_capacity_mw

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: energy_schedule

Captures schedule ID, source/sink PNodes, transmission path, scheduled MW by interval, e-Tag reference number, curtailment instructions, and schedule status (submitted, confirmed, curtailed, expired). Supports NAESB e-Tag compliance and real-time dispatch coordination.

attributes.name: energy_schedule_id

attributes.name: der_registry_id

attributes.name: energy_price_id

attributes.name: event_id

attributes.name: forecast_generation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.forecast_generation. Business justification: E-tags and transmission schedules are created based on generation forecasts. Scheduling coordinators use generation forecasts to submit balanced schedules to ISOs/RTOs and avoid imbalance penalties. L

attributes.name: generation_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Energy schedules (e-Tags) must reference the physical generation or load asset for NERC tagging requirements, balancing authority coordination, and transmission reservation validation. Mandatory for i

attributes.name: load_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.load. Business justification: Transmission schedules must account for load forecasts at sink points to ensure adequate delivery and avoid congestion. Schedulers link schedules to load forecasts to optimize transmission path select

attributes.name: load_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.load_zone. Business justification: Energy schedules for distribution-connected DER aggregations are dispatched against specific load zones. Load zone hosting capacity and VVO status constrain DER scheduling. ADMS/ETRM integration requi

attributes.name: market_participant_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to the market participant by the ISO/RTO for this energy schedule. Used for market settlement and reporting.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.planned_outage_window. Business justification: Schedulers coordinate energy schedules with planned transmission/generation maintenance windows to avoid scheduling through de-energized facilities. Required for OASIS posting compliance and day-ahead

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this schedule to a Financial Transmission Right (FTR) position that hedges congestion risk between the source and sink nodes.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to renewable.ppa_contract. Business justification: PPA scheduling: energy schedules for PPA resources reference the contract for delivery point/pnode mapping, minimum/maximum delivery obligations, curtailment rights and compensation, and transmission

attributes.name: primary_energy_scheduling_coordinator_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the scheduling coordinator responsible for submitting and managing this schedule with the ISO/RTO. The SC acts as the interface between market participants and the system operator.

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.storm_event. Business justification: Energy schedules are curtailed during storm events affecting transmission paths and delivery points. Scheduling coordinators track storm impacts for ISO/RTO settlement adjustments, force majeure claim

attributes.name: trade_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this schedule to the underlying energy trading transaction in the Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) system. References the deal or position in OpenLink Endur.

attributes.name: transmission_path_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transmission path or corridor used for this energy schedule. Links to the transmission network topology and Available Transfer Capability (ATC) calculations.

attributes.name: transmission_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transmission service agreement under which this schedule is executed. References the OATT-compliant service reservation.

attributes.name: ancillary_service_type
attributes.description: The type of ancillary service being scheduled, if applicable. Ancillary services support grid reliability and include regulation, reserves, and voltage support.

attributes.name: balancing_authority_code
attributes.description: The four-letter code identifying the NERC-registered Balancing Authority responsible for maintaining load-resource balance for this energy schedule.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or additional context related to this energy schedule.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this energy schedule was confirmed by the ISO/RTO or counterparty, indicating acceptance and readiness for execution.

attributes.name: congestion_charge_usd
attributes.description: The congestion charge in US dollars associated with this energy schedule, calculated based on Locational Marginal Pricing (LMP) differences between source and sink nodes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this energy schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: curtailment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this energy schedule has been subject to curtailment instructions from the transmission operator or ISO/RTO due to system constraints or reliability concerns.

attributes.name: curtailment_mw
attributes.description: The megawatt amount by which this schedule has been curtailed. Represents the reduction from the originally scheduled MW due to transmission constraints or reliability directives.

attributes.name: curtailment_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation of the reason for schedule curtailment, such as transmission congestion, system emergency, or reliability constraint.

attributes.name: curtailment_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the curtailment instruction was issued for this energy schedule.

attributes.name: dynamic_schedule_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a dynamic schedule that allows real-time adjustments to scheduled MW values based on actual generation or load conditions, as opposed to a static schedule with fixed intervals.

attributes.name: etag_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique electronic tag identifier assigned to this energy schedule for transmission system coordination and NERC compliance. The e-Tag is the industry-standard mechanism for scheduling energy transactions across transmission systems.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The duration of each scheduling interval in minutes. Common values are 15, 30, or 60 minutes depending on ISO/RTO market rules.

attributes.name: iso_rto_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Code
attributes.description: The code identifying the ISO or RTO jurisdiction where this energy schedule is executed. Major North American ISOs/RTOs include CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, and SPP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|ERCOT|MISO|PJM|NYISO|ISO_NE|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: loss_factor
attributes.description: The percentage factor representing energy losses during transmission from source to sink. Used to adjust scheduled quantities for line losses.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who last modified this energy schedule record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this energy schedule record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: number_of_intervals
attributes.description: The total count of scheduling intervals covered by this energy schedule. Calculated based on schedule duration and interval length.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: The priority classification of this energy schedule under OATT rules. Firm schedules have higher priority than non-firm during curtailment events.

attributes.name: rec_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) in MWh associated with this energy schedule, if applicable. Used for renewable portfolio standard (RPS) compliance.

attributes.name: rec_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this energy schedule is associated with renewable energy generation and requires Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) tracking for compliance or trading purposes.
attributes.references: EPA RPS Standards, State RPS Programs

attributes.name: schedule_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the scheduled energy delivery ends. Marks the end of the last interval in the schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the scheduled energy delivery begins. Marks the start of the first interval in the schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the energy schedule indicating its operational state in the scheduling workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|confirmed|approved|active|curtailed|expired|cancelled|rejected — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the energy schedule indicating the nature of the transaction: bilateral contract, day-ahead market (DAM), real-time market (RTM), ancillary services, wheel-through transmission, or dynamic schedule.

attributes.name: scheduled_mw
attributes.description: The total megawatt capacity scheduled for delivery in this energy schedule. Represents the aggregate power flow across all intervals.

attributes.name: scheduled_mwh
attributes.description: The total energy quantity in megawatt-hours scheduled for delivery across the entire schedule period. Calculated as the sum of interval-level MWh values.

attributes.name: scheduling_fee_usd
attributes.description: The administrative fee in US dollars charged by the ISO/RTO or scheduling coordinator for processing and managing this energy schedule.

attributes.name: settlement_period
attributes.description: The year-month period (YYYY-MM format) for which this energy schedule will be financially settled by the ISO/RTO or counterparty.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: The current status of financial settlement for this energy schedule. Tracks progression from preliminary to final settlement and any disputes or adjustments.

attributes.name: sink_pnode
attributes.description: The pricing node or location identifier where energy is delivered or withdrawn from the transmission system. Used for Locational Marginal Pricing (LMP) calculations.

attributes.name: source_pnode
attributes.description: The pricing node or location identifier where energy is sourced or injected into the transmission system. Used for Locational Marginal Pricing (LMP) calculations.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this energy schedule was submitted to the ISO/RTO or counterparty for approval and coordination.

attributes.name: transmission_charge_usd
attributes.description: The transmission service charge in US dollars for using the transmission system to deliver energy under this schedule. Based on OATT rates.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who created this energy schedule record in the ETRM system.

products.name: market_settlement
products.description: Unified settlement record for all wholesale energy transaction types within the trading domain: ISO/RTO market settlements (DAM/RTM energy and ancillary services), bilateral OTC trade settlements, PPA contract settlements, FTR congestion revenue settlements, and capacity market settlements. Captures settlement type discriminator, settlement amount ($), quantity (MWh), settlement price, energy imbalance charges, ancillary service charges, congestion charges, loss charges, uplift charges, netting adjustments, payment due date, payment status, settlement interval, ISO statement reference or counterparty invoice reference, dispute status, dispute resolution date, and cumulative P&L tracking. For FTR settlements: congestion revenue earned/owed based on LMP differential, settlement period, and P&L against acquisition cost. Reconciled in OpenLink Endur and feeds accounts receivable/payable. SSOT for all settlement data in the trading domain. Supports FERC market reporting, bilateral contract compliance, and settlement dispute management.
products.reference: ISO/RTO Settlement Statement

attributes.name: market_settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the market settlement record. Primary key for all wholesale energy transaction settlements across ISO/RTO markets, bilateral OTC trades, PPA contracts, FTR congestion revenue, and capacity markets.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying contract or agreement governing this settlement. Applicable for PPA settlements, bilateral contract settlements, and FTR holdings. Null for spot market settlements.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty entity involved in the settlement. For ISO/RTO settlements, this is the ISO/RTO organization; for bilateral trades, this is the trading counterparty; for PPA settlements, this is the power purchase agreement counterparty.

attributes.name: dr_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to demand.dr_event. Business justification: Market settlements reconcile DR event performance payments. Real business process: ISO settlement statements allocating energy and capacity payments for DR dispatch, requiring event linkage for paymen

attributes.name: energy_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.energy_price. Business justification: Settlement price reconciliation compares actual LMPs to forecasted prices for variance analysis and dispute resolution. Settlement analysts link settlements to the price forecasts used for budgeting a

attributes.name: load_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.load_zone. Business justification: Market settlements for DER aggregations are allocated to distribution load zones for cost recovery reporting and distribution planning cost allocation. Utilities use this link in regulatory rate cases

attributes.name: market_award_id
attributes.description: FK to trading.market_award.market_award_id — Settlements reconcile awarded quantities against actuals. The settlement→award FK is required for the settlement reconciliation process and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: market_bid_id
attributes.description: FK to trading.market_bid.market_bid_id — ISO/RTO market settlements must link to the originating market bid/award for settlement verification and dispute resolution. Essential for DAM/RTM settlement reconciliation.

attributes.name: market_participant_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned by the ISO/RTO to the market participant (scheduling coordinator or qualified scheduling entity) for this settlement. Used for ISO/RTO market reconciliation.

attributes.name: outage_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.event. Business justification: Market settlements include force majeure and outage-related adjustments. Unplanned events causing delivery failures require settlement recalculation with event references for dispute resolution, ISO/R

attributes.name: planned_outage_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.planned_outage_window. Business justification: Settlements account for planned outage impacts on delivery obligations. Scheduled maintenance windows affect capacity payments and energy delivery settlements with contractual curtailment provisions p

attributes.name: pnode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.pnode. Business justification: Market settlements are calculated at specific pricing nodes. ISO/RTO settlement statements, congestion charge allocation, and FTR congestion revenue settlement all require node-level settlement record

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to renewable.ppa_contract. Business justification: Financial settlement: market settlements for renewable resources must reference the PPA contract for contract price vs. market price comparison, REC allocation between energy and attributes, capacity

attributes.name: ppa_id
attributes.description: FK to trading.ppa.ppa_id — PPA settlements (now unified in market_settlement) must link back to the PPA contract for delivery reconciliation and invoice generation.

attributes.name: primary_market_trade_id
attributes.description: FK to trading.trade.trade_id — Settlement records must reference the trade they settle for reconciliation, P&L tracking, and audit trail. This is the core settlement→trade linkage in any ETRM system.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Market settlements with disputes or unusual charges trigger regulatory filings including FERC complaints, tariff interpretation requests, and cost recovery proceedings. Regulatory affairs references s

attributes.name: tertiary_market_transaction_trade_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying energy transaction or trade record in the ETRM system that generated this settlement. Links settlement to the originating position or deal.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The financial accounting period (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-03) to which this settlement is allocated for financial reporting purposes. Used for revenue recognition and accounts receivable/payable posting.

attributes.name: ancillary_service_charge_amount
attributes.description: The total charges for ancillary services procured in conjunction with the energy settlement. Includes regulation, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, and voltage support charges as applicable.

attributes.name: capacity_charge_amount
attributes.description: Charges for capacity obligations or capacity market settlements. Represents the cost of securing generation capacity to meet future demand, separate from energy commodity charges.

attributes.name: congestion_charge_amount
attributes.description: The congestion component of the locational marginal price settlement. Represents the cost of transmission congestion between the generation source and the delivery point. May be positive (charge) or negative (credit).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this settlement record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: cumulative_profit_loss_amount
attributes.description: The running cumulative profit or loss for this trading position or contract through this settlement date. Calculated by summing all settlement amounts for the position from inception to current settlement. Used for mark-to-market valuation and position tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this settlement. Typically USD for US markets or CAD for Canadian markets.

attributes.name: delivery_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when energy delivery ended for the transaction being settled. For interval-based settlements, this marks the end of the settlement interval.

attributes.name: delivery_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when energy delivery began for the transaction being settled. For interval-based settlements, this marks the beginning of the settlement interval.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this settlement is currently under dispute. True indicates an active dispute has been raised by either party; false indicates no dispute.

attributes.name: dispute_raised_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement dispute was formally raised. Null if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for the settlement dispute. Captures the business justification for challenging the settlement calculation or amount. Null if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement dispute was resolved and closed. Null if dispute is still open or if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: energy_charge_amount
attributes.description: The base energy charge calculated as settlement quantity multiplied by settlement price. Represents the core energy commodity cost before adjustments for ancillary services, congestion, losses, or uplift.

attributes.name: ftr_congestion_revenue_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Transmission Right (FTR) Congestion Revenue Amount (USD)
attributes.description: Revenue earned or owed from financial transmission right holdings based on the locational marginal price differential between source and sink nodes. Hedges congestion cost exposure in ISO/RTO markets.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this settlement was posted to the general ledger. Null if GL posting has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: gl_posting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this settlement has been posted to the general ledger in the ERP system. True indicates GL posting is complete; false indicates posting is pending.

attributes.name: imbalance_charge_amount
attributes.description: Charges or credits resulting from deviations between scheduled and actual energy delivery. Calculated as the difference between day-ahead schedule and real-time delivery, settled at real-time market prices.

attributes.name: iso_rto_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Code
attributes.description: The code identifying the ISO or RTO market in which the settlement occurred. Applicable only for ISO/RTO market settlements; null for bilateral and PPA settlements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|ERCOT|MISO|PJM|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP|AESO — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this settlement record was most recently updated. Audit trail field for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: loss_charge_amount
attributes.description: The marginal loss component of the locational marginal price settlement. Represents the cost of electrical losses incurred during transmission from generation to load.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that last modified this settlement record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: netting_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Adjustments applied during settlement netting process to reconcile multiple transactions, correct billing errors, or apply contractual netting provisions. May be positive or negative.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which payment was made or received for this settlement. Null if payment is still pending.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment for this settlement must be made or received. Determined by ISO/RTO market rules or bilateral contract payment terms.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment obligation for this settlement: pending processing, scheduled for payment, payment completed, payment received from counterparty, overdue past due date, or defaulted by counterparty.

attributes.name: rec_price_per_certificate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) Price per Certificate (USD)
attributes.description: The unit price in dollars per renewable energy certificate. Applicable when RECs are bundled with energy settlement or traded separately. Null for non-renewable settlements.

attributes.name: rec_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of renewable energy certificates associated with this settlement, measured in MWh-equivalent. Applicable for renewable energy transactions and PPA settlements with REC bundling. Null for non-renewable settlements.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the settlement was calculated and finalized. Represents the principal event timestamp for this transaction header.

attributes.name: settlement_interval_minutes
attributes.description: The duration of the settlement interval in minutes. Typically 5 minutes for real-time market settlements, 60 minutes for day-ahead market settlements, or custom intervals for bilateral contracts.

attributes.name: settlement_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The unit price in dollars per megawatt-hour at which the energy quantity is settled. For ISO/RTO markets, this is the locational marginal price (LMP); for bilateral trades, this is the contract price.

attributes.name: settlement_quantity_mwh
attributes.description: The total quantity of energy settled in megawatt-hours (MWh). Represents the volume of energy delivered or received for which financial settlement is being calculated.

attributes.name: settlement_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the settlement. May be ISO statement reference number, counterparty invoice number, or internal settlement batch identifier depending on settlement type.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the settlement record in the settlement workflow: draft calculation, pending approval, approved for payment, invoiced to/from counterparty, payment completed, under dispute, dispute resolved, or cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|invoiced|paid|disputed|resolved|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: settlement_type
attributes.description: Discriminator identifying the category of wholesale energy transaction being settled: ISO/RTO real-time market energy, ISO/RTO day-ahead market energy, ISO/RTO ancillary services, bilateral over-the-counter trade, power purchase agreement contract, financial transmission right congestion revenue, or capacity market settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iso_rtm_energy|iso_dam_energy|iso_ancillary_service|bilateral_otc|ppa_contract|ftr_congestion_revenue|capacity_market — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The net total settlement amount in US dollars after summing all charge components: energy, ancillary services, congestion, losses, uplift, imbalance, capacity, FTR revenue, and netting adjustments. Positive values indicate amounts owed to the utility; negative values indicate amounts payable.

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: The date on which the underlying energy transaction or trade was executed. For ISO/RTO markets, this is the operating day; for bilateral trades, this is the trade execution date.

attributes.name: uplift_charge_amount
attributes.description: Additional charges allocated by the ISO/RTO to recover costs not captured in the energy and ancillary service prices. Includes make-whole payments, reliability unit commitment costs, and other out-of-market payments.

products.name: counterparty
products.description: Trading counterparty master record for all entities with whom the utility executes wholesale energy trades, PPAs, capacity transactions, or ancillary service agreements. Captures legal entity name, DUNS number, EIC code (for international), FERC EQR counterparty ID, credit rating (S&P/Moody's/Fitch), credit rating date, jurisdiction, ISDA master agreement reference, CSA (Credit Support Annex) reference, netting agreement flag, and counterparty type (generator, marketer, utility, financial institution, municipality, cooperative). SSOT for counterparty identity in the trading domain.
products.reference: ETRM Counterparty Master

products.name: credit_exposure
products.description: Counterparty credit exposure record tracking mark-to-market exposure, potential future exposure (PFE), credit limit, collateral posted, and net exposure for each trading counterparty. Captures exposure as of date, credit limit utilization percentage, margin call threshold, collateral type (cash, letter of credit), and credit breach flag. Supports credit risk management and FERC credit reporting obligations.

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Defines the parent-child structural hierarchy of utility assets, enabling roll-up from component level (e.g., circuit breaker trip coil) to equipment level (e.g., 132kV circuit breaker) to functional location (e.g., substation bay 3) to facility (e.g., Northside 132kV Substation) to network segment (e.g., Northern Transmission Zone). Each hierarchy record captures parent asset reference, child asset reference, hierarchy level, hierarchy type (functional location, linear asset, electrical connectivity), and effective date range. Supports CAPEX/OPEX cost roll-up, condition aggregation, RAB valuation at any hierarchy level, and regulatory reporting by network segment. Aligned with Ventyx Asset Suite functional location structure, SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance hierarchy, and IEC 61968 CIM asset model.
products.reference: Ventyx Asset Suite — Functional Location / SAP PM Functional Location

attributes.name: cost_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of OPEX and CAPEX costs allocated to this hierarchical relationship. Used when a child asset serves multiple parent facilities or network segments and costs must be apportioned. Value between 0.00 and 100.00. Supports regulatory cost allocation and rate case preparation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Cost Allocation Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp

Used for risk-based maintenance prioritization and outage impact analysis.
attributes.references: NERC Transmission Planning Standards; Asset Management Best Practices

attributes.name: depth
attributes.description: Total depth of the hierarchy tree from this relationship to the deepest leaf node. Used for hierarchy complexity analysis and query optimization. Updated when child relationships are added or removed.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchical relationship ended or was superseded. Null for currently active relationships. Supports historical hierarchy reconstruction for regulatory reporting, asset lifecycle analysis, and audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchical relationship became active. Supports temporal hierarchy tracking for asset relocations, network reconfigurations, and organizational restructuring. Used for point-in-time hierarchy queries and historical CAPEX/OPEX roll-up.

attributes.name: functional_location_code
attributes.description: Structured functional location identifier from the enterprise asset management system representing the hierarchical path (e.g., NORTH-SUB132-BAY03-CB01). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance functional location structure and Ventyx Asset Suite location hierarchy. Used for work order assignment, maintenance planning, and cost center allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance Functional Location; Ventyx Asset Suite Functional Location

attributes.name: geographic_zone_code
attributes.description: Geographic or service territory zone identifier for the hierarchical relationship. Used for regional reporting, storm response planning, mutual aid coordination, and geographic cost allocation. Aligns with GIS-based service territory boundaries.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the hierarchy tree structure where level 1 is the top-most parent (e.g., network segment, region) and higher numbers represent deeper nesting (e.g., level 5 might be a component within equipment within a bay within a substation within a zone). Supports depth-based queries and roll-up aggregations.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Functional Location Structure

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hierarchical relationship type. Functional location represents organizational structure (e.g., substation > bay > equipment). Electrical connectivity represents electrical network topology. Linear asset represents sequential physical assets (e.g., transmission line spans). Spatial containment represents physical location nesting. Logical grouping represents business-defined asset groups. System subsystem represents system decomposition.
attributes.references: IEC 61968 CIM Asset Model; Ventyx Asset Suite Functional Location Structure

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy relationship record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used for audit trail, change detection, and incremental data processing.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility_code
