attributes.name: primary_der_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific DER asset being enrolled. Links to the DER registry containing technical specifications, interconnection details, and asset metadata.

attributes.name: settlement_meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the revenue-grade meter used for program settlement calculations, incentive payments, and NEM credit determination. Links to MDM system for interval data retrieval.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1, State Net Metering Rules

attributes.name: tou_rate_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.tou_rate_program. Business justification: DER enrollments in demand response and VPP programs are coordinated with TOU rate programs — customers enrolled in DER programs typically have TOU rates that align dispatch incentives. Linking enables

attributes.name: vpp_configuration_id
attributes.description: FK to renewable.vpp_configuration.vpp_configuration_id — DER enrollments into VPP programs must reference the specific VPP configuration. Critical for dispatch eligibility and aggregation.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment automatically renews at the end of the term. True for evergreen enrollments, false for fixed-term enrollments requiring explicit renewal.

attributes.name: baseline_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the customer baseline load (CBL) for demand response performance measurement. Customer baseline load uses historical consumption patterns, meter-before-meter-after compares pre/post installation, control group uses similar non-participating customers, day-matching uses same-day-type averages, regression uses statistical modeling.
attributes.references: OpenADR 2.0b, ISO/RTO DR Measurement and Verification Standards

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Communication protocol used for telemetry, dispatch commands, and control signals between the DER and DERMS or VPP platform. IEEE 2030.5 (Smart Energy Profile 2.0) for residential, OpenADR 2.0b for commercial DR, DNP3 for utility-scale SCADA integration.

attributes.name: control_endpoint_url
attributes.description: Network endpoint URL for sending dispatch commands, curtailment signals, and control instructions to the DER. Separate from telemetry for security and operational isolation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dispatch_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for dispatch order within the VPP or DERMS portfolio. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for economic dispatch optimization and curtailment sequencing.

attributes.name: enrolled_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Nameplate capacity in kilowatts (kW) enrolled in the program. May be less than the DER's total capacity if partial enrollment is allowed. Used for dispatch calculations, incentive payments, and portfolio aggregation.

attributes.name: enrolled_energy_capacity_kwh
attributes.description: Energy storage capacity in kilowatt-hours (kWh) enrolled for battery storage systems. Represents the usable energy that can be dispatched or charged under program control. Null for non-storage DERs.

attributes.name: enrollment_application_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer submitted the enrollment application. Used for tracking application processing time and program participation trends.

attributes.name: enrollment_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the utility approved the enrollment application and authorized program participation. Used for compliance reporting and customer communications.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the DER was officially enrolled in the program and participation became effective. Used for program term calculations, incentive eligibility, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when enrollment became active and the DER began participating in program dispatch, telemetry, or credit calculations. Critical for real-time market operations and settlement.

attributes.name: enrollment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional enrollment details, special conditions, customer preferences, or operational notes not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the enrollment record. Human-readable unique number used in customer communications, program reporting, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the enrollment. Pending indicates application submitted but not yet approved, active indicates full participation, suspended indicates temporary hold, terminated indicates program exit, opted_out indicates customer-initiated withdrawal, expired indicates term completion.

attributes.name: enrollment_term_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the contractual enrollment term. Null for open-ended enrollments. Used to trigger renewal processes and calculate program participation duration.

attributes.name: enrollment_term_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the contractual enrollment term. May differ from enrollment_date if there is a delay between enrollment and term commencement.

attributes.name: export_limit_kw
attributes.description: Maximum power in kilowatts (kW) that the DER is permitted to export to the grid under the interconnection agreement. Used to enforce dispatch constraints and prevent grid violations.

attributes.name: import_limit_kw
attributes.description: Maximum power in kilowatts (kW) that the DER is permitted to import from the grid for charging (applicable to battery storage systems). Null for generation-only DERs.

attributes.name: incentive_rate_per_kw
attributes.description: Capacity incentive payment rate in dollars per kilowatt of enrolled capacity. Used for calculating monthly or annual capacity payments to program participants.
attributes.references: Program Tariff, State PUC Approved Rates

attributes.name: incentive_rate_per_kwh
attributes.description: Energy incentive payment rate in dollars per kilowatt-hour of dispatched or curtailed energy. Used for calculating performance-based incentive payments.
attributes.references: Program Tariff, State PUC Approved Rates

attributes.name: last_dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent dispatch event or control signal sent to this enrolled DER. Used for monitoring program activity and asset utilization.

attributes.name: last_opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent opt-out event. Used for tracking opt-out patterns and customer engagement analysis.

attributes.name: opt_out_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is permitted to opt out of individual dispatch events or curtailment requests. True for voluntary DR programs, false for firm capacity commitments.
attributes.references: Program Terms and Conditions, FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: opt_out_count
attributes.description: Number of times the customer has opted out of dispatch events during the current enrollment term. Used to enforce opt-out limits and assess program reliability.

attributes.name: opt_out_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of opt-outs allowed per enrollment term. Null if unlimited opt-outs are permitted. Exceeding this limit may result in enrollment suspension or termination.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the program type. Net Energy Metering (NEM) for BTM generation credits, Virtual Power Plant (VPP) for aggregated dispatch, Demand Response (DR) for load curtailment, Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) for compliance tracking, storage incentive for battery programs, or feed-in tariff for fixed-rate purchase agreements.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222, State RPS Statutes, PURPA

attributes.name: rec_issuance_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) Issuance Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether generation from this enrolled DER is eligible for REC issuance under state RPS programs. True for qualifying renewable generation, false for storage-only or non-renewable DERs.
attributes.references: State RPS Statutes, NERC E-Tag Standards

attributes.name: rec_tracking_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) Tracking System ID
attributes.description: Identifier in the regional REC tracking system (e.g., NEPOOL GIS, WREGIS, M-RETS, PJM-EIS) for this enrolled DER. Used for automated REC issuance and retirement tracking.

attributes.name: telemetry_endpoint_url
attributes.description: Network endpoint URL for real-time telemetry data transmission from the DER to the DERMS or VPP aggregator. Used for monitoring generation, state of charge, and operational status.

attributes.name: telemetry_frequency_seconds
attributes.description: Frequency in seconds at which the DER transmits telemetry data to the DERMS or VPP platform. Typical values range from 5 seconds for utility-scale assets to 300 seconds (5 minutes) for residential BTM systems.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment was terminated or the customer exited the program. Null for active enrollments. Used for calculating program participation duration and churn analysis.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for enrollment termination. Customer request indicates voluntary withdrawal, non-compliance indicates failure to meet program requirements, equipment failure indicates technical issues, program closure indicates utility-initiated termination, term expiration indicates natural end of contract, relocation indicates customer moved.

attributes.name: total_dispatch_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of dispatch events or curtailment requests issued to this enrolled DER during the current enrollment term. Used for performance tracking and program evaluation.

attributes.name: total_dispatched_energy_kwh
attributes.description: Cumulative energy in kilowatt-hours (kWh) dispatched or curtailed from this enrolled DER during the current enrollment term. Used for settlement calculations and program impact assessment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: vpp_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status in Virtual Power Plant aggregation programs. Enrolled indicates active participation in VPP dispatch. Not enrolled indicates the resource is not participating. Pending indicates application under review. Suspended indicates temporary removal from dispatch. [Moved from der_registry: This attribute in der_registry represents the enrollment status of a DER in VPP programs, but a single DER can be enrolled in MULTIPLE VPP configurations simultaneously with different statuses. The status belongs to each specific enrollment relationship (DER + VPP combination), not to the DER itself. Moving this to der_enrollment allows tracking distinct enrollment statuses per VPP.]

products.name: incentive_program
products.description: Master record for renewable energy incentive programs administered by the utility or mandated by state/federal regulators. Captures program name, program type (ITC, PTC, SREC, storage incentive, interconnection rebate, green tariff), eligible technology types, incentive rate or structure ($/kW, $/MWh, $/REC), program budget ($), enrollment cap (MW or customers), application window, eligibility criteria, administering agency, and program status. SSOT for renewable incentive program definitions within this domain. Supports program management, budget tracking, and regulatory reporting.
products.reference: DOE / State PUC Incentive Program / IRS ITC/PTC

attributes.name: administering_agency

attributes.name: application_window_end_date

attributes.name: application_window_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the program begins accepting new applications from eligible participants.

attributes.name: budget_expended_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of program budget that has been committed or paid out to date in USD.

attributes.name: budget_remaining_amount

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for program inquiries and application support.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this incentive program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the incentive program expires or is scheduled to close. Null for open-ended programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the incentive program becomes active and begins accepting applications or issuing incentives.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed description of the eligibility requirements for participation in the incentive program, including customer class, technology specifications, interconnection requirements, and geographic restrictions.

attributes.name: eligible_technology_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of renewable energy technology types eligible for this incentive program (e.g., solar_pv, wind, battery_storage, hydroelectric, biomass, geothermal).
attributes.references: State RPS Statute, FERC QF Regulations

attributes.name: enrolled_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total capacity in megawatts (MW) currently enrolled or committed under the incentive program.

attributes.name: enrolled_customer_count

attributes.name: enrollment_cap_customer_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of customers or participants that can enroll in the incentive program. Null if no customer cap applies.

attributes.name: enrollment_cap_mw
attributes.description: Maximum total capacity in megawatts (MW) that can be enrolled in the incentive program. Null if no capacity cap applies.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of funding for the incentive program: ratepayer = utility customer rates, federal_grant = federal government funding, state_grant = state government funding, utility_shareholder = utility equity, carbon_credit = carbon offset revenue, rps_acp = RPS Alternative Compliance Payment funds.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Order, DOE Grant Agreement

attributes.name: incentive_rate_structure
attributes.description: Structure or basis for calculating the incentive payment: per_kw = dollars per kilowatt of capacity, per_mwh = dollars per megawatt-hour of generation, per_rec = dollars per Renewable Energy Certificate, percentage_of_cost = percentage of project cost, fixed_amount = lump sum, tiered = multiple rate tiers based on size or technology.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 48, State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: incentive_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the incentive rate value (e.g., USD_per_kW, USD_per_MWh, USD_per_REC, percent, USD for fixed amounts).

attributes.name: incentive_rate_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the incentive rate corresponding to the rate structure (e.g., 0.25 for $0.25/kW, 30.0000 for 30% of cost).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two or three-letter code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction or state where the incentive program applies (e.g., CA, NY, TX).

attributes.name: maximum_system_size_kw
attributes.description: Maximum renewable energy system capacity in kilowatts (kW) eligible for the incentive. Null if no maximum applies.

attributes.name: minimum_system_size_kw
attributes.description: Minimum renewable energy system capacity in kilowatts (kW) required for eligibility. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which incentive payments are issued to participants: one_time = single upfront payment, monthly/quarterly/annual = recurring payments, per_mwh = payment per unit of generation.

attributes.name: payment_term_years
attributes.description: Number of years over which incentive payments are made for recurring payment structures. Null for one-time payments.

attributes.name: program_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for the incentive program in USD. Used for tracking program expenditures and remaining capacity.
attributes.references: State PUC Budget Order, Utility IRP

attributes.name: program_code

products.name: rps_ppa_contribution
products.description: This association product represents the compliance contribution relationship between RPS obligations and PPA contracts. It captures the specific renewable energy volume (MWh) and RECs that each PPA contract contributes toward satisfying each RPS obligation, including technology-specific carve-out allocations (solar, offshore wind), verification status, and the compliance period during which the contribution applies. Each record links one RPS obligation to one PPA contract with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance contribution relationship. This is the SSOT for demonstrating to state regulators which contracts fulfilled which obligations.. Existence Justification: In renewable energy compliance operations, utilities actively manage a portfolio of PPA contracts to satisfy multiple RPS obligations across different state jurisdictions and compliance years. A single PPA contract contributes renewable energy and RECs to multiple RPS obligations (different states, different years, different carve-out tiers), and each RPS obligation is satisfied by aggregating contributions from multiple PPA contracts. This is a genuine operational M:N relationship that utilities must demonstrate to state regulators through detailed compliance filings.

attributes.name: peer_comparison_percentile
attributes.description: Percentile ranking of this participant performance relative to similar participants in the same program cohort. Used for behavioral DR feedback and social comparison messaging (e.g., You performed better than 75% of your neighbors).

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Calculated penalty amount in local currency assessed against the participant for non-performance or under-performance during the DR event. Applied per contractual terms for interruptible and wholesale market programs.

attributes.name: performance_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of measured curtailment to committed curtailment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.95 for 95% performance). Used to assess participant compliance with contractual obligations and determine penalty or bonus payment eligibility.

attributes.name: response_classification
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the participant response quality based on performance ratio thresholds. Used for behavioral segmentation, program effectiveness analysis, and targeted engagement strategies.

attributes.name: response_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the participant response concluded, either by event completion, restore command, or participant opt-out. Marks the end of the performance measurement window.

attributes.name: response_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the participant began actively responding to the DR event, as measured by load reduction or device state change. Marks the beginning of the performance measurement window.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the financial settlement process for this participant event record. Tracks progression from initial calculation through approval, payment, and any dispute resolution.

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the financial settlement for this participant event was finalized and approved for payment processing. Used for payment reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: target_setpoint_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target setpoint value. Ensures correct interpretation of device control parameters across different resource types.

attributes.name: target_setpoint_value
attributes.description: Target setpoint value commanded to the device during the DR event (e.g., thermostat temperature in degrees, battery discharge rate in kW). Applicable for DLC and VPP resources with adjustable setpoints.

attributes.name: to_dr_enrollment
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_enrollment.dr_enrollment_id — Every participant response must reference the enrollment that authorized participation. Required for incentive eligibility validation and capacity reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this participant event record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes to performance metrics, settlement status, or data quality adjustments.

products.name: load_baseline
products.description: Calculated customer baseline load profile used as the reference point for measuring curtailment during DR events. Stores baseline methodology (e.g., 10-of-10, regression, weather-adjusted), baseline interval values (kWh per 15-min or hourly), calculation date, applicable event window, adjustment factors, and version history. SSOT for M&V baseline data required by ISO/RTO settlement and PUC program reporting.
products.reference: FERC Order 745 Baseline Methodology; ISO/RTO M&V Baseline Protocol

attributes.name: load_baseline_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the load baseline calculation record. Primary key for the load baseline entity.

attributes.name: dr_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific DR event for which this baseline is applicable. Null if this is a standing baseline not tied to a specific event.

attributes.description: Reference to the service premise where the baseline load is measured. Links to the premise master record.

attributes.name: reference_load_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.load_forecast. Business justification: Load baselines are calibrated against load forecasts for the same period to validate baseline accuracy. ISO/RTO M&V methodologies require forecast-to-baseline comparison for weather-adjusted baseline

attributes.name: source_interval_reading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.interval_reading. Business justification: Load baseline is calculated from historical interval readings (baseline_source_days). Linking to the anchor interval_reading record supports audit trails for baseline_methodology validation and regula

attributes.name: superseded_by_baseline_load_baseline_id
attributes.description: Reference to the baseline record that supersedes this one. Null if this is the current active baseline. Used to maintain baseline version history.

attributes.name: adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative adjustment factor applied to the baseline to account for day-of conditions (e.g., weather, operational changes). Typically ranges from 0.8 to 1.2. A value of 1.0 indicates no adjustment.

attributes.name: adjustment_method
attributes.description: The method used to adjust the baseline for day-of conditions. Options include none (no adjustment), additive (add/subtract a fixed amount), multiplicative (apply a scaling factor), weather-normalized (adjust based on weather data), or pre-event-hours (adjust based on load in hours immediately before the event).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baseline was approved for use. Required for regulatory audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who approved this baseline for use in M&V calculations. Required for regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: baseline_calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this baseline load profile was calculated. Used for version control and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: baseline_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this baseline load profile becomes effective for Measurement and Verification (M&V) purposes.

attributes.name: baseline_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this baseline load profile expires and is no longer valid for M&V calculations. Null if the baseline remains valid until superseded.

attributes.name: baseline_load_profile_json
attributes.description: JSON-encoded array of baseline load values (kWh) for each interval within the event window. Each element represents the expected load for a specific time interval. Format: [{"interval_start":"2024-07-15T14:00:00","load_kwh":125.4},{"interval_start":"2024-07-15T14:15:00","load_kwh":128.2}].

attributes.name: baseline_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the customer baseline load. Common methods include 10-of-10 (average of 10 most recent similar days), high-10-of-10 (highest 10 days), mid-8-of-10 (middle 8 of 10), regression-based, weather-adjusted, or customer-specific algorithms approved by the ISO/RTO or PUC.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-012 Demand Response Baseline Standards

attributes.name: baseline_source_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) used as source data for calculating this baseline. Provides traceability to the historical load data used in the calculation.

attributes.name: baseline_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the baseline record. Indicates whether the baseline is in draft, pending approval, approved for use, actively in use, superseded by a newer version, or rejected.

attributes.name: baseline_version
attributes.description: Version number of this baseline calculation. Increments with each recalculation or adjustment. Used for audit trail and historical comparison.

attributes.name: calculation_engine
attributes.description: Name and version of the software system or calculation engine used to compute this baseline (e.g., Oracle MDM Baseline Calculator v3.2, Custom Python Engine v1.5). Used for audit and reproducibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baseline record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score (0-100) indicating the reliability of the input meter data used for baseline calculation. Based on completeness, accuracy, and validation status of interval data.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM VEE (Validation Estimation and Editing)

attributes.name: estimation_method
attributes.description: Method used to estimate missing interval data in the baseline calculation. Options include none (no estimation), linear interpolation, similar-day substitution, regression-based estimation, or carry-forward from previous interval.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM VEE Estimation Rules

attributes.name: event_window_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The end timestamp of the DR event window for which this baseline applies. Defines the conclusion of the curtailment measurement period.

attributes.name: event_window_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The start timestamp of the DR event window for which this baseline applies. Defines the beginning of the curtailment measurement period.

attributes.name: exclusion_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) that were excluded from the baseline calculation due to holidays, prior DR events, or anomalous load conditions.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The duration of each interval in the baseline load profile, typically 15 or 60 minutes. Aligns with AMI meter reading intervals.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM Interval Data Standards

attributes.name: iso_rto_submission_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Submission Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baseline was submitted to the ISO/RTO for settlement. Null if not yet submitted.

attributes.name: iso_rto_submitted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Submitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this baseline has been submitted to the ISO/RTO for settlement purposes. True if submitted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that last modified this baseline record. Required for audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baseline record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes.

attributes.name: missing_interval_count
attributes.description: Number of intervals with missing or invalid meter data that were estimated or excluded from the baseline calculation. Used to assess baseline reliability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, manual adjustments, or exceptions applied during baseline calculation. Used for audit trail and operational transparency.

attributes.name: peak_baseline_demand_kw
attributes.description: The maximum demand (kW) observed in the baseline load profile during the event window. Used for capacity-based DR program settlement.

attributes.name: puc_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this baseline is included in PUC program performance reporting. True if included, False otherwise.
attributes.references: State PUC Demand Response Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: temperature_sensitivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer's load is temperature-sensitive and requires weather-adjusted baseline methodology. True if temperature-sensitive, False otherwise.

attributes.name: to_dr_enrollment
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_enrollment.dr_enrollment_id — Baselines are calculated per enrolled resource. Without this FK, you cannot match baselines to the correct customer enrollment for M&V calculations.

attributes.name: total_baseline_energy_kwh
attributes.description: The sum of all interval baseline load values across the entire event window, expressed in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Used for aggregate curtailment measurement.

attributes.name: weather_station_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the weather station used for weather-adjusted baseline calculations. Links to external weather data sources (e.g., NOAA, local meteorological services).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that created this baseline record. Required for audit trail.

products.name: curtailment_measurement
products.description: Post-event measurement record capturing actual load curtailment achieved by an enrolled resource during a DR event interval. Stores interval-level metered load (kWh/kW), baseline load, calculated curtailment (kW), data source (AMI, SCADA, estimated), validation status, VEE flags, and M&V method applied. Feeds DR settlement, incentive payment calculation, and ISO/RTO performance reporting.
products.reference: Oracle MDM Interval Data; FERC Order 745 Measurement and Verification

attributes.name: baseline_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative adjustment factor applied to the baseline to account for day-of conditions (weather, operational changes). Typically ranges from 0.8 to 1.2. A value of 1.0 indicates no adjustment.

attributes.name: baseline_demand_kw
attributes.description: Calculated baseline power demand in kilowatts (kW) representing what the resource would have demanded absent the DR event. Used as the reference for curtailment calculation.

attributes.name: baseline_load_kwh
attributes.description: Calculated baseline energy consumption in kilowatt-hours (kWh) representing what the resource would have consumed absent the DR event. Calculated using the baseline methodology specified in the DR program rules.

attributes.name: baseline_method_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the baseline calculation methodology applied for this measurement. Common methods include High X of Y (e.g., average of highest 3 of last 10 similar days), Mid X of Y, regression-based, control group, meter-before, or customer-provided baseline.

attributes.name: bid_quantity_kw
attributes.description: The bid quantity in kilowatts (kW) submitted by the resource or aggregator for this DR event interval. May differ from enrolled_capacity_kw if the resource bid a different amount for this specific event.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this curtailment measurement record was first created in the system. Represents the initial calculation or data ingestion time.

attributes.name: curtailment_kw
attributes.description: Calculated load curtailment achieved during the interval in kilowatts (kW). Computed as baseline_demand_kw minus metered_demand_kw. Positive values indicate successful load reduction; negative values indicate load increase.

attributes.name: curtailment_kwh
attributes.description: Calculated energy curtailment achieved during the interval in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Computed as baseline_load_kwh minus metered_load_kwh. Used for settlement and incentive payment calculation.

attributes.name: data_quality_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the quality status of the metered data. ACTUAL indicates raw meter data; ESTIMATED indicates VEE-filled gaps; VALIDATED indicates passed quality checks; SUSPECT indicates potential data issues; MISSING indicates no data received; REJECTED indicates failed validation.

attributes.name: data_source_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source of the metered load data. Values include AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure), SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), MANUAL (manual meter read), ESTIMATED (VEE-estimated), AGGREGATED (sum of multiple meters), or TELEMETRY (real-time sensor data).

attributes.name: enrolled_capacity_kw
attributes.description: The enrolled or nominated load reduction capacity in kilowatts (kW) for this resource during the DR event. Represents the committed curtailment target used for performance evaluation and settlement.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Calculated incentive payment amount in currency for this measurement interval. Computed as settlement_quantity_kw multiplied by incentive_rate_per_kwh and interval duration. Subject to program caps and adjustments.

attributes.name: incentive_rate_per_kwh
attributes.description: The incentive payment rate in currency per kilowatt-hour ($/kWh) applicable to this measurement interval. Rate may vary by time-of-use period, event type, or performance tier.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the measurement interval in minutes. Common values are 5, 15, or 60 minutes depending on ISO/RTO market settlement rules and meter data granularity.

attributes.name: interval_end_timestamp
attributes.description: End timestamp of the measurement interval during the DR event. Defines the boundary of the measurement period for load curtailment calculation.

attributes.name: interval_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Start timestamp of the measurement interval during the DR event. Typically aligned to 5-minute, 15-minute, or hourly intervals per ISO/RTO settlement rules.

attributes.name: iso_rto_market_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Market Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the ISO/RTO wholesale market to which this curtailment measurement is reported for settlement. Values include CAISO, ERCOT, ISONE, MISO, NYISO, PJM, SPP, or NONE for retail-only programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|ERCOT|ISONE|MISO|NYISO|PJM|SPP|NONE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lmp_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The Locational Marginal Price in currency per megawatt-hour ($/MWh) at the resource location during this interval. Used to value the curtailment for wholesale market settlement or avoided cost calculation.

attributes.name: measurement_status_code
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the curtailment measurement record. PRELIMINARY indicates initial calculation; VALIDATED indicates passed M&V review; SETTLED indicates used for payment calculation; DISPUTED indicates under review; ADJUSTED indicates corrected after dispute; FINAL indicates locked for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: metered_demand_kw
attributes.description: Actual power demand measured during the interval in kilowatts (kW). Represents the average or peak demand during the measurement period depending on metering configuration.

attributes.name: metered_load_kwh
attributes.description: Actual energy consumption measured during the interval in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Sourced from AMI meter data, SCADA telemetry, or estimated via Validation Estimation and Editing (VEE) process.

attributes.name: mv_method_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Measurement and Verification (M&V) protocol applied to validate the curtailment calculation. Common protocols include IPMVP Options A-D (International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol) or utility-specific custom methods.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Penalty amount in currency assessed for under-performance or non-compliance during this interval. Applied when actual curtailment falls below minimum performance thresholds defined in the DR program agreement.

attributes.name: performance_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of actual curtailment achieved to the enrolled capacity or bid quantity for this resource during the interval. Calculated as curtailment_kw divided by enrolled_capacity_kw. Values above 1.0 indicate over-performance; below 1.0 indicate under-performance.

attributes.name: reported_to_iso_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement has been reported to the ISO/RTO for wholesale market settlement. True indicates the record was included in the ISO/RTO performance report; False indicates retail-only or not yet reported.

attributes.name: reported_to_iso_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement was submitted to the ISO/RTO for wholesale market settlement. Used for tracking reporting deadlines and settlement cycles.

attributes.name: reported_to_puc_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reported to Public Utility Commission (PUC) Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement has been included in regulatory reporting to the state Public Utility Commission (PUC). True indicates the record was included in DR program performance reports; False indicates not yet reported.

attributes.name: settlement_quantity_kw
attributes.description: The final settled curtailment quantity in kilowatts (kW) used for incentive payment calculation. May differ from curtailment_kw after applying performance thresholds, caps, or adjustments per program rules.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this curtailment measurement record was last modified. Tracks revisions due to data corrections, dispute resolution, or re-calculation with updated baseline methods.

attributes.name: validated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement record was validated and approved for settlement. Marks the transition from preliminary to validated status in the measurement lifecycle.

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting validation findings, data quality issues, adjustments applied, or dispute resolution details for this measurement record. Used for audit trail and M&V documentation.

attributes.name: vee_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the metered data was processed through Validation Estimation and Editing (VEE) logic. True indicates VEE was applied to fill gaps or correct suspect data; False indicates raw meter data was used.

attributes.name: weather_humidity_percent
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage at the resource location during the measurement interval. Used for baseline adjustment in weather-sensitive load profiles.

attributes.name: weather_temperature_f
attributes.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at the resource location during the measurement interval. Used for baseline adjustment and performance analysis. May be sourced from weather station data or utility weather service.

products.name: dr_incentive_payment
products.description: Transactional record of all DR financial settlements and incentive payments, serving as the single authoritative financial record for the demand domain. Covers wholesale market settlement (ISO/RTO capacity and energy payments, LMP-based calculations, performance adjustments, settlement statement references, settlement period reconciliation) and retail-level incentive disbursements (capacity payments, energy payments, performance bonuses, penalty deductions). Captures settlement period, calculation basis, enrolled capacity, measured curtailment, gross and net amounts, aggregator share, utility net cost, payment approval status, disbursement reference, reconciliation status, and ISO/RTO settlement statement cross-reference. SSOT for ALL DR financial obligations — wholesale settlement, retail incentives, aggregator payments, customer disbursements, and settlement reconciliation with wholesale markets.
products.reference: SAP IS-U FICA DR Payment; FERC Order 745 Compensation

attributes.name: actual_load_kw
attributes.description: The measured actual load in kilowatts during the demand response event. Used to calculate curtailment performance.

attributes.name: aggregator_share_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the payment allocated to the aggregator based on the aggregator share percentage.

attributes.name: aggregator_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the gross payment retained by the aggregator as commission for program management and customer enrollment services.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the incentive payment was approved for disbursement by authorized personnel.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who approved this incentive payment for disbursement.

attributes.name: baseline_load_kw
attributes.description: The calculated baseline load in kilowatts representing the customers expected consumption without demand response curtailment. Used for measurement and verification (M&V) calculations.

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: Detailed description of the calculation methodology used for this payment, including baseline calculation method, M&V approach, and rate application logic.

attributes.name: capacity_payment_amount
attributes.description: The calculated capacity payment amount in dollars based on enrolled capacity and capacity rate. Represents payment for availability.

attributes.name: capacity_rate_per_kw
attributes.description: The contracted capacity payment rate in dollars per kilowatt for the enrolled demand response capacity. Basis for capacity payment calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this incentive payment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payment record (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: curtailment_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes that the customer maintained load curtailment during the demand response event.

attributes.name: customer_net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Net payment amount in dollars disbursed to the customer after aggregator share and penalty deductions.

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the incentive payment was disbursed to the customer or aggregator.

attributes.name: disbursement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for the payment disbursement transaction (e.g., check number, wire confirmation, EFT trace number) for reconciliation with financial systems.

attributes.name: energy_curtailed_kwh
attributes.description: Total energy curtailed in kilowatt-hours during the settlement period, calculated as measured curtailment multiplied by duration. Used for energy payment calculations.

attributes.name: energy_payment_amount
attributes.description: The calculated energy payment amount in dollars based on measured curtailment and energy rate or LMP. Represents payment for actual performance.

attributes.name: energy_rate_per_kwh
attributes.description: The contracted energy payment rate in dollars per kilowatt-hour for verified load curtailment. Used for retail-level energy payment calculations.

attributes.name: enrolled_capacity_kw
attributes.description: The committed demand response capacity in kilowatts that the customer or aggregator enrolled for this settlement period. Basis for capacity payments.

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total gross incentive payment amount in dollars before aggregator share and deductions. Sum of capacity, energy, and bonus payments.

attributes.name: iso_rto_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Name
attributes.description: Name of the ISO or RTO wholesale market from which this payment originates (e.g., PJM, CAISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE, MISO, SPP). Null for retail-only programs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this incentive payment record was last updated, reflecting the most recent change to payment status, amounts, or reconciliation status.

attributes.name: lmp_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The locational marginal price in dollars per megawatt-hour at the pricing node (PNode) during the demand response event. Used for wholesale market energy payment calculations.

attributes.name: measured_curtailment_kw
attributes.description: The verified load reduction in kilowatts achieved during the demand response event, calculated as baseline load minus actual load. Basis for energy payments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding special circumstances, adjustments, disputes, or other relevant information about this incentive payment.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the incentive payment is disbursed: bill credit applied to customer account, direct deposit to bank account, physical check, wire transfer, or settlement through aggregator.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for this incentive payment transaction, used for customer communication and payment tracking.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the incentive payment: pending calculation (awaiting M&V), pending approval (awaiting management review), approved (ready for disbursement), disbursed (payment issued), reconciled (matched with wholesale settlement), disputed (under review), or cancelled (voided). attributes.name: payment_type

attributes.name: penalty_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Penalty amount in dollars deducted from payment for non-performance, failure to curtail, or non-compliance with program requirements.

attributes.name: performance_bonus_amount
attributes.description: Additional incentive payment in dollars awarded for exceeding curtailment targets or achieving exceptional performance metrics.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of reconciliation between retail incentive payment and wholesale market settlement: not reconciled, reconciled (matched), variance identified (discrepancy found), under review (investigating), or resolved (variance corrected).

attributes.name: settlement_period_end
attributes.description: End timestamp of the settlement period covered by this incentive payment. Defines the billing cycle or market settlement window.

attributes.name: settlement_period_start
attributes.description: Start timestamp of the settlement period covered by this incentive payment. Aligns with ISO/RTO settlement intervals for wholesale market payments.

attributes.name: settlement_statement_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference to the ISO/RTO wholesale market settlement statement from which this payment originates. Used for reconciliation with wholesale market settlements.

attributes.name: utility_net_cost
attributes.description: Net cost to the utility in dollars for this demand response incentive payment after accounting for wholesale market revenue offsets and ISO/RTO settlements.

attributes.name: maximum_annual_interruption_hours

attributes.name: maximum_curtailment_duration_hours
attributes.description: The maximum duration in hours for a single load curtailment event. Protects the customer from excessively long interruptions.

attributes.name: maximum_events_per_year
attributes.description: The maximum number of discrete curtailment events that the utility may dispatch in a calendar year under this agreement. Limits the frequency of customer disruption.

attributes.name: minimum_curtailment_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The minimum duration in minutes for which a load curtailment event must be sustained once initiated. Ensures operational effectiveness of demand response dispatch.

attributes.name: non_compliance_penalty_rate_per_kw
attributes.description: The penalty rate in dollars per kilowatt ($/kW) assessed when the customer fails to curtail the contracted load during a dispatch event. Enforces contractual compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional terms, conditions, special provisions, or operational notes related to this interruptible tariff agreement.

attributes.name: last_communication_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful communication between the DLC device and the utility control system. Used for device health monitoring and connectivity issue detection.

attributes.name: last_control_event_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the device last responded to a DR control signal. Used for performance verification and device responsiveness tracking.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent maintenance or service activity performed on the device. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling and device reliability tracking.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DLC device record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: max_curtailment_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive minutes the device can be curtailed during a single DR event. Enforces customer comfort limits and program rules.

attributes.name: network_address
attributes.description: IP address, MAC address, or protocol-specific network identifier for the DLC device. Used for device provisioning, network troubleshooting, and security monitoring.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the next preventive maintenance activity is scheduled for the device. Used for field service planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the DLC device. Determines whether the device is available for DR event dispatch and eligible for incentive payments.

attributes.name: opt_out_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is permitted to opt out of individual DR events. Determines event dispatch logic and customer notification requirements.

attributes.name: opt_out_count_ytd
attributes.description: Number of times the customer has opted out of DR events in the current calendar year. Used to enforce program opt-out limits and track customer engagement.

attributes.name: rated_load_kw
attributes.description: Nameplate rated power consumption of the controlled load in kilowatts. Used for calculating total enrolled capacity and expected curtailment during DR events.

attributes.name: security_certificate_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the digital security certificate used for encrypted communication. Critical for maintaining secure command and control of DLC devices.

attributes.name: telemetry_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Frequency in seconds at which the device reports status and operational data. Determines data granularity for M&V and real-time monitoring.

attributes.name: to_dr_enrollment
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_enrollment.dr_enrollment_id — DLC devices are installed at customer premises under a specific DR enrollment. Required for device-to-program mapping during event dispatch.

attributes.name: total_curtailment_hours_ytd
attributes.description: Cumulative hours of load curtailment delivered by this device in the current calendar year. Used for incentive calculation and program impact reporting.

attributes.name: total_events_dispatched_ytd
attributes.description: Total number of DR events this device has been dispatched for in the current calendar year. Used for program performance reporting and customer communication.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty for the DLC device expires. Used for maintenance planning and replacement cost forecasting.

products.name: vpp_dispatch
products.description: Transactional record of a Virtual Power Plant (VPP) dispatch instruction issued to an aggregated portfolio of DERs (batteries, EVs, smart inverters, controllable loads) to provide grid services beyond traditional DR curtailment. Captures dispatch timestamp, service type (energy, capacity, frequency regulation, spinning reserve, voltage support), target MW, ramp rate, dispatch duration, ISO/RTO market product, settlement interval, actual response (MW), DERMS integration reference, and dispatch source (utility, ISO/RTO, aggregator). Distinct from standard DR events as VPP dispatches coordinate bidirectional DER resources for wholesale market products and ancillary services.
products.reference: DERMS VPP Dispatch; FERC Order 2222 DER Aggregation Dispatch

attributes.name: vpp_configuration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the aggregated portfolio of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) that received this dispatch instruction.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the aggregator or DERMS platform acknowledged receipt of the VPP dispatch instruction. Used to track communication latency and dispatch readiness.

attributes.name: actual_mw
attributes.description: Actual measured power response in megawatts (MW) delivered by the VPP portfolio during the dispatch period. Used for measurement and verification (M&V) and settlement calculations.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-032 - Data for Power System Modeling

attributes.name: baseline_mw
attributes.description: Calculated baseline power level in megawatts (MW) representing what the VPP portfolio would have consumed or generated without the dispatch instruction. Used for measurement and verification (M&V) to calculate actual response.
attributes.references: NAESB REQ-021 - Demand Response Measurement and Verification

attributes.name: bidirectional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VPP dispatch instruction utilized bidirectional DER capabilities (both charging and discharging). True for dispatches involving energy storage or vehicle-to-grid (V2G) resources; false for unidirectional load curtailment.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the VPP dispatch instruction was cancelled. Examples include grid condition change, market price change, or operational constraint. Null if the dispatch was not cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction was cancelled before completion. Null if the dispatch was not cancelled.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction was completed and DER resources returned to normal operation. Marks the end of the dispatch lifecycle.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-015 - Wholesale Electric Quadrant Standards

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VPP dispatch met the minimum performance requirements for the contracted service type. True if performance ratio exceeded the compliance threshold; false otherwise. Used for capacity accreditation and penalty assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this VPP dispatch record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: der_count
attributes.description: Number of individual DER assets (batteries, electric vehicles, smart inverters, controllable loads) that participated in this VPP dispatch instruction.

attributes.name: der_response_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of DER assets in the VPP portfolio that successfully responded to the dispatch instruction, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.92 for 92% response rate). Used to assess portfolio reliability.

attributes.name: derms_integration_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS) Integration Reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier linking this VPP dispatch to the corresponding instruction or transaction in the Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). Enables traceability between utility dispatch systems and DER control platforms.

attributes.name: dispatch_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the VPP dispatch instruction in minutes. Calculated as the difference between dispatch end time and dispatch start time.

attributes.name: dispatch_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction expires and DER resources should return to normal operation.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-015 - Wholesale Electric Quadrant Standards

attributes.name: dispatch_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the VPP dispatch instruction, formatted as VPP- followed by 10 digits. Used for external communication with ISO/RTO and aggregators.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-015 - Wholesale Electric Quadrant Standards

attributes.name: dispatch_priority
attributes.description: Priority level of the VPP dispatch instruction. Emergency dispatches override normal operations; high priority dispatches support critical grid conditions; normal and low priority dispatches support economic optimization.

attributes.name: dispatch_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or operational reason for issuing the VPP dispatch instruction. Examples include peak demand management, renewable integration, frequency response, voltage support, or market arbitrage.

attributes.name: dispatch_source
attributes.description: Originating system or entity that initiated the VPP dispatch instruction. Distinguishes between utility Energy Management System (EMS), ISO/RTO market dispatch, aggregator platform, Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS), or manual operator dispatch.

attributes.name: dispatch_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction becomes effective and DER resources should begin responding.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-015 - Wholesale Electric Quadrant Standards

attributes.name: dispatch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VPP dispatch instruction. Tracks progression from issuance through execution to completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|issued|acknowledged|active|completed|cancelled|failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction was issued to the aggregated DER portfolio. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction.

attributes.name: iso_rto_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the ISO or RTO market region where the VPP dispatch is being executed. Examples include CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, and SPP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|ERCOT|MISO|PJM|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lmp_energy_price
attributes.description: Locational Marginal Price for energy at the pricing node during the dispatch interval, expressed in dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh). Used for settlement and revenue calculation.

attributes.name: market_product
attributes.description: Specific wholesale market product or ancillary service that the VPP dispatch is fulfilling. Examples include Day-Ahead Market (DAM) energy, Real-Time Market (RTM) energy, regulation up/down, or operating reserves. Maps to ISO/RTO product definitions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the VPP dispatch. Used to capture non-standard conditions or operator observations.

attributes.name: performance_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of actual MW response to target MW dispatch, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.95 for 95% performance). Used to assess VPP portfolio compliance and reliability for capacity accreditation.

attributes.name: pricing_node
attributes.description: Locational Marginal Price (LMP) node or pricing point where the VPP portfolio is registered and settled in the wholesale market. Used for financial settlement and locational value calculation.

attributes.name: ramp_rate_mw_per_min
attributes.description: Required rate of change in power output in megawatts per minute (MW/min). Specifies how quickly the VPP portfolio must transition from current state to target dispatch level.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 - Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of grid service requested from the VPP portfolio. Includes energy arbitrage, capacity provision, frequency regulation, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, and voltage support. Determines the operational mode and response requirements for the DER fleet.

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Total financial settlement amount in dollars for the VPP dispatch performance. Calculated based on actual MW response, LMP energy price, and applicable market product rates. Used for aggregator and customer incentive payments.

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the settlement amount. Typically USD for North American energy markets.

attributes.name: settlement_interval
attributes.description: Time granularity for measuring and settling the VPP dispatch performance. Aligns with ISO/RTO market settlement intervals (typically 5-minute, 15-minute, or hourly).

attributes.name: target_mw
attributes.description: Target power output or curtailment in megawatts (MW) requested from the VPP portfolio. Positive values indicate generation or discharge; negative values indicate load reduction or charging.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-032 - Data for Power System Modeling

attributes.name: telemetry_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Frequency in seconds at which real-time telemetry data was collected from the VPP portfolio during the dispatch. Typical values range from 1 to 60 seconds depending on service type and ISO/RTO requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this VPP dispatch record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: dr_capacity_registration
products.description: Master record of DR capacity registered with an ISO/RTO or utility capacity market, representing individual customer resources, aggregator portfolios, and VPP resource pools. Captures registration ID, ISO/RTO market, portfolio name, resource type mix (load curtailment, DER, battery, EV), capacity season, registered MW, geographic zone, performance tier and obligation, capacity payment rate ($/MW-day), compliance test results, certification status, registration effective date, portfolio composition details, and aggregator portfolio metadata (ISO/RTO registration ID, resource type mix, total registered capacity). SSOT for wholesale DR capacity positions, aggregator portfolio registrations, VPP resource pools, and ISO/RTO capacity reporting obligations.
products.reference: ISO/RTO DR Capacity Resource Registration; FERC Order 745 Capacity Enrollment

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: baseline_methodology

attributes.name: capacity_obligation_mw

attributes.name: capacity_payment_rate_per_mw_day

attributes.name: certification_date

attributes.name: certification_status
