attributes.name: compliance_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent ISO/RTO compliance test or capacity performance verification test for this registration.

attributes.name: compliance_test_result_mw
attributes.description: Measured demand reduction in megawatts (MW) achieved during the most recent compliance test. Used to validate registered capacity and adjust capacity credits.

attributes.name: compliance_test_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the most recent compliance test. Failed tests may result in capacity derating or registration suspension.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: iso_rto_market
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Market
attributes.description: The ISO/RTO market in which this DR capacity is registered. Determines market rules, capacity auction structure, and performance obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|NYISO|ISO-NE|CAISO|MISO|SPP|ERCOT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: iso_rto_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Registration Identifier
attributes.description: External registration identifier assigned by the ISO/RTO capacity market for this DR resource or portfolio. This is the business identifier used in wholesale market communications and settlements.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this registration record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special conditions, exceptions, or operational details related to this DR capacity registration. Used for operational coordination and issue tracking.

attributes.name: performance_penalty_rate_per_mwh
attributes.description: Penalty rate in dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh) applied for non-performance during ISO/RTO performance assessment hours. Varies by market and performance tier.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Performance classification tier assigned by the ISO/RTO based on historical performance, resource type, and telemetry capabilities (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Emergency-Only). Affects capacity credit and payment rates.

attributes.name: portfolio_composition_json
attributes.description: JSON structure containing detailed composition of the DR portfolio, including individual customer IDs, premise IDs, meter IDs, resource types, and individual capacity contributions. Used for portfolio management and settlement allocation.

attributes.name: portfolio_name
attributes.description: Business name or designation for the DR capacity portfolio. May represent an aggregator portfolio, utility program portfolio, or Virtual Power Plant (VPP) resource pool.

attributes.name: puc_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration must be included in state Public Utility Commission (PUC) demand response program reporting and Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance filings.

attributes.name: registered_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total registered demand response capacity in megawatts (MW) committed to the ISO/RTO capacity market. This is the capacity obligation that must be available during performance periods.

attributes.name: registration_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this DR capacity registration becomes effective and capacity obligations begin. Typically aligns with the start of the capacity delivery season.

attributes.name: registration_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this DR capacity registration expires and capacity obligations end. Typically aligns with the end of the capacity delivery season.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DR capacity registration. Active status is required for capacity payments and dispatch eligibility.

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DR capacity registration structure. Determines reporting obligations, settlement processes, and performance measurement methodologies.

attributes.name: resource_type_mix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or JSON structure describing the mix of resource types in this registration (e.g., load_curtailment, battery_storage, solar_der, ev_charging, chp). Captures the composition of the portfolio for capacity credit calculations.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration was submitted to the ISO/RTO capacity market. Used for tracking registration timelines and auction participation.

attributes.name: submitted_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who submitted this registration to the ISO/RTO. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: telemetry_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Required telemetry reporting interval in seconds (e.g., 4, 10, 60) for real-time performance monitoring. Null if telemetry is not required.

attributes.name: telemetry_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time telemetry data submission to the ISO/RTO is required for this registration. Typically required for Tier 1 performance resources and VPP registrations.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Telemetry Requirements, NERC CIP Standards

attributes.name: to_aggregator
attributes.description: FK to demand.aggregator.aggregator_id — Many capacity registrations are submitted by aggregators. This FK links the registration to the aggregator entity for portfolio management and FERC Order 2222 compliance.

attributes.name: to_program
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_program.dr_program_id — Capacity registrations are made under specific DR programs for ISO/RTO market participation. This FK links the registered capacity to the program for reporting and settlement.

domains.name: outage
domains.description: Outage management including unplanned interruptions, planned maintenance windows, storm response, crew dispatch, restoration prioritization, customer notifications, SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI tracking, and OMS integration. Manages outage events, switching orders, service restoration workflows, and reliability performance reporting. Distinct from grid domain (real-time control) — focuses on event lifecycle and restoration coordination.

products.name: event
products.description: Core master record for every unplanned or planned power interruption event managed by the OMS. Captures the full lifecycle from initial detection (via AMI ping, SCADA alarm, customer call clustering, or predictive model) through final restoration. Includes cause classification, outage type (sustained, momentary, planned, major event per IEEE 1366), affected circuit/feeder, estimated vs. actual restoration time (ETR/ATR), initial prediction metadata (source, confidence, predicted scope, predicted cause, predicted affected segments), source call/report metadata (call receipt timestamp, source type, reported symptom, call disposition, duplicate flag, call clustering results), lifecycle status transitions with full audit trail (status code, transition timestamp, triggering actor, status notes), affected network segment detail (segment identifier, type, de-energization timestamps, isolation method, customer count, restoration sequence priority), SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI contribution, storm flag, Major Event Day declaration status, and OMS event identifier. This is the authoritative SSOT for outage event identity, lifecycle, initial prediction, source reporting, status history, and segment-level impact in the outage domain.
products.reference: OMS Outage Event (GE PowerOn ADMS)

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each outage event record in the OMS. Primary key for the outage_event data product. Serves as the authoritative SSOT identity key for all downstream joins, lineage, and reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Event Entity; IEEE 1366 Outage Event Definition

attributes.name: cause_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.cause. Business justification: The event table stores cause_code (STRING) and cause_description (STRING) as denormalized text fields. The cause table is the authoritative reference for outage cause classifications. Adding cause_id

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Outages within control areas impact ACE, CPS compliance, frequency response obligations, and NERC reporting. Control center operators need to track outage impacts on balancing authority performance me

attributes.name: control_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_center. Business justification: Outage events are operationally managed by a specific control center. NERC TOP/EOP standards require knowing which control center coordinated the outage response. Domain experts expect this link for p

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.der_system. Business justification: Outage events must track DER involvement for root cause analysis, IEEE 1547 compliance verification, fault contribution assessment, and regulatory reporting. OMS systems routinely flag DER-related dis

attributes.name: detecting_ami_head_end_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Detecting Ami Head End Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.ami_head_end. Business justification: Outage events detected via AMI last-gasp must reference the detecting AMI head-end system. event has detection_source (plain text) but no FK. This supports AMI-OMS integration KPI reporting, head-end

attributes.name: forecast_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.zone. Business justification: Outage events occur within forecast zones. Utilities track zone-level outage impacts for load forecast adjustments, reliability index calculations by zone, and regulatory reporting. OMS systems routin

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Outage events must be evaluated against regulatory obligations for NERC/PUC reportability. Compliance officers determine which outages trigger mandatory reporting under specific obligations (NERC EOP,

attributes.name: reliability_index_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.reliability_index_period. Business justification: Connect each outage event to its reporting period for reliability metrics; many events belong to one reliability_index_period.

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulated service territory within which the outage occurred. Used for PUC regulatory reporting, territory-level reliability benchmarking, and rate case support.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Regulations; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent storm or severe weather event record when is_storm_event is True. Links individual outage events to the storm event for aggregate storm impact reporting and mutual aid cost tracking.
attributes.references: State PUC Storm Reporting; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: actual_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: The Actual Time of Restoration (ATR) — the confirmed timestamp when the last affected customer on this outage event was restored to service. Used as the authoritative end time for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI duration calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012; NERC FAC-002; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: affected_customers_commercial
attributes.description: Number of commercial customer service points affected by this outage event. Subset of customers_affected_count. Used for commercial segment reliability reporting and economic impact estimation.

attributes.name: affected_customers_industrial
attributes.description: Number of industrial customer service points affected by this outage event. Subset of customers_affected_count. Used for industrial segment reliability reporting and large-customer impact notifications.

attributes.name: affected_customers_residential
attributes.description: Number of residential customer service points affected by this outage event. Subset of customers_affected_count. Used for customer class-level reliability reporting and equity analysis required by some state PUCs.

attributes.name: caidi_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Average Interruption Duration Index (CAIDI) in Minutes
attributes.description: The Customer Average Interruption Duration Index (CAIDI) for this outage event, representing the average restoration time experienced by affected customers. Calculated as total customer_minutes_interrupted divided by customers_affected_count. Stored at event level for benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 CAIDI Definition; State PUC Annual Reliability Report

attributes.name: call_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer calls or trouble reports received and clustered to this outage event. Used to gauge customer impact severity, prioritize restoration, and assess IVR/call center load during storm events.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle CC&B; GE PowerOn ADMS Call Clustering

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the outage event record was first created in the OMS or Silver layer data product. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA tracking of event creation latency.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: crew_dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the first field crew was dispatched to the outage location. Used to measure dispatch response time (detection_timestamp to crew_dispatch_timestamp) as an operational KPI and for regulatory response time compliance.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Crew Management; State PUC Emergency Response Standards

attributes.name: crew_on_site_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the first field crew arrived on-site at the outage location. Used to measure crew travel time and assess field response performance against SLA targets.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; State PUC Emergency Response Standards; Ventyx Asset Suite

attributes.name: critical_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage event affects one or more critical facilities (hospitals, emergency services, water treatment, telecommunications, or other life-safety infrastructure). True triggers elevated priority and mandatory regulatory notification protocols.
attributes.references: State PUC Critical Facility Notification Requirements; NERC EOP-011; FEMA Critical Infrastructure Protection

attributes.name: customer_minutes_interrupted
attributes.description: Total customer minutes interrupted (CMI) contributed by this outage event, calculated as the sum of interruption duration (minutes) multiplied by customers affected for each restoration segment. Primary input to SAIDI (System Average Interruption Duration Index) calculation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 SAIDI Definition; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer service points (meters) interrupted by this outage event at peak impact. Used as the primary customer impact metric for SAIFI calculation (interruptions per customer) and regulatory reporting to PUC.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 SAIFI Definition; State PUC Reliability Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: The source or mechanism by which the outage was first detected. Supports analysis of detection method effectiveness and AMI/SCADA investment value. Values: ami_ping (AMI outage notification), scada_alarm (SCADA supervisory alarm), customer_call (inbound customer report), predictive_model (ML-based prediction), field_crew (crew observation), smart_meter_outage_notification (last gasp signal).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Oracle Utilities MDM AMI Integration; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world timestamp when the outage event was first detected or reported, regardless of detection source (AMI ping, SCADA alarm, customer call, or predictive model). This is the authoritative event start time used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI duration calculations per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012; NERC FAC-002; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: energy_not_served_mwh
attributes.description: Estimated energy not served (ENS) in MWh due to this outage event, calculated as the product of average load (MW) on the affected circuit and the outage duration (hours). Used for economic impact assessment, IRP planning, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012; NERC FAC-002; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: The Estimated Time to Restoration (ETR) communicated to customers and field crews, representing the predicted date and time by which all affected customers will be restored. Updated dynamically as restoration progresses. Distinct from actual_restoration_timestamp.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS ETR Engine; State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; IEEE 1366-2012

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the outage event within the OMS workflow. Transitions: new (detected, unworked) → in_progress (crew dispatched or switching underway) → restored (all customers re-energized) → closed (event verified and finalized) → cancelled (duplicate or false positive confirmed).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Event Status Workflow; IEEE 1366-2012

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outage event per IEEE 1366 definitions: sustained (interruption > 5 minutes), momentary (≤ 5 minutes), planned (scheduled maintenance), major_event_day (MED per IEEE 1366 beta method), or partial (affecting a subset of customers on a circuit). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sustained|momentary|planned|major_event_day|partial|rolling — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 Standard for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices

attributes.name: fault_location
attributes.description: Descriptive location of the fault or interruption point on the network (e.g., pole number, span identifier, address nearest to fault). Captured from field crew report or automated fault location indicator (FLI) in the ADMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network

attributes.name: initial_call_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the first customer call or report associated with this outage event was received by the Customer Information System (CIS) or IVR. Used for call clustering analysis and detection latency measurement.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle CC&B; State PUC Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: is_major_event_day
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event occurred on a day declared as a Major Event Day (MED) per the IEEE 1366 beta method. MED events are excluded from standard SAIDI/SAIFI calculations and reported separately to PUC. True = MED event; False = normal event.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 Section 4.2 Major Event Day; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: is_storm_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event was caused by or associated with a declared storm or severe weather event. Storm-flagged events may be subject to separate regulatory reporting thresholds and mutual aid activation criteria.
attributes.references: State PUC Storm Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: isolation_method
attributes.description: Method by which the fault was isolated from the network: automatic (protective device operated automatically), manual (field crew operated device manually), remote (SCADA/ADMS remote switching), or flisr_automated (ADMS FLISR automation executed switching sequence).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module; IEEE C37; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event meets NERC reporting thresholds (e.g., EOP-004 disturbance reporting criteria based on MW loss, customer count, or duration). True = event must be reported to NERC/DOE via OE-417 or equivalent.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004 Disturbance Reporting; DOE OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident Reporting

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated customer outage notifications (IVR, SMS, email, or app push) have been sent for this outage event. True = at least one notification batch dispatched. Used for regulatory compliance tracking of customer communication requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; Oracle CC&B Notification Module

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the first customer outage notification was dispatched for this event. Used to measure notification latency from detection and to demonstrate compliance with PUC customer communication time requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; Oracle CC&B

attributes.name: oms_event_code
attributes.description: The externally-known event identifier assigned by the Outage Management System (GE PowerOn ADMS). This is the operational business identifier used by field crews, dispatchers, and customer service representatives to reference the outage event across systems.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Event; NAESB Business Practice Standards

attributes.name: predicted_cause_code
attributes.description: The cause code predicted by the OMS predictive model or ADMS fault analysis engine at the time of initial detection, before field crew investigation. Compared against final cause_code for model accuracy tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weather|equipment_failure|animal_contact|vegetation|human_error|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Predictive Analytics; IEEE 1366-2012

attributes.name: predicted_customers_affected
attributes.description: The number of customers predicted to be affected by the outage at the time of initial detection, as estimated by the OMS/ADMS predictive model. Compared against actual customers_affected_count for model accuracy and ETR calibration.

attributes.name: prediction_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.00–100.00) assigned by the predictive model or ADMS fault analysis engine to the initial outage prediction, including predicted cause and affected scope. Used to assess model reliability and calibrate automated dispatch thresholds.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Predictive Analytics Module

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Restoration priority classification assigned to the outage event, used to sequence crew dispatch and switching operations. Critical: hospitals, emergency services, critical infrastructure; High: large commercial/industrial, high customer count; Medium: standard residential; Low: single-customer or non-critical.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Restoration Prioritization; State PUC Critical Facility Requirements; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: puc_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Reportable Event Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event meets the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) threshold for mandatory individual event reporting (e.g., exceeds customer count or duration thresholds defined in the utility's tariff or service quality rules).
attributes.references: State PUC Service Quality and Reliability Rules; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: reported_symptom
attributes.description: The primary symptom reported by the first customer caller or detected by the AMI/SCADA system at the time of initial report. Used for triage, cause hypothesis, and crew dispatch guidance.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Oracle CC&B Trouble Call Management

attributes.name: saidi_contribution_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Contribution in Minutes
attributes.description: This event's contribution to the System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI), expressed in customer-minutes per total customers served. Calculated as customer_minutes_interrupted divided by total customers served in the reporting period. Stored at event level for regulatory period aggregation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 SAIDI Definition; State PUC Annual Reliability Report

attributes.name: saifi_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) Contribution
attributes.description: This event's contribution to the System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI), expressed as customer interruptions per total customers served. Calculated as customers_affected_count divided by total customers served. Stored at event level for regulatory period aggregation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 SAIFI Definition; State PUC Annual Reliability Report

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the outage event record. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.

products.name: interruption
products.description: Granular record of a single customer or premise-level service interruption linked to a parent outage event or planned maintenance window. Tracks the specific service point, customer account reference, interruption start and end timestamps, duration in minutes, cause code, restoration method (switching, repair, bypass), planned/unplanned flag, notification sent flag, notification channel, critical care designation (medical baseline, life support), restoration confirmation, and association to planned maintenance windows. Also serves as the customer-outage association record capturing per-customer impact including notification delivery status and opt-out preferences. This is the single SSOT for ALL customer-level outage impact — feeds SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI reliability index calculations, supports customer-facing outage communication, drives regulatory customer impact reporting, and provides the definitive record of which customers were affected by each event.
products.reference: Customer Interruption Record (IEEE 1366)

attributes.name: interruption_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a single customer or premise-level service interruption record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 - Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with the interrupted service point at the time of the interruption. Supports customer-facing outage communication and regulatory customer impact reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA; Oracle Utilities CC&B Customer Account

attributes.name: ami_meter_id
attributes.description: The AMI meter identifier associated with the service point at the time of the interruption. Used to correlate last-gasp and first-breath AMI signals from the MDM system for automated interruption detection and restoration confirmation.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; AMI/Advanced Metering Infrastructure Standards; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_service_agreement. Business justification: Individual customer interruptions require service agreement context to apply correct credit calculation rules based on rate schedule, service class, and contractual SLA terms. Enables automated credit

attributes.name: cause_id
attributes.description: FK to outage.cause

attributes.name: crew_dispatch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field crew dispatch record associated with the restoration of this interruption. Links to workforce management for crew response time analysis and restoration efficiency reporting.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.der_system. Business justification: Customer interruptions at DER-equipped service points require DER system reference for islanding analysis, restoration sequencing, and regulatory reporting of DER performance during grid disturbances

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation serving the affected service point at the time of the interruption. Supports substation-level reliability performance reporting and outage root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event that caused this customer-level interruption. Links the granular interruption record to the broader outage event for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI roll-up calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Event Record

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution feeder circuit that serves the affected service point. Supports feeder-level reliability analysis, SAIDI/SAIFI benchmarking by circuit, and GIS-based outage mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: interruption_planned_outage_window_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned maintenance window associated with this interruption, when applicable. Null for unplanned outages. Links to the planned outage schedule for customer notification and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: meter_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.meter_point. Business justification: Interruptions must reference the meter_point (AMI collection point) directly for interval data gap analysis, automated outage detection via AMI, and SAIDI/SAIFI calculations at the meter_point level.

attributes.name: outage_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the switching order executed to isolate or restore the affected circuit segment. Links the customer-level interruption to the operational switching workflow in the ADMS/OMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service delivery point (meter point or premise connection) that experienced the interruption. The fundamental unit of interruption tracking per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; SAP IS-U Device Management; Oracle CC&B Service Point

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: FK to distribution.service_territory

attributes.name: to_planned_outage_window_id
attributes.description: FK to outage.planned_outage_window.planned_outage_window_id — Customer interruptions from planned maintenance link to the planned outage window. Required for distinguishing planned vs unplanned interruptions in reliability reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this interruption record was first created in the system, either by automated OMS event processing or manual dispatcher entry. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: critical_care_type
attributes.description: Specific category of critical care designation for the affected customer. Used to prioritize restoration sequencing and determine notification requirements. Only populated when is_critical_care is true.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Rules; CPUC Rule 14; HIPAA (for health-related designations)

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: Classification of the affected customer by service class at the time of the interruption. Used for segmented SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting by customer class as required by state PUC reliability standards and NERC reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Number of customers affected by the parent outage event at the time this interruption record was created. Denormalized from the outage event for regulatory reporting convenience. Used in SAIFI numerator calculations and NERC/PUC customer impact reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC EOP-004; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the data quality status of this interruption record as assessed during Silver layer validation. 'validated' indicates all timestamps and durations are confirmed; 'estimated' indicates one or more fields are estimated; 'suspect' indicates anomalies detected; 'corrected' indicates the record has been manually revised post-initial capture.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM VEE (Validation, Estimation, and Editing); Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Quality Rules

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the service interruption in whole minutes, calculated as the difference between interruption_end_timestamp and interruption_start_timestamp. Stored as a business field to support SAIDI and CAIDI reliability index calculations without requiring real-time computation. Null if interruption is still active.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC Reliability Reporting; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer's service was restored, recorded to millisecond precision. Null if the interruption is still active. Used as the end point for duration calculations and CAIDI index computation per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Estimated date and time of service restoration communicated to the customer and used for crew scheduling. Distinct from interruption_end_timestamp (actual restoration). Supports customer communication accuracy tracking and ETR (Estimated Time to Restore) performance measurement.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS ETR; State PUC Customer Notification Rules; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: interruption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the interruption record. 'active' indicates the customer is currently without power; 'restored' indicates service has been re-energized; 'cancelled' indicates the interruption was logged in error; 'pending_confirmation' indicates restoration has been initiated but field confirmation is outstanding.

attributes.name: interruption_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interruption as planned (scheduled maintenance), unplanned (forced outage), or momentary (duration less than 5 minutes per IEEE 1366 definition). Drives separate SAIDI/SAIFI/MAIFI index tracking and regulatory reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Section 3; NERC Reliability Reporting; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: is_critical_care
attributes.description: Indicates whether the affected customer or premise is designated as a critical care account (medical baseline, life support equipment, or other medically vulnerable designation). Critical care customers receive priority restoration and mandatory advance notification under state PUC rules.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Rules; CPUC Rule 14; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this interruption record was most recently modified, including status updates, restoration confirmation, or cause code revisions. Supports change tracking and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Change Data Capture

attributes.name: major_event_day_exclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interruption has been formally excluded from the standard SAIDI/SAIFI reliability index calculations under the IEEE 1366 Major Event Day beta method. Distinct from storm_event_flag — this is the formal regulatory exclusion determination.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Section 4.2 Major Event Day Beta Method; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: momentary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interruption qualifies as a momentary interruption (duration less than 5 minutes per IEEE 1366 definition). Momentary interruptions are tracked separately for MAIFI (Momentary Average Interruption Frequency Index) calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Section 3 Momentary Interruption Definition; State PUC MAIFI Reporting

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel used to deliver the outage notification to the affected customer. Supports multi-channel notification analytics and customer preference compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Rules; Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: notification_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted out of outage notifications for this service point. When true, notification_sent will be false by design. Supports customer preference management and regulatory opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Communication Rules; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage notification has been sent to the affected customer for this interruption. Supports regulatory compliance tracking for customer notification requirements mandated by state PUCs.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Rules; Oracle Utilities CC&B Notification

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the outage notification was dispatched to the customer. Used to measure notification lead time relative to interruption start and to demonstrate regulatory compliance with advance notice requirements for planned outages.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Rules; NAESB Business Practices

attributes.name: oms_event_number
attributes.description: The externally-known event number assigned by the Outage Management System (GE PowerOn ADMS) to the parent outage event. Serves as the cross-system integration key for reconciliation between OMS, CIS, and MDM systems.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; SAP IS-U; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: protective_device_operation
attributes.description: Type of protective device that operated to isolate the fault causing this interruption. Supports equipment performance analysis, recloser operation tracking, and fuse-saving vs. trip-and-reclose strategy evaluation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC PRC Standards

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this interruption record, used in customer communications, regulatory filings, and OMS integration. Format: INT-YYYY-NNNNNNNN.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle Utilities CC&B; NERC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interruption must be included in regulatory reliability reports submitted to NERC, FERC, or state PUCs. Interruptions below minimum duration thresholds or excluded under MED rules may be flagged as non-reportable.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; FERC Form 1; State PUC Annual Reliability Reports; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: restoration_confirmation_method
attributes.description: Method by which service restoration was confirmed. AMI ping uses Advanced Metering Infrastructure last-gasp/first-breath signals; field_crew indicates on-site verification; customer_callback indicates customer-reported restoration; scada indicates SCADA system re-energization signal; estimated indicates restoration assumed based on switching operations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; Oracle Utilities MDM; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: restoration_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether service restoration has been confirmed for this interruption, either through AMI meter ping, field crew confirmation, or customer callback. Distinguishes between estimated restoration and verified restoration for CAIDI accuracy.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle Utilities MDM AMI

attributes.name: restoration_method
attributes.description: Method used to restore service to the affected customer or premise. Supports operational analysis of restoration efficiency and crew dispatch effectiveness. attributes.name: saidi_contribution_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Contribution (Minutes)
attributes.description: This interruption's individual contribution to the SAIDI reliability index, expressed in customer-minutes divided by total customers served. Stored as a pre-computed business field to support regulatory reporting aggregation without requiring full recalculation. Null if interruption is active or excluded from SAIDI.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 SAIDI Definition; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: start_timestamp

attributes.name: storm_event_flag

attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Major Event Day (MED) Beta Method; State PUC Storm Reporting Rules

attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; FERC Form 1; IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the time and location of the interruption. Used for weather-normalized reliability analysis, storm response performance reporting, and climate resilience planning. products.name: outage_switching_order
products.description: Formal switching order issued during outage restoration or planned maintenance to reconfigure the distribution network. Captures the complete switching sequence including individual step detail (step sequence number, device identifier, device type, action type — open/close/tag/verify, required safety state, completion status, actual execution timestamp, executing crew member). Also records issuing dispatcher, executing crew, affected switching devices (sectionalizers, reclosers, breakers), safety clearance references, energization/de-energization timestamps, and approval chain. Supports granular audit trail of switching sequences for NERC compliance and post-event analysis. Integrates with GE PowerOn ADMS switching management module.

attributes.description: The confirmed number of customer service points that were interrupted as a result of this switching order, validated post-restoration. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculation and regulatory reporting to State PUCs.

attributes.name: adms_switching_order_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) Switching Order Reference
attributes.description: The native switching order identifier assigned by the GE PowerOn Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse and the operational ADMS source system.

attributes.name: approval_chain_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the approval chain for this switching order, including any conditional approvals, escalations, or deviations from standard authorization procedures. Supports NERC compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the switching order received final authorization from the approving supervisor or operations manager. Part of the approval chain audit trail required for NERC compliance.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this switching order was cancelled, if applicable. Populated only when order_status is 'cancelled'. Supports post-event analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: completed_steps_count
attributes.description: The number of individual switching steps that have been successfully executed and confirmed as of the last update. Enables real-time progress monitoring during active switching operations.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management Module; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this switching order record was first created in the system, which may precede the issued timestamp if the order was drafted in advance. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance customer notification was sent for this switching order (applicable to planned outages). Supports compliance tracking against State PUC advance notification requirements, typically 48-72 hours prior to planned interruption.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; Oracle Utilities CC&B Customer Management

attributes.name: de_energization_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the affected network segment was de-energized (taken out of service) as part of this switching order. Critical for outage duration measurement and SAIDI calculation start point.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: energization_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the affected network segment was re-energized (returned to service) following completion of the switching sequence. Marks the end of the customer interruption for SAIDI/CAIDI calculation.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: estimated_customers_affected
attributes.description: The estimated number of customer service points that will be or are interrupted as a result of this switching order. Used for customer notification prioritization, regulatory reporting, and SAIFI calculation inputs.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: hazard_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing known hazards, special safety precautions, or environmental conditions relevant to executing this switching order. Examples include downed conductors, flooded equipment, or proximity to energized lines. Mandatory review by crew before execution.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; IEEE Std C2 (NESC); NERC CIP-006

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the dispatcher formally issued this switching order to the field crew. This is the principal business event timestamp marking the start of the switching order lifecycle. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this switching order record was most recently modified. Tracks any changes to the order after initial creation, supporting audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching order is associated with an event that meets NERC reportability thresholds (e.g., EOP-004 disturbance reporting). When True, the event must be included in mandatory NERC regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; NERC FAC-001; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: network_segment_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the distribution or transmission network segment affected by this switching order, including feeder name, circuit section, and geographic reference. Supports field crew orientation and post-event reporting.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: oms_incident_number
attributes.description: The incident or trouble call number from the Outage Management System (OMS) associated with this switching order. Enables traceability from the switching sequence back to the originating customer-reported outage or system-detected fault.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Module; State PUC Outage Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the switching order. Tracks progression from initial drafting through dispatcher issuance, field execution, and final completion or cancellation. Drives workflow routing in GE PowerOn ADMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management Module; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the switching order by operational purpose. Distinguishes planned maintenance windows from emergency outage restoration, storm response, load transfer operations, and asset commissioning/decommissioning activities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned_maintenance|emergency_restoration|storm_response|load_transfer|commissioning|decommissioning — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: planned_outage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching order is associated with a planned (scheduled) outage as opposed to an unplanned (forced) interruption. Planned outages are tracked separately for SAIDI/SAIFI reporting and customer advance notification compliance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: post_event_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching order has been flagged for mandatory post-event review, typically triggered by NERC reportable events, major storm response, or switching errors. Drives the post-event analysis workflow.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; NERC FAC-001; State PUC Post-Event Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: post_event_review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text findings and corrective actions documented during the post-event review of this switching order. Populated after review completion when post_event_review_flag is True. Supports continuous improvement and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; NERC FAC-001; State PUC Post-Event Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to this switching order, used for restoration prioritization and crew dispatch sequencing. Critical priority is reserved for transmission-level or large-scale customer impact events.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC TPL-001; State PUC Service Reliability Standards

attributes.name: restoration_method
attributes.description: The method used to restore service as part of this switching order. Distinguishes manual field crew switching from automated ADMS-driven Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration (FLISR), remote switching via SCADA, sectionalizing, or load transfer to alternate feeders.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module; NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: safety_clearance_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the safety clearance (hold tag or clearance order) associated with this switching order. Ensures that de-energized equipment is properly tagged and locked out before crew work begins. Mandatory for OSHA lockout/tagout compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std C2 (NESC)

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time by which the switching sequence is expected to be completed and the network restored to target configuration. Used for outage duration estimation and customer notification.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Customer Notification Requirements

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time for field crew to begin executing the switching sequence. Used for planned maintenance scheduling and crew coordination. May differ from actual execution start time.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching order was issued in response to a major storm or declared emergency event. When True, the associated outage duration may be excluded from IEEE Std 1366 SAIDI/SAIFI calculations per major event day (MED) criteria.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Major Event Day Exclusion Policy; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this switching order was suspended mid-execution, if applicable. Populated only when order_status is 'suspended'. Common reasons include unexpected hazards, equipment failure, or crew safety concerns.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: switching_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the switching order, used by dispatchers, field crews, and control room operators. Format: SO-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. This is the business-facing reference number used in OMS and ADMS systems.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management; NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: switching_purpose_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the operational reason for issuing this switching order, including the specific fault, maintenance activity, or load transfer objective. Provides context beyond the structured order_type classification.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-001; Ventyx Asset Suite

attributes.name: switching_zone
attributes.description: The operational control zone or dispatch territory within which this switching order is executed. Aligns with the utility's geographic service territory divisions used for crew dispatch and reliability performance reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; State PUC Service Territory Definitions

attributes.name: total_steps_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual switching steps defined in this switching order sequence. Used for progress tracking and completeness validation during execution.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management Module; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this switching order, incremented each time the order is revised after initial issuance. Supports audit trail requirements and ensures field crews are executing the most current approved version of the switching sequence.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: The nominal operating voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the network segment affected by this switching order. Determines applicable safety procedures, crew qualifications, and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; IEEE Std C2 (NESC); IEC 60038

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the associated maintenance or repair work order in the asset management system (Ventyx Asset Suite or SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance). Links the switching order to the underlying maintenance activity that necessitated the switching sequence.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: damage_assessment_code

attributes.name: dispatch_location_description
