attributes.description: Date and time the first proactive customer notification was issued for this storm event. Used for PUC compliance reporting on customer communication timeliness.
attributes.references: PUC Customer Notification Rules; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: incident_commander
attributes.description: Name of the designated Incident Commander responsible for overall storm response operations under the Incident Command System (ICS). Used for accountability, communications, and post-storm after-action review.
attributes.references: FEMA Incident Command System (ICS); Utility Emergency Response Plan

attributes.name: is_major_event_day
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storm event qualifies as a Major Event Day (MED) per IEEE 1366-2012 statistical threshold methodology. When True, outages during this event are excluded from SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculations for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 (Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices); PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: is_mutual_aid_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether mutual aid from other utilities or the regional mutual aid group was formally requested for this storm event. Triggers mutual aid tracking, cost allocation, and regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standard EOP-011; Edison Electric Institute (EEI) Mutual Aid Guidelines

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this storm event record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GE PowerOn ADMS Audit Log

attributes.name: med_threshold_saidi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Major Event Day (MED) System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Threshold
attributes.description: The calculated SAIDI threshold value (in minutes per customer) used to determine MED qualification for this event year, per IEEE 1366-2012 beta method. Stored for audit and regulatory verification purposes.

attributes.name: meteorological_end_time
attributes.description: The date and time the weather event physically ended impacting the service territory per NWS or internal meteorological data. Used for IEEE 1366 MED exclusion period boundary calculations.
attributes.references: NWS Storm Data; IEEE 1366-2012 MED Calculation

attributes.name: meteorological_start_time
attributes.description: The date and time the weather event physically began impacting the service territory, as reported by the National Weather Service or internal meteorological data. May precede the declared start time.
attributes.references: NWS Storm Data; IEEE 1366-2012 MED Calculation

attributes.name: mutual_aid_coordinator
attributes.description: Name of the regional mutual aid coordinator organization or agreement (e.g., 'EEI Mutual Aid', 'Southeast Mutual Aid Group') through which external crews were requested.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Aid Guidelines; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: mutual_aid_request_time
attributes.description: Date and time the formal mutual aid request was submitted to the regional mutual aid coordinator or neighboring utilities. Null if no mutual aid was requested.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Aid Guidelines; NERC EOP-011; PUC Storm Reporting

attributes.name: nerc_event_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Event Type
attributes.description: NERC event classification code for mandatory regulatory reporting. EEA1/EEA2/EEA3 indicate Emergency Energy Alert levels; MEA indicates a Misoperation Event Alert; OE417 indicates a DOE Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report filing requirement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EEA1|EEA2|EEA3|MEA|OE417|other|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC Event Analysis Guidelines; DOE OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident Reporting; FERC Order 830

attributes.name: nws_storm_code
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by the National Weather Service (NWS) to the weather event, used to cross-reference official meteorological data, storm tracks, and NWS storm reports for regulatory and insurance purposes.
attributes.references: NOAA/NWS Storm Data Publication; NERC Event Analysis

attributes.name: oe417_filing_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Energy (DOE) OE-417 Filing Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storm event meets the threshold requiring a DOE OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report filing. Triggered when 50,000+ customers are affected or critical infrastructure is impacted.
attributes.references: DOE OE-417 Reporting Requirements; NERC Event Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: oe417_filing_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the DOE OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report was submitted for this storm event. Null if filing not required or not yet submitted.
attributes.references: DOE OE-417 Reporting Requirements; NERC Event Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: peak_customers_affected
attributes.description: Maximum number of customers simultaneously without power at any point during the storm event. Key metric for regulatory reporting, mutual aid justification, and public communications. Sourced from OMS outage aggregation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; PUC Storm Reporting; NERC Event Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: puc_notification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Utility Commission (PUC) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storm event requires formal notification to the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) per state-specific emergency reporting thresholds (e.g., >10% of customers affected or extended outage duration).
attributes.references: State PUC Emergency Reporting Rules; NERC Event Analysis

attributes.name: puc_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the formal notification was submitted to the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) for this storm event. Null if notification not required or not yet submitted.

attributes.name: response_activation_level
attributes.description: Numeric level (1–5) indicating the severity of the storm response activation, where Level 1 is routine and Level 5 is maximum emergency mobilization. Determines staffing, resource deployment, and executive notification thresholds.
attributes.references: Utility Emergency Response Plan (ERP); NERC CIP-014; FEMA Incident Command System (ICS)

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the storm response operation. Drives workflow routing in OMS and determines whether mutual aid, crew dispatch, and cost tracking are active.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Workflow; NERC Event Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: storm_cost_reference
attributes.description: Reference code linking this storm event to the corresponding cost collection object in SAP S/4HANA (e.g., WBS element, internal order, or cost center) for storm cost tracking, regulatory cost recovery filings, and OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance (CO Module); PUC Storm Cost Recovery Proceedings; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: storm_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the storm event (e.g., 'Hurricane Ida', 'Winter Storm Uri', 'Derecho 2023-07'). Used for communications, regulatory reporting, and historical reference.
attributes.references: National Weather Service (NWS) Storm Naming Conventions; NERC Event Analysis

attributes.name: storm_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and situational awareness comments entered by storm coordinators during the event lifecycle. Captures key decisions, escalations, and observations not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Utility Emergency Response Plan

attributes.name: storm_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the storm event, used in OMS, regulatory filings, and mutual aid coordination. Format: STM-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC Event Analysis Guidelines

attributes.name: storm_to_outage_events
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — A storm event groups multiple outage events under coordinated response. This parent-child link is essential for storm response management and MED calculations.

attributes.name: storm_type
attributes.description: Classification of the weather event type driving storm response operations. Determines response protocols, mutual aid triggers, and IEEE 1366 Major Event Day (MED) classification criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hurricane|ice_storm|derecho|tornado|heat_event|winter_storm|thunderstorm|flood|wildfire|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 (Power Systems Reliability Indices); NWS Storm Classification Standards

attributes.name: total_customer_interruptions
attributes.description: Cumulative count of individual customer interruption events associated with this storm, accounting for customers who experienced multiple outages. Used in SAIFI calculation inputs for IEEE 1366 reporting.

attributes.name: total_outage_events
attributes.description: Total number of discrete outage events (trouble calls, switching events, fault isolations) grouped under this storm event in the OMS. Used for storm complexity assessment and resource planning.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; NERC Event Analysis

products.name: mutual_aid_request
products.description: Record of a mutual aid request issued to or received from neighboring utilities during large-scale storm response or major outage events. Captures requesting utility, responding utility, request date, crew type and count requested, crew type and count committed, mobilization date, demobilization date, ESOP (Emergency Support Operations Plan) reference, and cost reimbursement tracking flag. Supports NERC EOP mutual aid obligations and storm recovery coordination.
products.reference: Mutual Aid Agreement (NERC EOP-011 / ESOP)

attributes.name: mutual_aid_request_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the mutual aid request record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3 (Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements); IEEE 1366

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Mutual aid requests are scoped to the requesting utility's control area, which defines the geographic and operational boundary of the emergency. NERC ESOP and regional mutual aid agreements are organi

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outage event that triggered this mutual aid request. Links the aid request to the specific storm, major outage, or emergency event driving the need for external resources.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS event record; NERC EOP-005-3

attributes.name: primary_storm_event_id
attributes.description: FK to outage.storm_event.storm_event_id — Mutual aid requests are issued in context of a storm event. Must link to parent storm for coordination and cost tracking.

attributes.name: weather_input_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.weather_input. Business justification: Mutual aid deployment decisions require weather forecast data to determine crew mobilization timing, staging locations, and resource quantities. Weather severity forecasts justify mutual aid requests

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the responding utility formally acknowledged receipt of the mutual aid request. Used to measure response time SLA compliance.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; ESOP response time standards

attributes.name: actual_cost_usd
attributes.description: Actual total cost in US dollars incurred for the mutual aid deployment upon demobilization, as submitted by the responding utility for reimbursement. Populated after demobilization and cost reconciliation.
attributes.references: FERC cost recovery rules; EEI Mutual Assistance Program; SAP S/4HANA AP/AR settlement

attributes.name: affected_customers_count
attributes.description: Number of customers without power at the time the mutual aid request was issued. Provides context for the scale of the outage event and justifies the level of external resource request.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC EOP-005-3; State PUC reporting requirements

attributes.name: arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the responding utility's crews arrived at the staging area or work location within the requesting utility's service territory and became available for restoration work.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; ESOP staging and logistics

attributes.name: commitment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the responding utility formally committed to providing the requested resources, transitioning the request from acknowledged to committed status.

attributes.name: cost_reimbursement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the requesting utility has agreed to reimburse the responding utility for costs incurred during the mutual aid deployment. True = reimbursable; False = non-reimbursable (goodwill aid). Drives cost tracking and invoice generation workflows.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; EEI Mutual Assistance Program cost reimbursement guidelines; FERC cost recovery rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this mutual aid request record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; internal data governance policy

attributes.name: crew_count_committed
attributes.description: Number of crew units actually committed by the responding utility. May be less than crew_count_requested if the responding utility has limited available resources.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; ESOP resource commitment

attributes.name: crew_count_deployed
attributes.description: Actual number of crew units that physically arrived and performed restoration work in the requesting utility's territory. May differ from committed count due to last-minute changes or attrition during transit.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; ESOP deployment tracking

attributes.name: crew_count_requested
attributes.description: Number of crew units (typically crew trucks or work teams) requested from the responding utility. A crew unit typically consists of a truck and associated personnel per ESOP standards.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; ESOP resource quantification

attributes.name: crew_type_committed
attributes.description: Classification of crew type actually committed by the responding utility. May differ from crew_type_requested if the responding utility can only provide a partial or alternative resource match. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: line_crew|tree_crew|damage_assessment|substation|transmission|logistics — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; ESOP crew classification standards

attributes.name: crew_type_requested
attributes.description: Classification of crew type requested by the requesting utility (e.g., line crew, tree trimming crew, damage assessment crew, substation crew, transmission crew, logistics crew). Drives resource matching in ESOP coordination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: line_crew|tree_crew|damage_assessment|substation|transmission|logistics — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; ESOP crew classification standards

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the responding utility's crews completed their assignment and were released to return to their home utility. Marks the end of active mutual aid deployment.

attributes.name: equipment_count_committed
attributes.description: Number of equipment units of the specified type actually committed by the responding utility.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; ESOP resource commitment

attributes.name: equipment_count_requested
attributes.description: Number of equipment units of the specified type requested from the responding utility.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; ESOP resource quantification

attributes.name: equipment_type_requested
attributes.description: Type of specialized equipment requested alongside crews, such as bucket trucks, digger derricks, cable pullers, generators, or mobile command units. Supplements crew type in resource matching.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; ESOP equipment classification

attributes.name: esop_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: ESOP (Emergency Support Operations Plan) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Emergency Support Operations Plan (ESOP) or mutual aid agreement under which this request is issued. Ties the request to the governing bilateral or regional aid compact.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; Edison Electric Institute (EEI) Mutual Assistance Program

attributes.name: estimated_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated total cost in US dollars for the mutual aid deployment, including labor, equipment, lodging, and travel expenses. Used for budget planning and pre-authorization of reimbursable aid.
attributes.references: FERC cost recovery rules; EEI Mutual Assistance Program; SAP S/4HANA cost management

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the weather or emergency event that triggered the mutual aid request. Used for post-event analysis, NERC regulatory reporting, and storm response benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hurricane|ice_storm|tornado|wildfire|flood|earthquake|major_outage|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; FEMA National Incident Management System (NIMS); IEEE 1366

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current status of the cost reimbursement invoice associated with this mutual aid request. Tracks the financial settlement lifecycle from invoice submission through payment or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AR/AP; FERC cost recovery; EEI Mutual Assistance Program

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this mutual aid request record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and Silver Layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; internal data governance policy

attributes.name: mobilization_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which the committed crews and resources depart from the responding utility and begin travel to the requesting utility's service territory.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; EEI Mutual Assistance Program; ESOP mobilization procedures

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this mutual aid request must be reported to NERC under EOP-005-3 or other applicable reliability standards. True = reportable event requiring NERC submission.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; NERC Rules of Procedure Section 1600

attributes.name: nerc_submission_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) Submission Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this mutual aid event was submitted to NERC for regulatory reporting. Null if nerc_reportable_flag is False or submission is pending.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; NERC Rules of Procedure Section 1600

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or coordination details associated with the mutual aid request. May include staging instructions, safety briefing requirements, or special equipment needs.

attributes.name: oms_event_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier from the Outage Management System (GE PowerOn ADMS) for the outage event associated with this mutual aid request. Enables traceability between the aid request and the OMS event record.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS integration; NERC EOP-005-3

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the mutual aid request, reflecting the severity of the outage event and urgency of resource need. Drives dispatch sequencing when multiple requests compete for limited responding utility resources.

attributes.name: regional_mutual_aid_group
attributes.description: Name of the regional mutual aid compact or group under which this request is coordinated (e.g., Southeast Electric Exchange, Mid-Atlantic Mutual Aid Group, Midwest Mutual Aid Group). Identifies the regional coordination framework.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; NERC EOP-005-3; regional ESOP compacts

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the mutual aid request was formally submitted by the requesting utility. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the request lifecycle.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the mutual aid request, used in inter-utility communications, ESOP documentation, and regulatory reporting. Format: MAR-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; ESOP (Emergency Support Operations Plan) standard numbering

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the mutual aid request, tracking progression from initial submission through crew mobilization, active deployment, and final demobilization or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|acknowledged|committed|active|demobilized|cancelled|closed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this utility is the requesting party (outbound — this utility is seeking aid from a neighbor) or the responding party (inbound — this utility is providing aid to a neighbor).
attributes.references: NERC EOP-005-3; ESOP bilateral aid agreements

attributes.name: requesting_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary operational contact at the requesting utility responsible for coordinating the mutual aid request and managing incoming crews.
attributes.references: ESOP contact management; EEI Mutual Assistance Program

attributes.name: requesting_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the primary operational contact at the requesting utility. Used for real-time coordination during storm response.
attributes.references: ESOP contact management; EEI Mutual Assistance Program

attributes.name: requesting_utility_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the utility that is requesting mutual aid resources. Identifies the party in need of crew or equipment support during a major outage or storm event.

attributes.name: requesting_utility_nerc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requesting Utility NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) ID
attributes.description: NERC-assigned registered entity identifier for the requesting utility, used for regulatory reporting and inter-utility coordination under NERC EOP standards.

attributes.name: responding_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary operational contact at the responding utility responsible for coordinating crew dispatch and resource commitment.
attributes.references: ESOP contact management; EEI Mutual Assistance Program

attributes.name: responding_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the primary operational contact at the responding utility. Used for real-time coordination during crew mobilization.
attributes.references: ESOP contact management; EEI Mutual Assistance Program

attributes.name: responding_utility_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the utility that is committing resources in response to the mutual aid request. Identifies the aid-providing party.

attributes.name: responding_utility_nerc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Responding Utility NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) ID
attributes.description: NERC-assigned registered entity identifier for the responding (aid-providing) utility, used for regulatory reporting and inter-utility coordination.

attributes.name: service_territory_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the primary service territory where restoration work will be performed. Used for jurisdictional compliance, state PUC reporting, and logistics planning.
attributes.references: State PUC regulatory reporting; NERC EOP-005-3

attributes.name: staging_location
attributes.description: Name or address of the staging area designated for incoming mutual aid crews within the requesting utility's service territory. Used for logistics coordination and crew check-in management.
attributes.references: ESOP staging and logistics procedures; EEI Mutual Assistance Program

products.name: reliability_index_period
products.description: Periodic reliability performance record capturing computed SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI index values for a defined reporting period (monthly, quarterly, annual) at a given reporting level (system, circuit, substation, PUC territory). Stores total customer minutes interrupted, total interruptions, customers served, MED-excluded values, and IEEE 1366 normalized values. This is the authoritative operational record — NOT an analytics aggregate — used for PUC regulatory filings and NERC reliability reporting.
products.reference: SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI Reporting (IEEE 1366 / PUC Annual Reliability Report)

attributes.name: reliability_index_period_id
attributes.description: Primary key for reliability_index_period

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: SAIDI/SAIFI reliability indices are computed and reported per control area for NERC BAL and PUC regulatory filings. The control area is the primary reporting boundary for reliability performance. Doma

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting is mandated by specific PUC obligations with defined performance thresholds and filing deadlines. Regulatory affairs maps each reporting period to the governing obligation

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.zone. Business justification: Reliability indices (SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI) are calculated and reported by forecast zone for state PUC regulatory compliance and performance benchmarking. Forecast zones define geographic reporting boun

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for amending or recomputing this reliability index period record (e.g., data correction from OMS, reclassification of MED events, customer count correction). Required for version_number greater than 1. Supports regulatory audit trail and PUC amendment filing documentation.
attributes.references: State PUC Amendment Reporting Requirements; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the authorized utility employee (typically a Reliability Engineer or Director of Grid Operations) who approved this reliability index period record for regulatory filing. Supports SOX internal control documentation and regulatory audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 906 (Management Certification); State PUC Audit Requirements; NERC Compliance

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reliability index period record was formally approved for regulatory filing. Supports SOX internal control audit trails and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; State PUC Audit Requirements; NERC Compliance Documentation

attributes.name: caidi_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Average Interruption Duration Index (CAIDI) in Minutes
attributes.description: Customer Average Interruption Duration Index expressed in minutes per interruption. Computed as total_customer_minutes_interrupted divided by total_customer_interruptions (equivalently, SAIDI divided by SAIFI). Represents the average duration of each interruption experienced by affected customers. Used to assess restoration performance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.3; NERC Reliability Standards; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: caidi_normalized_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: IEEE 1366 Normalized CAIDI (Excluding Major Event Days) in Minutes
attributes.description: CAIDI value computed after excluding Major Event Day (MED) interruptions per IEEE 1366 normalization methodology. Derived from normalized SAIDI and SAIFI values. Used for PUC performance standard compliance and restoration performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Performance Standards

attributes.name: computation_method
attributes.description: Identifies the specific computational methodology applied to derive the reliability indices in this record. IEEE_1366_STANDARD applies the full IEEE 1366 methodology including MEDs; IEEE_1366_MED_EXCLUDED applies the normalized MED-excluded methodology; PUC_CUSTOM applies a state-specific PUC-mandated variation; NERC_BENCHMARK applies NERC benchmarking methodology.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reliability index period record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: customers_served
attributes.description: Total number of customers served within the reporting entity boundary during the reporting period. This is the denominator used in SAIDI and SAIFI index calculations per IEEE 1366. Typically represents the average or end-of-period customer count as defined by the applicable PUC methodology.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.1; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: equipment_failure_outage_events
attributes.description: Number of outage events during the reporting period caused by equipment failure (excluding storm and third-party causes). Supports asset reliability analysis, maintenance planning, and capital investment justification for aging infrastructure programs.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reliability index period record was most recently modified. Tracks amendments, recomputations, and corrections to the reliability indices. Supports audit trail and regulatory amendment documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; State PUC Amendment Reporting Requirements; IEEE Std 1366-2012

attributes.name: maifi_index
attributes.description: Momentary Average Interruption Frequency Index computed as total momentary customer interruptions divided by customers served. Measures the frequency of brief power interruptions (five minutes or less) per customer. Increasingly required by PUCs as a power quality metric alongside SAIDI and SAIFI.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.5; State PUC Power Quality Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: med_event_count
attributes.description: Number of calendar days during the reporting period that qualified as Major Event Days (MEDs) per the IEEE 1366 beta + 2.5 sigma threshold methodology. Used to assess storm and extreme weather impact on reliability performance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: med_excluded_customer_interruptions
attributes.business_glossary_term: Major Event Day (MED) Excluded Customer Interruptions
attributes.description: Total customer interruptions attributable to Major Event Days (MEDs) that are excluded from the normalized IEEE 1366 index calculations. MEDs are days where the daily SAIDI exceeds a statistically derived threshold (beta + 2.5 sigma). Tracking this separately enables both total and MED-excluded reporting as required by most PUCs.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4 (Major Event Day definition); State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: med_excluded_customer_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Major Event Day (MED) Excluded Customer Minutes Interrupted
attributes.description: Total customer minutes interrupted attributable to Major Event Days (MEDs) that are excluded from the normalized IEEE 1366 index calculations. Used to compute MED-normalized SAIDI and SAIFI values required for PUC regulatory filings and NERC benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: med_threshold_saidi_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Major Event Day (MED) SAIDI Threshold in Minutes
attributes.description: The computed daily SAIDI threshold (beta + 2.5 sigma) used to classify a calendar day as a Major Event Day for this reporting period. Derived from the five-year historical daily SAIDI distribution per IEEE 1366 methodology. Documents the MED classification boundary applied to this period.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: momentary_interruption_count
attributes.description: Total number of momentary interruptions (duration five minutes or less per IEEE 1366 definition) experienced by customers during the reporting period. Used to compute MAIFI (Momentary Average Interruption Frequency Index) and assess power quality performance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.5 (MAIFI definition); State PUC Power Quality Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: nerc_registered_entity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Registered Entity ID
attributes.description: NERC Compliance Registry identifier for the utility entity responsible for this reliability report. Required for NERC reliability standard compliance submissions and benchmarking participation. Aligns with the NERC Transmission Planner, Distribution Provider, or Load-Serving Entity registration.
attributes.references: NERC Compliance Registry; NERC Reliability Standards EOP-004; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: oms_source_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outage Management System (OMS) Source System Code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Outage Management System (OMS) instance from which the underlying outage event data was sourced for this reliability index computation. Supports data lineage tracing back to GE PowerOn ADMS or equivalent OMS. Critical for audit and regulatory filing validation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Integration; SOX Data Lineage Requirements; State PUC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date marking the inclusive end of the reliability reporting period. Combined with period_start_date to define the exact window over which SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI indices are computed.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; FERC Form 1; State PUC Annual Reliability Report

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date marking the inclusive start of the reliability reporting period. Combined with period_end_date to define the exact window over which SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI indices are computed.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; FERC Form 1; State PUC Annual Reliability Report

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reporting period granularity. Determines the aggregation window for SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI index calculations. MONTHLY is used for operational monitoring; QUARTERLY and ANNUAL are used for PUC regulatory filings; ROLLING_12_MONTH is used for NERC benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4; NERC Reliability Standards EOP-004; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: planned_interruption_customer_minutes
attributes.description: Customer minutes interrupted attributable to planned (scheduled maintenance) outage events during the reporting period. Some PUC jurisdictions require separate reporting of planned vs. unplanned interruptions. Enables decomposition of total CMI into planned and unplanned components.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 3.2 (planned interruption definition); State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: prior_period_saidi_minutes
attributes.description: SAIDI value from the immediately preceding equivalent reporting period (e.g., prior month, prior quarter, prior year) for the same reporting entity. Stored on the record to support period-over-period variance analysis in regulatory filings without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Annual Reliability Report; NERC Reliability Benchmarking

attributes.name: prior_period_saifi_index
attributes.description: SAIFI value from the immediately preceding equivalent reporting period for the same reporting entity. Stored on the record to support period-over-period variance analysis in regulatory filings without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Annual Reliability Report; NERC Reliability Benchmarking

attributes.name: puc_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code plus PUC suffix identifying the state Public Utility Commission jurisdiction under which this reliability index period record is filed (e.g., CA-PUC, NY-PUC, TX-PUC). Determines applicable performance standards, reporting formats, and filing deadlines.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission Regulations; NERC Compliance Registry; FERC Jurisdictional Boundaries

attributes.name: puc_saidi_performance_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Utility Commission (PUC) SAIDI Performance Target in Minutes
attributes.description: Regulatory SAIDI performance target (in minutes) established by the applicable state PUC for the reporting period and reporting entity. Used to assess compliance with performance-based rate mechanisms and potential penalty or incentive triggers. Null if no PUC target applies to this reporting level.
attributes.references: State PUC Performance-Based Ratemaking Orders; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: puc_saifi_performance_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Utility Commission (PUC) SAIFI Performance Target
attributes.description: Regulatory SAIFI performance target established by the applicable state PUC for the reporting period and reporting entity. Used to assess compliance with performance-based rate mechanisms and potential penalty or incentive triggers. Null if no PUC target applies to this reporting level.
attributes.references: State PUC Performance-Based Ratemaking Orders; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: puc_target_met
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Utility Commission (PUC) Performance Target Met Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility met all applicable PUC reliability performance targets (SAIDI and SAIFI) for this reporting period and reporting entity. True if all applicable targets were met; False if one or more targets were missed. Null if no PUC targets apply. Drives performance-based rate adjustment calculations.
attributes.references: State PUC Performance-Based Ratemaking Orders; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: reporting_entity_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the specific entity (circuit ID, substation code, PUC territory code, operating area code, or system-level identifier) at which the reliability indices are reported. Corresponds to the reporting_level classification. For SYSTEM level, this is the utility NERC registered entity identifier.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; NERC Compliance Registry; State PUC Service Territory Definitions

attributes.name: reporting_entity_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the reporting entity (e.g., circuit name, substation name, PUC territory name, operating area name). Used for display in regulatory filings and reliability performance dashboards.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: reporting_level
attributes.description: Organizational or geographic granularity at which the reliability indices are computed and reported. SYSTEM represents the full utility service territory; CIRCUIT and SUBSTATION represent distribution-level granularity; PUC_TERRITORY aligns with regulatory jurisdiction boundaries; OPERATING_AREA represents internal operational divisions.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 5; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: reporting_period_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the reporting period, encoding the period type and calendar reference (e.g., MONTHLY-2024-03, QUARTERLY-2024-Q1, ANNUAL-2024). Used as the primary business key for regulatory filings and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; NERC Reliability Standards; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: saidi_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) in Minutes
attributes.description: System Average Interruption Duration Index expressed in minutes per customer. Computed as total_customer_minutes_interrupted divided by customers_served. Represents the average total duration of interruptions experienced per customer during the reporting period. Primary reliability metric for PUC regulatory filings and NERC benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.1; NERC Reliability Standards; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: saidi_normalized_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: IEEE 1366 Normalized SAIDI (Excluding Major Event Days) in Minutes
attributes.description: SAIDI value computed after excluding Major Event Day (MED) interruptions per IEEE 1366 normalization methodology. Computed as (total_customer_minutes_interrupted minus med_excluded_customer_minutes) divided by customers_served. This is the primary metric used for year-over-year performance benchmarking and PUC performance standard compliance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Performance Standards; NERC Reliability Benchmarking

attributes.name: saifi_index
attributes.description: System Average Interruption Frequency Index expressed as interruptions per customer. Computed as total_customer_interruptions divided by customers_served. Represents the average number of interruptions experienced per customer during the reporting period. Key reliability metric for PUC regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.2; NERC Reliability Standards; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: saifi_normalized_index
attributes.business_glossary_term: IEEE 1366 Normalized SAIFI (Excluding Major Event Days)
attributes.description: SAIFI value computed after excluding Major Event Day (MED) interruptions per IEEE 1366 normalization methodology. Computed as (total_customer_interruptions minus med_excluded_customer_interruptions) divided by customers_served. Used for PUC performance standard compliance and NERC benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Performance Standards; NERC Reliability Benchmarking

attributes.name: storm_related_outage_events
attributes.description: Number of outage events during the reporting period that were classified as storm-related (weather-caused). Supports storm impact analysis, MED classification validation, and regulatory storm reporting requirements. Sourced from OMS event cause codes.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Storm Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: third_party_outage_events
attributes.description: Number of outage events during the reporting period caused by third parties (e.g., vehicle accidents, dig-ins, animal contacts, vegetation encroachment by non-utility parties). Some PUC jurisdictions allow exclusion of third-party caused outages from performance standard calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: total_customer_interruptions
attributes.description: Total number of customer interruptions (sum of customers affected across all outage events) during the reporting period. This is the numerator for SAIFI calculation. Each customer affected by each distinct outage event counts as one interruption.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.2 (SAIFI definition); State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: total_customer_minutes_interrupted
attributes.description: Sum of the product of customers affected multiplied by outage duration in minutes across all outage events in the reporting period. This is the numerator for SAIDI calculation, expressed in customer-minutes. Also referred to as Customer Minutes of Interruption (CMI) in regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.1 (SAIDI definition); State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: total_outage_events
attributes.description: Total number of distinct outage events (interruption incidents) that occurred within the reporting entity boundary during the reporting period. Provides context for interpreting SAIDI and SAIFI values and supports frequency-based reliability analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Event Records; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: unplanned_interruption_customer_minutes
attributes.description: Customer minutes interrupted attributable to unplanned (forced/fault) outage events during the reporting period. Unplanned interruptions are the primary driver of reliability index degradation and are the focus of most PUC performance standards.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 3.2; State PUC Performance Standards; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number incremented each time this reliability index period record is amended or recomputed. Version 1 represents the initial filing; subsequent versions represent amendments. Supports regulatory amendment tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Amendment Reporting Requirements; SOX Internal Controls; IEEE Std 1366-2012

products.name: prediction
products.description: Operational record of a system-generated or dispatcher-created predicted outage scope at the time of initial event creation, capturing estimated number of affected customers, predicted cause, predicted affected circuit segments, confidence level, and prediction source (AMI ping, SCADA alarm, customer call clustering, predictive model). Distinct from the actual outage event — represents the initial assessment used for crew pre-positioning and ETR communication before field confirmation.
products.reference: Predicted Outage (GE PowerOn ADMS Predictive Outage)

attributes.name: prediction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the outage prediction record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module

attributes.name: ami_head_end_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.ami_head_end. Business justification: Outage predictions consume AMI last-gasp data aggregated by head-end system. prediction has ami_meter_count but no FK to ami_head_end. Linking supports AMI-based predictive outage analytics, head-end

attributes.name: cause_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.cause. Business justification: The prediction table has predicted_cause_code (STRING) and predicted_cause_description (STRING) as denormalized cause references. The cause table is the authoritative reference for outage cause classi

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the substation associated with the predicted outage scope. Used for crew dispatch routing and switching order coordination.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: load_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.load. Business justification: Predictive outage management systems integrate load forecasts to estimate customer impact (count, MW interrupted) and prioritize response. Advanced OMS platforms reference specific load forecast runs

attributes.name: oms_event_id
attributes.description: Externally-known identifier assigned by the Outage Management System (OMS) to the predicted outage event. Used to correlate this prediction record with the OMS event lifecycle and downstream actual outage records.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: prediction_circuit_feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary distribution circuit predicted to be affected by the outage. Sourced from the GIS network model and used for crew routing and switching order preparation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: prediction_feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution feeder predicted to be affected. A feeder is a primary distribution line segment fed from a substation bus. Used for network topology analysis and switching order preparation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: predictive_model_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the predictive analytics model version that generated this prediction, when prediction_source is 'predictive_model'. Enables model performance tracking, auditability, and retraining feedback loops.
attributes.references: DOE Grid Modernization Initiative; GE PowerOn ADMS — Predictive Analytics

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulated service territory within which the predicted outage falls. Used for regulatory reporting to State Public Utility Commissions (PUCs) and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI performance tracking.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Regulations; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: state_estimation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.state_estimation_run. Business justification: Outage predictions use the current network state from state estimation as input to predictive models. The state estimation run provides the baseline network topology for fault location prediction. Dom

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storm or major weather event record associated with this prediction, if applicable. Links the prediction to the storm response management workflow for resource mobilization and regulatory major event day (MED) classification.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day (MED) Classification; State PUC Storm Reporting

attributes.name: weather_input_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.weather_input. Business justification: Outage prediction models consume weather forecast inputs (wind speed, precipitation, temperature) to predict storm-related outage likelihood and severity. Utilities use this linkage for storm prepared

attributes.name: ami_meter_count
attributes.description: Number of Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) smart meters within the predicted outage scope that contributed last-gasp or ping-failure signals to the prediction. Indicates the AMI signal density supporting the prediction confidence.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — Meter Reading; AMI/MDM Integration

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: Numeric confidence score (0.00–100.00) representing the model's or system's certainty in the predicted outage scope, cause, and affected area. Higher values indicate greater confidence. Used to prioritize crew dispatch and ETR communication decisions.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Predictive Analytics; DOE Grid Modernization Initiative

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this outage prediction record was first persisted in the data platform. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: crew_preplacement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether field crews have been pre-positioned based on this outage prediction prior to field confirmation of the actual outage. When True, crew dispatch records are linked to this prediction in the workforce management system.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management; Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management

attributes.name: critical_customer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predicted outage scope includes one or more critical customers (e.g., hospitals, emergency services, life-support customers, large industrial accounts with SLA obligations). When True, triggers priority restoration protocols and mandatory customer notification.
attributes.references: State PUC Critical Customer Regulations; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: customer_call_count
attributes.description: Number of inbound customer outage calls received and clustered to generate or corroborate this prediction. Used to assess the customer-reported signal strength and prioritize crew dispatch.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U — CIS; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Customer Management

attributes.name: der_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predicted outage scope includes Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) such as rooftop solar, battery storage, or microgrids that may be islanded or require isolation procedures. When True, DERMS coordination is required.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 — DER Interconnection; FERC Order 2222; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time after which this prediction is considered stale and should no longer be used for crew dispatch or ETR communication without refresh. Typically set to a configurable window (e.g., 2 hours) after prediction_timestamp. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module

attributes.name: flisr_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predicted outage scope is within a network segment eligible for automated Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration (FLISR) execution via the ADMS. When True, automated switching sequences may be initiated without manual dispatcher intervention.

attributes.name: major_event_day_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prediction is associated with a Major Event Day (MED) as defined by IEEE 1366. MED events are excluded from standard SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI calculations and reported separately to state PUCs and NERC.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day Classification; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC

attributes.name: medical_baseline_customer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predicted outage scope includes customers enrolled in a medical baseline or life-support program. When True, triggers mandatory proactive notification and priority restoration per state PUC regulations.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline / Life Support Customer Regulations

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage notification has been sent to affected customers based on this prediction. When True, the notification timestamp and channel are tracked in the customer notification log. Supports state PUC notification compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; NAESB Business Practices

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the first customer notification was dispatched based on this outage prediction. Used for state PUC compliance reporting on notification timeliness. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the predicted outage by its nature. 'unplanned' = unexpected equipment or system failure; 'planned' = scheduled maintenance window; 'storm' = weather-driven event; 'momentary' = predicted to be a brief interruption (< 5 minutes per IEEE 1366); 'sustained' = predicted to exceed the momentary threshold.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices

attributes.name: predicted_affected_segments
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of distribution circuit segment identifiers predicted to be de-energized. Sourced from the GIS network model topology analysis. Used for switching order preparation and crew routing.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: predicted_customer_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of customers predicted to be without power based on the initial assessment. Used for crew pre-positioning, ETR communication, and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI impact estimation. Distinct from the confirmed customer count on the actual outage event record.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: predicted_etr
attributes.description: Initial estimated date and time by which power is predicted to be restored to affected customers. Communicated to customers and field crews at the time of prediction creation. Distinct from the revised ETR updated during active restoration. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: predicted_fault_latitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal latitude coordinate of the predicted fault location. Used for GIS-based crew dispatch and outage mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; WGS-84 Coordinate Reference System

attributes.name: predicted_fault_location
attributes.description: Predicted geographic or network location of the fault, expressed as a GIS asset identifier, address, or coordinate reference. Used to direct first-responder crews to the most probable fault point before field confirmation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Outage Analysis; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: predicted_fault_longitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal longitude coordinate of the predicted fault location. Used for GIS-based crew dispatch and outage mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; WGS-84 Coordinate Reference System

attributes.name: predicted_load_mw
attributes.description: Estimated megawatts (MW) of load predicted to be interrupted based on the affected circuit segments and customer mix. Used for grid operations impact assessment and load restoration prioritization.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management; NERC TPL Standards

attributes.name: predicted_outage_duration_min
attributes.description: Estimated duration of the outage in minutes as assessed at the time of prediction creation. Derived from historical restoration times for similar cause codes and circuit configurations. Used for CAIDI estimation and crew resource planning.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — CAIDI; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: prediction_source
attributes.description: The originating signal or mechanism that triggered the outage prediction. 'ami_ping' = Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) last-gasp or ping failure; 'scada_alarm' = SCADA system alarm from field device; 'customer_call_cluster' = clustering of inbound customer outage calls; 'predictive_model' = ML/analytics model output; 'dispatcher_manual' = manually entered by a system operator or dispatcher; 'smart_meter_outage_notification' = direct outage notification from smart meter.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — Meter Reading; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: prediction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the outage prediction record. 'pending' = generated but not yet dispatched; 'active' = in use for crew pre-positioning and ETR communication; 'confirmed' = field crew has validated the predicted scope; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer prediction; 'cancelled' = prediction voided before confirmation; 'expired' = prediction window elapsed without field confirmation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module

attributes.name: prediction_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the outage prediction was system-generated or dispatcher-created. Represents the principal real-world event time for this prediction record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: predictive_model_version
attributes.description: Version string of the predictive analytics model that generated this prediction. Used alongside predictive_model_id for model governance, auditability, and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: DOE Grid Modernization Initiative; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: protection_zone
attributes.description: The protection zone or relay zone within which the predicted fault is located. Used by switching order coordinators to identify the correct protective device (recloser, fuse, breaker) to operate for isolation and restoration.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR; IEEE C37 — Protective Relaying

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this outage prediction record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GE PowerOn ADMS; OSIsoft PI; Oracle Utilities MDM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this outage prediction record was last modified in the data platform. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: voltage_level
attributes.description: Voltage classification of the network segment predicted to be affected. Determines the severity tier, crew qualification requirements, and regulatory reporting category.
attributes.references: IEC 60038 — Standard Voltages; IEEE C57; NERC FAC Standards

attributes.name: weather_condition_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the weather conditions at the time of prediction creation (e.g., clear, wind, ice, lightning, flood). Used for cause analysis, storm classification, and reliability reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|wind|ice|lightning|flood|snow|extreme_heat|fog|tornado|hurricane — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day Classification; NOAA Weather Classification

attributes.name: wind_speed_mph
attributes.description: Recorded or forecast wind speed in miles per hour at the predicted fault location at the time of prediction creation. Used for storm severity assessment and major event day (MED) classification.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day Classification; NOAA

products.name: call
products.description: Record of an inbound customer trouble call or AMI-generated outage report received by the utility, used to initiate or corroborate an outage event. Captures call receipt timestamp, source type (IVR, agent, AMI ping, mobile app, web portal), reported symptom, caller account reference, associated outage event (once matched), call disposition, and whether the call was a duplicate of an existing event. Feeds OMS call clustering and outage prediction logic.
products.reference: Trouble Call (GE PowerOn ADMS / Oracle CC&B CIS)

attributes.name: call_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each inbound customer trouble call or AMI-generated outage report record in the Outage Management System (OMS). Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Management

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility customer account associated with the caller or AMI device that originated this outage report. Links to the Customer Information System (CIS) account record.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Account Management

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.der_system. Business justification: Trouble calls from DER customers may indicate system malfunction, islanding issues, or anti-islanding protection failures requiring DER system reference for proper diagnosis and dispatch prioritizatio

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution substation serving the reported outage location, resolved from the GIS network model. Used for geographic grouping of calls, outage event scoping, and storm response coordination.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Substation Asset Model; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: duplicate_of_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original (first-received) outage call record of which this call is a duplicate. Populated only when is_duplicate = True. Enables deduplication lineage tracing in OMS call clustering.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Clustering

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event record once this call has been matched or clustered to a confirmed outage event in the OMS. Null until the call is correlated to an event.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Event Management

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution circuit (feeder) serving the reported outage location, resolved from the GIS network model based on the service address or premise. Used for OMS call clustering by circuit and outage event correlation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Distribution Network Model; GE PowerOn ADMS — ADMS (Advanced Distribution Management System) Circuit Management

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the smart meter or AMI endpoint that generated an automated outage ping or last-gasp signal, if the call source is AMI-initiated rather than a human caller.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — Meter Data Management; AMI Infrastructure

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility service premise (physical delivery point) associated with the reported outage location. Links to the GIS/network model for spatial outage clustering and distribution circuit identification.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U — Device Management; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the declared storm or major weather event record associated with this outage call, when weather_event_flag = True. Links to the storm event management entity for storm response coordination and MED exclusion processing.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day (MED); GE PowerOn ADMS — Storm Management; State PUC Storm Reporting

attributes.name: affected_customers_reported
attributes.description: Number of customers the caller reports as being affected by the outage (e.g., 'my whole street is out'). This is a caller-provided estimate, not a system-confirmed count. Used as an early indicator for outage scope assessment and crew dispatch prioritization.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Outage Scope Assessment; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: ami_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the AMI endpoint (smart meter) that generated an automated last-gasp outage notification or power-off ping. Populated only when call_source_type = AMI_PING. Used to correlate AMI-detected outages with customer account and network topology.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) Device Management; ANSI C12.19

attributes.name: ami_signal_type
attributes.description: Type of automated signal received from the AMI endpoint that triggered this outage report. LAST_GASP = meter-detected power loss notification; POWER_RESTORE = meter-detected power restoration; TAMPER = tamper event; BLINK = momentary interruption blink count; POWER_QUALITY = voltage sag/swell event. Populated only when call_source_type = AMI_PING.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — AMI Signal Processing; IEEE 1159 Power Quality

attributes.name: call_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the outage call record within the OMS workflow. RECEIVED = call logged, not yet processed; PENDING_MATCH = awaiting correlation to an outage event; MATCHED = successfully linked to an outage event; DUPLICATE = identified as a duplicate of an existing call or event; CLOSED = call resolved and closed; CANCELLED = call withdrawn or invalid.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Management Workflow

attributes.name: caller_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who placed the trouble call, as provided at time of call. May differ from the account holder name if a third party is reporting on behalf of the customer. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR/CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Call Management

attributes.name: caller_phone_number
attributes.description: Phone number provided by or captured from the caller at time of call receipt. Used for call-back confirmation and customer notification of restoration. Classified as restricted PII per GDPR/CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Call Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this outage call record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer ingestion timestamp). Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and regulatory record-keeping. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; NERC Reliability Reporting Audit Trail; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: Classification of the customer associated with this outage call by service type. Used for restoration prioritization, regulatory reporting, and SAIDI/SAIFI index segmentation per IEEE 1366 and PUC requirements.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Tariff Classification; SAP IS-U — Customer Classification

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the data quality status of this outage call record as assessed during Silver Layer ingestion and validation. VALID = passed all validation rules; SUSPECT = passed ingestion but has anomalies requiring review; INVALID = failed critical validation; PENDING_REVIEW = awaiting manual data quality review.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Quality Standards; Oracle Utilities MDM — VEE (Validation, Estimation, and Editing)

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the final outcome or resolution action taken on this call (e.g., EVENT_CREATED, ADDED_TO_EVENT, DUPLICATE_CLOSED, NO_OUTAGE_FOUND, REFERRED_TO_CREW, CUSTOMER_CALLBACK_SCHEDULED). Sourced from OMS disposition reference table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EVENT_CREATED|ADDED_TO_EVENT|DUPLICATE_CLOSED|NO_OUTAGE_FOUND|REFERRED_TO_CREW|CUSTOMER_CALLBACK_SCHEDULED|INVALID — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Disposition; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the customer call in seconds from answer to disconnect, for calls received via IVR or live agent channels. Used for call center operational reporting, SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance, and customer experience analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B — Call Center Operations; State PUC Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Estimated date and time of power restoration communicated to the customer at the time of call handling or subsequent notification. Sourced from OMS restoration forecasting. Used for customer expectation management and SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Restoration Forecasting; State PUC Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: hazard_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the caller reported a safety hazard associated with the outage (e.g., downed power line, sparking equipment, fire, flooding near electrical equipment). True = hazard reported; False = no hazard reported. Triggers priority escalation in OMS crew dispatch and public safety notification workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 — Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Priority Escalation

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: Specific type of safety hazard reported by the caller when hazard_indicator = True. Used to determine emergency response protocol, crew safety briefing requirements, and coordination with emergency services (fire, police). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DOWNED_LINE|SPARKING|FIRE|FLOODING|EQUIPMENT_DAMAGE|TREE_ON_LINE|VEHICLE_ACCIDENT|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC CIP; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Hazard Management

attributes.name: is_duplicate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this call has been identified as a duplicate report of an outage already captured by a prior call or AMI notification for the same event and location. True = duplicate; False = unique first report. Used by OMS call clustering logic to avoid double-counting in reliability metrics.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Clustering; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: ivr_session_code
attributes.description: Unique session identifier assigned by the Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system for calls received through the automated phone channel. Used for call traceability, IVR system reconciliation, and customer experience analytics. Populated only when call_source_type = IVR.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B — IVR (Interactive Voice Response) Integration; SAP IS-U CIS

attributes.name: matched_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this call was successfully matched or correlated to a confirmed outage event in the OMS. Populated when call_status transitions to MATCHED. Used for OMS processing latency analysis and reliability reporting timelines. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Event Correlation

attributes.name: medical_baseline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the affected customer account is registered on the utility's medical baseline or life-support program, requiring priority restoration and proactive notification per PUC regulations. True = medical baseline customer; False = standard customer. Classified as confidential due to sensitivity of health-related program enrollment.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Program Rules; NERC EOP Standards; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Customer Program Management

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage acknowledgement or estimated restoration time (ERT) notification has been sent to the customer associated with this call. True = notification sent; False = not yet sent. Supports PUC customer notification compliance tracking.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Customer Notification

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the outage acknowledgement or estimated restoration time (ERT) notification was dispatched to the customer. Populated when notification_sent_flag = True. Used for PUC notification compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Notification Management

attributes.name: oms_call_cluster_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outage Management System (OMS) Call Cluster ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the OMS call cluster to which this call has been assigned during the outage prediction and event correlation process. Multiple calls from the same geographic area or circuit are grouped into a cluster to predict the probable outage location and initiate crew dispatch before a formal event is confirmed.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS (Outage Management System) Call Clustering and Outage Prediction

attributes.name: outage_start_reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the caller reports the outage began, as stated by the customer or detected by the AMI device. May differ from the OMS-confirmed outage start time. Used as an input to outage event timeline reconstruction and SAIDI/CAIDI calculations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Reliability Indices; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Event Timeline

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Restoration priority level assigned to this outage call based on hazard indicators, medical baseline status, customer class, and outage scope. CRITICAL = life-safety or critical infrastructure; HIGH = medical baseline or large commercial/industrial; MEDIUM = standard residential or small commercial; LOW = non-urgent or duplicate. Drives OMS crew dispatch sequencing.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Restoration Prioritization; State PUC Service Reliability Rules

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the outage call or AMI-generated outage report was received by the utility system. This is the principal business event timestamp used for OMS call clustering, outage prediction, and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: reference_number
